title: Solution Architect Product & Technology
description:
**Department:**
Product Development
  
  
**Location:**
India - Resident (0008)
  
  
**Compensation:**
Rs3,825,000 - Rs5,175,000 / year
  
  
**Description**
**This role will be working out of our office 5 days a week.**
Vena Solutions is seeking a Solution Architect, Product & Technology to drive the evolution of the features and capabilities of Vena’s SaaS cloud platform. Armed with a core set of architecture skills on cloud based apps, you will own the architecture of existing and emerging features and capabilities.With a keen eye on non-functional requirements, you will translate business requirements into a resilient solution within the Vena platform. This role is a match for you if you are looking to apply your architecture strengths in applications & technology as a key contributor to the delivery of an incredible experience for our customers. At Vena we continuously evolve through innovation with a keen eye on a customer experience that is second to none. Ensuring that we maintain our customers' trust as we enhance our products will be a core goal to the work you perform. Delivering in close collaboration with our Engineering teams you will help ensure the quality product our customers have grown to expect. Our environment and culture both foster and encourage individuals who are self-directed and self-motivated, empowering employees to take ownership of our collective success. Here at Vena, we value transparency, inclusion, continuous learning and passionate people who want to make their mark on our rapidly growing product and business.The successful candidate will have the opportunity to collaborate with a broad range of stakeholders, including Product, Engineering, SaaS Technology & Ops, and Security/InfoSec, as you provide thought leadership and hands-on support in meeting functional and non-functional requirements aligned with our standards and roadmaps. To be successful, this role requires you to thrive in a workplace that is fun, engaging, technically challenging and filled with opportunities to be individually impactful.
  
  
**How You'll Make An Impact**

* Solution Architecture + Strategy/Roadmap:

+ Working with Product Management and domain experts, define and own the architecture and roadmap for a set of product features/capabilities in a cloud-based application environment
+ Collaborate closely with Engineers in the definition of solutions and design
+ Review and validate alignment of Engineer designs and implementations against your Solution Architecture, with full compliance and standards adherence
+ Support Scrum teams during development lifecycle in troubleshooting, innovating and refactoring

* R&D:

+ Keep informed on current industry trends and evaluate opportunities to evolve our patterns, blueprints, processes and tactics

* Communications:

+ Maintain Architecture artifacts and proactively communicate/manage change to support your stakeholders while mentoring and training Engineers

* Governance:

+ Actively participate as a member of the architecture governance board in both process definition and execution, including development of internal standards, policies, principles, and best practices.

* Innovation:

+ Work with stakeholders in PoC activities to promote business cases for future features and enhancements, while supporting our culture of innovation

**We'd Love to See**

* 3+ years’ experience in applied Solution Architecture
* 5+ years’ experience in software development with 3+ years’ experience in Java / Fullstack
* Working knowledge of React/Redux and experience developing in NodeJS (or equivalent)
* Good understanding of algorithms and computational complexity
* Experience or deep understanding of data structures, management and OLTP an asset
* Experience in designing distributed and concurrent systems and microservices and APIs (REST, GraphQL)
* Experience with AWS, Microsoft Azure, or equivalent cloud environments
* Knowledge of and experience with development of cloud-based SaaS applications
* Proven collaboration, communication and influencing skills across diverse stakeholders
* Prior experience in scrum/lean/agile environment, preferably while working on a cloud-based solution
* You are self-motivated, and self-directed
* You enjoy tackling new problems and pushing technology forward
* A history of demonstrating empathy for customers

Base salary range 31,15,350 - 42,14,885 INR
  
  

* Our salaries are tailored to roles, levels and locations. Your individual pay within this range is influenced by factors like work location, skills, experience and education. As you progress in your role, your compensation may adapt, offering flexibility for growth beyond initial levels. For specifics, your recruiter will provide details and address any questions during the hiring process.

title: Lead GenAI Platform Engineer
description:
NO FRESHER WILL BE PREFERRED
  
  
We are looking for Lead GenAI Engineer as a Full Time for our IT Company.
  
  
Location- Remote
  
Experience- 10+ years
  
Budget- As per company standard
  
Notice Period- Immediate Joiner
  
  
AI Engineer – GenAI Platform Engineering
  
  
Primary Skill: Gen AI Tools
  
  
Secondary Skill: Python, Machine Learning, Data Engineering
  
  
Tertiary Skill: Hadoop
  
  
Minimum Years of Experience: 10
  
  
Business Justification
  
This role is a strategic platform engineering lead responsible for designing and scaling enterprise Generative AI, Data Science, Metadata, Data Quality, and Event-Driven platform capabilities within MALTS. The position will drive self-service AI enablement, platform modernization, and reusable enterprise services that accelerate AI adoption across Consumer, Banking, and Wealth businesses. Ideal candidates possess deep expertise in GenAI, platform engineering, data engineering, distributed systems, governance, and enterprise-scale AI platforms.
  
  
  
Workday Position Summary
  
This is a senior platform engineering role responsible for architecting, building, and advancing Bank of America’s enterprise-scale Generative AI leveraging Data Science, Event Platform, Data Quality, Metadata, and Data Platform capabilities. The role will help define the strategy, architecture, and engineering standards for next-generation AI and data platforms that enable self-service, governed, and scalable solutions across Consumer, Banking, Wealth, and Enterprise organizations.
  
  
The successful candidate will lead the design and delivery of reusable enterprise platform services that accelerate AI adoption, data-driven decision making, advanced analytics, agentic workflows, and digital transformation initiatives. This individual will work closely with architects, product owners, engineers, data scientists, and business stakeholders to build highly scalable, secure, and resilient platforms leveraging cloud-native technologies, distributed computing, modern data architectures, and Generative AI frameworks.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise with strong leadership skills, a passion for innovation, and the ability to translate complex business needs into enterprise-grade platform capabilities.
  
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
Provide technical leadership, architectural direction, and platform engineering expertise across enterprise Generative AI, Data Science, Data Engineering, Event Streaming, Metadata, and Data Quality initiatives.
  
  
Design and develop reusable platform services that enable end-to-end self-service AI and data workflows, including data onboarding, data preparation, experimentation, model development, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, governance, and observability.
  
  
Define and implement enterprise standards, reference architectures, and engineering best practices for scalable AI and data platforms.
  
  
Lead the design and delivery of agentic AI applications, intelligent workflows, MCP-enabled services, and event-driven architectures using modern open-source technologies.
  
  
Partner with business, product, architecture, and engineering teams to gather requirements, evaluate technologies, prototype solutions, and accelerate innovation.
  
  
Drive platform modernization initiatives leveraging cloud-native architectures, Kubernetes, containers, serverless services, distributed computing, and modern data processing frameworks.
  
  
Ensure platform solutions meet enterprise requirements for security, governance, resiliency, scalability, availability, compliance, and operational excellence.
  
  
Establish and enforce CI/CD, Infrastructure-as-Code, automation, and DevSecOps practices to improve developer productivity and platform reliability.
  
  
Provide technical mentorship, conduct architecture reviews, perform code reviews, and champion engineering excellence across teams.
  
  
Own critical technology decisions and communicate architectural direction effectively to technical and executive stakeholders.
  
  
  
Required Qualifications
  
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or related technical discipline.
  
  
10+ years of hands-on experience designing and building enterprise-scale AI, Data Science, Data Engineering, Metadata, Data Quality, and Analytics platforms.
  
  
Proven experience architecting and implementing enterprise Generative AI platforms, including LLM integration, agent frameworks, retrieval systems, prompt orchestration, vector-enabled architectures, and AI governance capabilities.
  
  
Strong experience building self-service platforms supporting the complete AI/ML lifecycle, including data ingestion, feature engineering, experimentation, model development, deployment, inferencing, monitoring, and observability.
  
  
Deep understanding of modern AI and data platform architectures, including storage-compute separation, distributed processing, interactive development environments, containerization, and developer productivity tooling.
  
  
Experience designing and implementing metadata-driven platforms, semantic layers, data lineage, data quality frameworks, knowledge graphs, and enterprise data governance solutions.
  
  
Hands-on expertise with Python and modern AI/ML ecosystems, including open-source frameworks, libraries, and model-serving technologies.
  
  
Strong experience designing event-driven and streaming architectures using technologies such as Kafka, Apache Spark, Flink, or equivalent distributed processing frameworks.
  
  
Experience building and deploying scalable AI and data workloads on Kubernetes, containers, virtualized infrastructure, and cloud-native environments.
  
  
Practical experience developing enterprise-grade APIs, microservices, and distributed systems supporting high-volume data and AI workloads.
  
  
Experience implementing CI/CD, automated testing, infrastructure automation, and DevSecOps practices using enterprise toolchains.
  
  
Strong understanding of platform observability, monitoring, security, governance, reliability, recoverability, and operational excellence.
  
  
Proven ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams, influence architectural decisions, and communicate complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.
  
  
  
Preferred Qualifications
  
Experience building enterprise-wide GenAI ecosystems including AI gateways, model management, prompt management, vector databases, agent orchestration, and responsible AI capabilities.
  
  
Experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), agentic architectures, MCP servers, AI workflow orchestration, and enterprise knowledge platforms.
  
  
Strong knowledge of cloud-native AI and data platforms across public and private cloud environments.
  
  
Experience with developer platforms, internal AI copilots, self-service data products, and platform product management.
  
  
Experience establishing enterprise AI governance, compliance, risk controls, and responsible AI practices.
  
  
Demonstrated success leading large-scale platform transformations and modernizing legacy analytics and data science ecosystems.

title: Senior Manager
description:
**Senior Technology / Engineering Manager**

**Pune Onsite**

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a Senior Technology / Engineering Manager to lead engineering initiatives, technology delivery, and team execution within a dynamic and growing organization.

This role requires a leader who is comfortable wearing multiple hats, taking ownership across technology, delivery, people, and business priorities, and operating effectively without highly segmented responsibilities.

This is a hands-on leadership opportunity for someone who can combine strong technical understanding with people leadership, strategic thinking, and day-to-day execution.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead engineering teams, providing technical direction, coaching, and performance leadership.
* Own end-to-end technology delivery across multiple projects, initiatives, and priorities.
* Translate business objectives into practical technology strategies, solutions, and execution plans.
* Work closely with senior leadership and key stakeholders to define priorities, manage expectations, and drive successful outcomes.
* Provide technical guidance on software architecture, application development, modernization, cloud, and emerging technologies.
* Manage multiple concurrent initiatives while maintaining focus on timelines, quality, resources, and business priorities.
* Establish and improve engineering processes, development standards, delivery practices, and operational discipline.
* Participate in architecture and design discussions and provide hands-on guidance when required.
* Identify delivery risks, technical challenges, and resource constraints and proactively develop solutions.
* Collaborate across engineering, product, operations, business, and other functional teams to ensure effective execution.
* Help build scalable engineering practices and organizational capabilities as the company continues to grow.
* Take ownership of problems beyond a narrowly defined functional area and drive them through resolution.
* Support technology planning, budgeting, resource allocation, and prioritization.
* Evaluate new technologies and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, scalability, reliability, and overall business value.
* Contribute to hiring, team development, succession planning, and building a high-performing engineering culture.
* Balance strategic technology leadership with the ability to get into the details when the situation requires it.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Senior Manager-level experience leading engineering, technology, software development, or technology delivery teams.
* Experience working in a small to mid-sized organization, startup, scale-up, or entrepreneurial environment is highly preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to wear multiple hats and take ownership across technology, delivery, people, and business priorities.
* Strong technical foundation with the ability to engage in architecture, engineering, and technology discussions.
* Proven experience managing multiple projects, workstreams, or competing priorities simultaneously.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to operate independently, make decisions, and drive initiatives with limited layers of management.
* Strong problem-solving and execution mindset.
* Experience building teams, processes, and engineering practices in a growing organization.
* Ability to move between strategic discussions and detailed execution when required.

title: ServiceNow Architect
description:
ServiceNow Architect

**Location:**
Pune

**Experience:**
8–12+ years (minimum 4–5 years as an Architect)

**Reports to:**
Head of ServiceNow Practice

About the Role

We are building a ServiceNow platform practice and its flagship solution.

As Architect, you will own the technical design of this offering end-to-end and set the architectural standards for the broader ServiceNow practice as we scale delivery.

What You'll Do

* Own solution architecture across ITSM, ITOM (Event Management, Discovery, CMDB), and Integration Hub for the AuditIQ platform and future offerings.
* Design the integration architecture connecting log/monitoring sources (application logs, infra telemetry) into ServiceNow via REST/SOAP APIs, MID Server, and Integration Hub spokes.
* Define the pattern-matching and incident-correlation design — how known error signatures, anomaly detection, and duplicate-incident checks translate into ServiceNow workflows and data models.
* Establish CMDB and data model standards to support incident-to-CI linkage and historical incident referencing (root cause, resolution).
* Lead technical design reviews, environment/instance strategy, security architecture, and performance/scalability planning.
* Define coding standards, integration patterns, and reusable components for the delivery team to build against.
* Act as the technical anchor in client/pre-sales conversations — solutioning, effort estimation, and technical proposals.
* Mentor Lead Developers and Developers; run architecture governance and code/design reviews.
* Stay current on ServiceNow releases (AI capabilities, Predictive Intelligence, Now Assist) and evaluate fit for the AuditIQ roadmap.

Must-Have Skills

* Proven ServiceNow architecture experience across at least 2 of: ITSM, ITOM, Event Management, Integration Hub, CMDB/Discovery.
* Strong grasp of ServiceNow scripting (Glide API, Business Rules, Script Includes, Flow Designer, Scripted REST APIs).
* Experience designing integrations with external monitoring/log tools (e.g., Splunk, Dynatrace, AppDynamics, ELK, Datadog).
* Solid understanding of CMDB data modeling and the Common Service Data Model (CSDM).
* Experience with ServiceNow's AI/ML capabilities — Predictive Intelligence, Performance Analytics, or Now Assist — is a strong plus.
* Track record of solutioning and presenting to client/leadership stakeholders.

Good to Have

* ServiceNow Certified Technical Architect (CTA).
* Experience building a practice or offering from scratch (not just project delivery).
* Exposure to DevSecOps tooling integration with ServiceNow.

Certifications

**Mandatory**

* CSA (Certified System Administrator)

**Required (at least one)**

* CIS-ITSM
* CIS-Event Management
* CIS-Discovery

**Preferred**

* CTA (Certified Technical Architect)

title: AI Engineering Lead – Agentic AI Platform (Telecom BSS/OSS)
description:
**Hiring Location: Pune, Mumbai, Bengaluru**

**On-site: UAE**

We are hiring a Technical Engineering Lead for an AI-native digital transformation platform at [a Tier-1 telecom operator in the UAE]. In line with the UAE National AI Strategy, the operator is building agentic AI and sovereign compute into its core connectivity and BSS/OSS platforms. You will be the platform's senior technical authority: you own the design and the delivery, and you lead the squads who build it.

This is not a hands-off management role. You will design multi-agent workflows and review the code that ships them.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Design the platform

• Design cloud-native, secure, scalable architecture that brings LLMs, multi-agent systems and autonomous workflows into Network Operations (NOC), Service Assurance and customer lifecycle management.

• Design agent networks (LangGraph, LangChain, AutoGen) that run real-time, intent-based network and BSS workflows: automated recovery playbooks, predictive fault management, Zero-Touch Provisioning and autonomous network slicing.

• Align designs with TM Forum ODA and CAMARA APIs, and integrate telco-specific LLMs for alarm correlation, complex event processing and network analytics.

• Deploy across regional sovereign cloud and hybrid environments (AWS, Azure OpenAI, OCI).

Lead engineering delivery

• Own the technical roadmap end to end, and give architecture- and code-level guidance in Python, Go and Node.js.

• Make AI-assisted development (Cursor, GitHub Copilot) the team's standard way of working, with clear standards for prompt and context engineering, prompt versioning, semantic chunking and RAG pipelines.

• Partner with product managers, data scientists, network domain experts and senior stakeholders to turn telecom business problems into technical blueprints.

Make AI production-grade

• Build LLM evaluation into CI/CD: automated test beds that score models on hallucination, toxicity, compliance, latency and context recall before anything is released.

• Redefine QA for non-deterministic systems, with probabilistic testing of agents that handle billing, SIM activation and VVIP service assurance.

• Run LLMOps at scale (Databricks or Kubeflow): feedback loops, intent classification models, fine-tuning and guardrail validation.

• Instrument multi-step reasoning chains with tracing (OpenInference, Arize Phoenix, LangSmith), and control token cost through prompt caching, dynamic model routing and throughput scaling while meeting local latency targets.

Govern and protect

• Make sure every data layer complies with TDRA regulations and sovereign data-privacy requirements.

• Put real-time guardrails in place (e.g. NeMo Guardrails) for data masking, jailbreak prevention and responsible-AI behaviour.

Build the team

• Lead, mentor and upskill software and AI engineers on engineering quality and responsible AI, and help develop early-career talent through initiatives such as the AI Graduate Programme.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

Essential

• [12+] years of hands-on software engineering, including [4+] years as a Tech Lead or technical design authority leading squads on complex production systems, ideally at a Tier-1 telecom operator or a large enterprise.

• A track record of delivering RAG and agentic systems in production: LangChain/LangGraph or LlamaIndex, vector databases (Milvus, Pinecone, Qdrant or similar), and LLMOps/MLOps pipelines.

• Strong Python, plus Node.js and/or Go.

• Deep experience with AWS, Azure or GCP, plus Kubernetes, Docker, service meshes and Terraform across hybrid environments.

• Working knowledge of telecom architecture in at least one area: BSS/OSS stacks, 5G and network slicing, NFV/SDN, service assurance, or event-driven telemetry and alarm correlation.

• Daily use of AI coding assistants, and evidence that you have raised a team's productivity with them.

• A record of coaching engineers and building strong teams.

Highly valued

• Hands-on TM Forum ODA / Open APIs or CAMARA experience.

• LLM evaluation, observability and guardrail tooling running in production.

• Fine-tuning or intent-classification work on Databricks or Kubeflow.

• Delivery in sovereign or regulated cloud environments, ideally in the GCC.

WHY THIS ROLE

• Production, not proofs of concept: agents running live network and customer operations on a national network.

• A mandate to set the engineering and AI standards for the platform from day one.

• Visible, strategic work tied directly to a national AI agenda.

HOW TO APPLY

Apply via LinkedIn or send your CV to services@therighthire.co.uk.

In a few lines, tell us about one agentic or RAG system you took to production: what it did, the scale it ran at, and one thing that went wrong and how you fixed it.

#Hiring #AgenticAI #GenAI #LLMOps #Telecom #BSS #OSS #EngineeringLeadership #UAEJobs

title: Workplace AI Architect
description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.
  
  
**About The Role**
Define and govern the adoption of AI across Workplace and platform-based solutions, with a strong focus on out-of-the-box capabilities, integrations, and security. Act as the orchestration point across Software Development, Data & Analytics, business users, and platform owners, ensuring consistent routing of AI initiatives. Drive the transition from ad-hoc usage to controlled, scalable adoption through clear governance, measurement, and chargeback, positioning AI as an extension of existing platforms rather than a parallel capability. The role focuses on Workplace AI platforms and embedded capabilities such as Microsoft 365 Copilot, AI assistants, and collaboration tools.
  
  
**Main Accountabilities And Tasks**

* AI Roadmap & Out-of-the-Box Ownership: Own the AI roadmap for Workplace and platform-based AI capabilities and the adoption of out-of-the-box solutions; contribute to the cross-functional definition of AI architecture; establish AI as a coherent enterprise capability.
* Platform-First, Preview & Early-Access Ownership: Prioritise out-of-the-box capabilities over new builds; own the evaluation, piloting, and rollout of preview features and vendor early-access programmes; track and govern AI features increasingly embedded in existing enterprise services.
* Governance of Services, Integrations & Agents: Establish a single enterprise entry point and a risk-based approval process, supported by self-service guardrails and clear approval timelines so the front door enables rather than blocks; govern AI services, integrations, APIs, and the lifecycle of AI agents; ensure every AI asset is inventoried, owned, and operated within agreed controls.
* Routing of AI Initiatives Across Delivery Tracks: Define and govern how AI initiatives are routed across delivery tracks - out-of-the-box, preview, and early-access (this role); citizen development (business users, against standards set by this role); custom development and advanced integrations (Software Development); and analytics-driven solutions (Data & Analytics).
* Security, Risk & Compliance (with Infosec): Together with Infosec, define and enforce AI-specific controls under a clear split of accountability for who defines, approves, and enforces; ensure compliance with GDPR and the EU AI Act; govern third-party AI usage and minimise shadow-AI risk.
* AI Lifecycle Management: Govern the full lifecycle covering build, publish, operate, and retire; ensure ownership, inventory, and transparency for every AI solution; enforce environment-based controls across experiment, managed, and production.
* Business Value, Chargeback & Adoption: Define how AI business value is measured; build and operate a chargeback model so consumption is transparent and costs sit with the consuming business; drive adoption and track it against value realisation.
* User Support, Enablement & Training: Act as the primary point of contact for AI adoption; provide patterns, guardrails, and reusable templates so users can build safely; deliver training, documentation, and onboarding paths that build AI literacy across the organisation.

**Desired Experience And Qualifications**

* Work experience: 8-10+ years in enterprise IT, architecture, or transformation roles, with experience in governance, platform strategy, or large-scale adoption.
* Expertise: Senior expert / enterprise architect level. Strong understanding of enterprise AI platforms (e.g. Microsoft 365 Copilot) and assistant and agent-based tooling, and of GenAI / agent-based architectures; deep knowledge of platform vs. custom-development trade-offs and licensing models; experience defining operating models and governance standards.
* Governance & regulation: Proven experience defining and rolling out enterprise AI governance frameworks or platform-adoption strategies; familiarity with AI security controls and applicable regulation (EU AI Act, GDPR, responsible-AI guidance).
* Cloud & FinOps: Deep familiarity with cloud platforms (Microsoft ecosystem preferred); familiarity with chargeback or FinOps models, ideally applied to AI or cloud services; working knowledge of enterprise AI licensing and the ability to translate licensing constraints into platform and routing decisions.
* Education & certifications: University degree in IT, Computer Science, or a related field; Microsoft, AI, or cloud certifications preferred, with security and compliance certifications a plus.
* Soft skills: Strategic and structured thinking; clear, pragmatic communication, including the ability to translate technical standards for business users and citizen developers; sound decision-making in complex, ambiguous environments; comfort balancing innovation with control.
* Languages: Fluent English required; additional languages a plus.

What we offer you
  
  
Medical insurance for self and family
  
  
Company sponsored transportation facility
  
  
Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.
  
  
We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

.

title: Senior Change and Release Engineer
description:
**Title: Senior Change and Release Engineer**
**Job Level:**
4
  
  
**Location:**
Pune
  
  
**Summary:**
We are looking for an experienced Senior Change and Release Engineer to improve the safety, speed, and visibility of technology changes across Maersk. This role combines change engineering, operational governance, data analysis, and automation to reduce change-related incidents while enabling teams to deploy confidently and frequently. The successful candidate will work across CI/CD and traditional change environments, establish scalable risk controls, improve change and deployment visibility, and build automation and AI-assisted workflows that modernise change and release operations.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
**Change Engineering and Automation:**

* Champion the shift from manual, human-dependent deployments to automated, staged deployments
* Establish scalable, risk-based governance and engineering controls that improve deployment safety without creating unnecessary delivery friction
* Enable full visibility of every production change – including vendor-led and CI/CD deployments to support incident correlation, faster root-cause identification and audit readiness
* Own AI-enabled operational initiatives for change and release – pioneer, build and experiment with AI-driven workflows, and continuously explore how to advance the agentic way of doing change and release engineering

**Governance and Operational Performance:**

* Own the change and release KPIs end to end, driving sustained reduction of change-caused P1/P2 major incidents; analyse change failures and root-cause patterns and convert them into targeted preventive actions
* Surface compliance, trends and exceptions to leadership, keeping enforcement fair, transparent and non-punitive
* Enforce mandatory UAT/test evidence and validated, tested rollback plans for all major and critical changes before approval, with complete blast-radius and impact capture so the right level of scrutiny is applied to each change
* Run effective, right-sized Change Advisory Board (CAB) meetings that balance governance with speed of delivery

**Leadership and Continuous Improvement:**

* Lead and coach a small team of Change Managers, building a culture of ownership, accountability and delivery discipline
* Provide end-to-end, process-level ownership – maintaining process documentation, SOPs and quick-reference guidance, and periodically reviewing, upgrading and evolving the process wherever needed to keep it fit for purpose
* Produce crisp, outcome-driven reporting for senior leadership on change KPIs, adoption progress and governance health

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field with relevant industry certifications
* 10+ years of IT experience with proven expertise in IT change and release operations in a high-volume, high-impact production environment
* Hands-on experience governing changes across CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions), traditional releases and vendor-led changes
* Prior experience participating in or facilitating CAB forums, with exposure to channel-based and post-incident change restriction models
* Familiarity with DORA metrics (lead time, deployment frequency, change failure rate) and their application in assessing software delivery performance
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex change and incident data sets and derive actionable insights
* Practical exposure to enterprise ITSM platforms, modern automation approaches and AI-assisted change tooling
* Evidence of an automation mindset, using engineering-led approaches to streamline processes and improve operational efficiency
* Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills up to Tech Leadership level.
* Exposure to programming/scripting languages such as Python, Bash, or PowerShell for automation and data manipulation is desirable
* Prior experience in cloud environments (e.g. AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and containerisation technologies (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes) is highly desirable

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
The Senior Technical Architect is responsible for successfully designing and managing the successful delivery of complex Salesforce solutions for our customers. These technologies include—but are not necessarily limited to Salesforce products and APIs, Apex/Visualforce, Lightning, mobile development technologies, and integration/ETL technologies.
  
  
You are both a big picture thinker and in-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills when it comes to architecting a solution, including knowing how to leverage AI development tools like Claude and GitHub Copilot to optimize code quality and accelerate design cycles. * Understanding of systems architecture and ability to design scalable performance-driven solutions, including using AI platforms to evaluate architectural scaling and load limits

* Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL)

title: FOUNDING ENGINEER
description:
**Company Description**
Joy-N-Crew Vacations LLP designs immersive, transformative travel experiences with a strong focus on authentic cultural connection. Specializing in Japan, the team brings deep knowledge of the country’s history, culture, and landscapes, from Tokyo’s vibrant streets to Kyoto’s serene temples. The company works closely with passionate local guides who share their expertise and personal stories, helping travelers engage meaningfully with local communities. Carefully curated itineraries emphasize genuine cultural experiences, including interactions with local artists, participation in traditional rituals, and regional cuisine. Joy-N-Crew Vacations LLP aims to inspire travelers, broaden their perspectives, and foster lasting appreciation for Japanese culture.

**Role Description**
As a Founding Engineer at Joy-N-Crew Vacations LLP, you will design, build, and maintain the core technology platform that powers our travel-planning and customer experience tools. This full-time, on-site role is based in Pune City and involves close collaboration with founders, operations, and product teams to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions. Day-to-day, you will architect and implement scalable backend and frontend systems, integrate third-party services, optimize performance, and ensure high standards of reliability and security. You will establish engineering best practices, set up development workflows, and contribute to technical decision-making, including stack selection and roadmap planning. In addition, you will help shape the product vision, experiment with new features, and iterate quickly based on traveler and internal feedback.

**Qualifications**

* Strong software engineering skills in modern programming languages (e.g., JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, or similar) and experience with web application development.
* AI and programming language skills are a must.
* Experience with system architecture, databases (SQL/NoSQL), APIs, and integrating third-party services or travel technology platforms.
* Proficiency with frontend frameworks (e.g., React, Vue, or Angular) and responsive UI development for user-facing applications.
* Ability to set up and maintain development workflows, including version control (Git), CI/CD pipelines, testing strategies, and basic DevOps practices.
* Comfort with working in an early-stage environment, owning end-to-end features, and making pragmatic trade-offs between speed and quality.
* Strong problem-solving, analytical thinking, and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across non-technical teams.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Interest in travel and cultural experiences; familiarity with Japan or the travel industry is a plus.

title: EY - GDS Consulting - AI And DATA - Databricks Architect - Senior Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-Consulting - Data and Analytics – Senior Manager - Databricks Architect**
EY's Consulting Services is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional and technical capabilities and product knowledge. EY’s financial services practice provides integrated Consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, retail banks, investment banks, broker-dealers & asset management firms, and insurance firms from leading Fortune 500 Companies. Within EY’s Consulting Practice, Data and Analytics team solves big, complex issues and capitalize on opportunities to deliver better working outcomes that help expand and safeguard the businesses, now and in the future. This way we help create a compelling business case for embedding the right analytical practice at the heart of client’s decision-making.
  
  
**The opportunity**
Senior Data & AI Architect with 13+ years of experience in data engineering and data architecture, strong hands-on expertise in Databricks, Hadoop, Spark/PySpark, and cloud data platforms.
  
  
This role combines deep technical ownership of enterprise Lakehouse and data platform architecture with hands-on experience building Agentic AI and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions on Databricks. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable designing large-scale, production-grade data pipelines, architecting modern AI-driven solutions, and engaging directly with clients on strategic proposals and solution design.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Architect, design, and deliver scalable Data & AI solutions on the Databricks Lakehouse platform, covering ingestion, transformation, storage, governance, and consumption layers.
* Design and optimize large-scale distributed data processing pipelines using Hadoop, Apache Spark, and PySpark.
* Build reusable, production-grade Python frameworks and pipelines for batch and streaming data engineering workloads.
* Define and implement cloud data architecture on AWS and/or Azure, covering storage, IAM, networking, security, and monitoring, with native Databricks integration.
* Own end-to-end ETL/ELT design, data ingestion, transformation, orchestration, and data quality frameworks across the platform.
* Design dimensional data models (star/snowflake schemas, fact/dimension tables, SCD) to support analytical and reporting use cases.
* Design and build Agentic AI solutions on Databricks, including LLM integration, tool/function calling, agent workflows, guardrails, and enterprise data integration.
* Architect and implement RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) solutions using Databricks — document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector search, retrieval, grounding, and evaluation.
* Establish and enforce engineering best practices for Git-based version control, code reviews, and CI/CD across development, test, and production environments.
* Lead performance optimization and production deployment of Databricks jobs, workflows, and pipelines at scale.
* Participate in strategic RFP/RFI responses, technical proposals, solution shaping, effort estimation, and architecture presentations.
* Act as a trusted technical advisor in customer workshops, translating business requirements into robust technical architectures.
* Mentor engineering teams on Databricks, Spark, cloud architecture, and modern AI/RAG engineering practices.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
13+ years of experience in Data Engineering / Data Architecture, with strong hands-on experience across Databricks, Hadoop, Spark/PySpark, and cloud data platforms.
  
  

* Databricks

+ Strong expertise in Databricks Lakehouse, Delta Lake, Databricks SQL, and Unity Catalog.
+ Hands-on experience with Jobs/Workflows, performance optimization, and production deployments.

* Hadoop & Spark

+ Strong knowledge of the Hadoop ecosystem, HDFS, and Hive.
+ Strong hands-on experience with Apache Spark and PySpark for large-scale distributed data processi

* Python

+ Strong proficiency in Python for building scalable, reusable, production-grade data pipelines and frameworks.
+ Cloud
+ Strong experience with AWS and/or Azure, including cloud storage, IAM, networking, security, and monitoring.
+ Experience integrating Databricks with cloud-native services.

* Data Engineering

+ Expertise in ETL/ELT, batch and streaming processing, data ingestion, transformation, orchestration, and data quality.
+ Proven ability to design scalable, production-ready pipeline architectures.

* SQL & Data Modelling

+ Strong SQL skills, with experience in dimensional modelling, star/snowflake schemas, fact/dimension models, SCD, and analytical data models.

* Agentic AI

+ Hands-on experience designing and building Agentic AI solutions with Databricks, including LLMs, tool/function calling, agent workflows, guardrails, and enterprise data integration.

* RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)

+ Strong experience building RAG solutions using Databricks, including document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector search, retrieval, grounding, and evaluation.

* Git & CI/CD

+ Strong knowledge of Git, branching strategies, pull requests, and code reviews.
+ Experience with CI/CD pipelines and deployment across multiple environments.
+ Experience with Databricks Asset Bundles and/or Terraform is a plus.

* Strategic RFPs & Solutioning

+ Ability to participate in strategic RFP/RFI responses, solution shaping, technical proposals, and effort estimations.
+ Experience delivering architecture presentations and leading customer workshops.

* Client Communication
* Strong client-facing and communication skills, with the ability to understand business requirements, translate them into scalable technical solutions, and clearly communicate architectural decisions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Prior experience in a consulting, systems integrator, or client-facing delivery role.
* Relevant cloud or Databricks certifications (e.g., Databricks Certified Data Engineer / Solutions Architect, AWS/Azure certifications).
* Exposure to enterprise data governance, MLOps, or LLMOps practices.

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Architect, IT Solutions, Copilot & Agentic AI Platforms
description:
Edwards Lifesciences is expanding its global technology capabilities with the launch of a new IT Innovation Hub in Pune, India. The Hub strengthens the technology foundation that supports our business worldwide, working in close partnership with teams across regions to deliver reliable, high-quality solutions at scale. Designed as a long-term investment, the Pune Hub will advance newer digital capabilities such as automation, data, AI, and cloud, and will include roles spanning end user services, application development, and enterprise platform teams. Together, these teams will help Edwards operate more efficiently and accelerate innovation in support of our mission of advancing patient care.
  
  
As Edwards accelerates its AI-driven transformation, we are seeking an Architect, IT Solutions to serve as the enterprise technical authority for our two most strategic agentic AI platforms — Microsoft Copilot (M365 Copilot, Copilot Studio) and Moveworks. This is a multi-faceted architecture role that spans platform leadership, integration design, and end-to-end solution architecture. You will define how these platforms are built, extended, integrated, and governed across the enterprise.
  
  
This role works alongside our existing Azure infrastructure architect and complements cloud expertise with deep, platform-specific technical authority. If you thrive at the intersection of enterprise architecture, applied AI, and business-facing delivery — and want to shape how a global lifescience company adopts agentic AI at scale — this is the role for you.
  
  
**How you’ll make an impact:**
**Platform Architecture Leadership — Copilot & Moveworks**

* Own the enterprise platform architecture for Microsoft Copilot (M365 Copilot, Copilot Studio) and Moveworks — serving as the definitive technical authority on capabilities, extensibility, and best practices.
* Define the ecosystem blueprint, platform standards, extensibility patterns, and long-term technical roadmap for both platforms.
* Evaluate and recommend new platform features, plugins, connectors, and agentic AI capabilities as they emerge from Microsoft and Moveworks.

**Integration Architecture**

* Design and govern the integration layer connecting Copilot and Moveworks to enterprise systems such as ServiceNow, Workday, JDE, Active Directory, HRIS, LMS, and CMDB.
* Define API strategies, event-driven patterns, connector frameworks, and messaging standards that enable secure, reliable, and scalable data flows across platforms.
* Partner with the Azure architecture team to ensure integration patterns align with cloud infrastructure, identity (Entra ID), and security standards.

**Lead Solution Architecture**

* Provide end-to-end solution design and technical authority for all AI agent, copilot, and automation solutions built on these platforms.
* Lead architecture reviews, approve design decisions, and ensure solutions are production-ready, secure, and aligned with enterprise standards.
* Translate complex business requirements into scalable, repeatable architectural patterns and executable design strategies.

**Governance, Mentorship & Innovation**

* Develop, institute, and maintain platform-specific design methodologies, development standards, security patterns, and operational best practices.
* Provide training, coaching, and technical mentorship to Forward-Deployed Engineers (FDEs), solution developers, and IT team members on Copilot and Moveworks architecture.
* Survey emerging developments in agentic AI — including multi-agent orchestration, RAG patterns, and tool-using agents — and recommend approaches that extend platform value.
* Develop and maintain architecture models, reference designs, integration maps, and documentation for current and proposed implementations.

**What you’ll need (Required):**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Progressive IT experience, including significant depth in platform architecture, integration architecture, or solution architecture.
* Experience in an architect role working with cross-functional teams (within IT and/or business) on enterprise-level or complex system implementations.
* Deep expertise in at least one of the following: Microsoft Copilot ecosystem (M365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Graph API, Graph Connectors, Copilot extensibility) or Moveworks platform (conversational AI, enterprise integrations, workflow automation).
* Strong integration architecture skills: REST/GraphQL APIs, event-driven architectures, enterprise connectors, middleware, and messaging patterns (e.g., Azure Service Bus, Logic Apps, Power Automate).
* Proven ability to design end-to-end solution architectures for enterprise AI, automation, or digital workplace platforms.
* Experience defining platform standards, governance frameworks, and reusable architectural patterns at enterprise scale.
* Strong understanding of identity, security, and compliance requirements in enterprise AI deployments (e.g., Entra ID, conditional access, DLP, data classification).
* Expert-level documentation and communication skills — ability to create architecture blueprints, integration maps, and present complex technical concepts to senior leadership and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong interpersonal and leadership skills, including cross-functional negotiation, vendor management, and the ability to drive alignment across distributed teams.

**What else we look for (Preferred):**

* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio — building custom copilots, plugins, connectors, topics, and generative AI orchestration.
* Hands-on experience with Moveworks platform — configuring enterprise virtual agents, workflow automation, knowledge integration, and analytics.
* Experience with agentic AI patterns including multi-agent orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), tool-using agents, and planner-executor models.
* Experience integrating AI platforms with enterprise systems such as ServiceNow, Workday, SAP, Active Directory, LMS, and CMDB.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps) as an automation and extensibility layer.
* Experience deploying AI solutions in regulated industries (e.g., medical device, pharmaceuticals, financial services) with attention to governance and responsible AI practices.
* Advanced degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline.
* Professional certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Microsoft 365 Administrator Expert, TOGAF, or equivalent architecture frameworks.
* Track record of mentoring engineers and building technical communities of practice.

**Why is this role different?**
This is not a generic enterprise architect role. You will be the single technical authority for two of the most strategic AI platforms at Edwards Lifesciences — platforms that are actively transforming how our work, decide, and collaborate. You will shape the architecture, set the standards, and mentor the next generation of Forward-Deployed AI Engineers who build on these platforms every day.
  
  
You will operate at the intersection of platform strategy, hands-on architecture, and business impact — with direct visibility to senior IT leadership and the opportunity to influence how a global healthcare company scales agentic AI responsibly.

**Job Description**
**Senior Demo Platform Architect – Contact Center and Customer Experience**
**Position Overview:**
We are seeking a seasoned Senior Demo Platform Engineer with deep expertise in contact center technologies and CX suites, preferably Zendesk, Amazon Connect, and AWS. This role will own the development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of shared demo environments and reusable customer service use cases. The ideal candidate will combine hands-on technical expertise, strong operational ownership, and independent decision-making to ensure demo environments remain reliable, current, scalable, and ready to support both internal teams and occasional customer-facing engagements.
  
  
**Core Daily Activities**

* Own and Optimize Demo Environments – Maintain reliable, scalable, secure, and high-quality shared demo environments leveraging Amazon Connect, AWS, and Zendesk.
* Develop New Demo Use Cases – Design and build compelling, reusable demonstrations that showcase contact center, customer experience, AI, automation, analytics, and integration capabilities.
* Support Custom Demo Requests – Partner with presales specialists and architects to develop opportunity-specific configurations, integrations, workflows, and demonstrations.

* Platform Management: Experience maintaining shared technical environments, managing releases and configuration changes, troubleshooting complex issues, and proactively improving platform availability and reliability.
* Leadership Skills: Demonstrated ability to operate with ownership, take initiative, work independently, influence cross-functional teams, and manage multiple projects in a fast-paced and globally distributed environment.
* Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to document technical solutions, collaborate across time zones, and articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a track record of investigating root causes, making sound decisions with incomplete information, and developing scalable solutions to complex challenges.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Certifications: Zendesk certifications, AWS Certified Solutions Architect, or equivalent credentials in contact center platforms.

The role centers on our Java/Spring Boot enterprise stack, spanning REST services, event-driven microservices, integrations, and production operations. You'll work closely with US-based engineering and customer teams, with regular time zone overlap for collaboration and handoffs.
  
  
You'll also influence our product roadmap through direct customer feedback, identifying new use cases and technical challenges that shape Blitzy's evolution. High performers may have opportunities to visit our Cambridge, MA headquarters and transition into core product or platform engineering as we scale.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Embed with customer teams during critical implementations, partnering with engineering leaders on sprint planning, architecture reviews, technical decisions, and production deployments

* Develop custom solutions, reusable patterns, scripts, and tools that accelerate customer adoption and demonstrate Blitzy’s capabilities in enterprise environments
* Debug complex issues spanning customer infrastructure, integrations, microservices, and the Blitzy platform, supporting production operations, health checks, metrics, and configuration management
* Drive successful POCs and technical demonstrations that showcase advanced use cases, deliver measurable value, and expand into enterprise-wide deployments
* Maintain high standards for testing, code quality, performance, and observability using JUnit 5, Cucumber/Gherkin, JMeter, Git, Logback/SLF4J, SpotBugs, and SonarQube
* Identify recurring customer needs, technical patterns, and expansion opportunities that inform product priorities and enterprise adoption
* Collaborate with product and engineering teams to translate field experience into platform improvements, technical documentation, reusable best practices, and contributions to the core product

**Qualifications**

* 10+ years of software engineering experience with a track record of shipping production code in enterprise environments
* Deep hands-on expertise with Java 17, Spring Boot 3.x, Spring MVC, Spring Data JPA, Spring Security, Hibernate/JPA, and Actuator
* Strong experience with REST APIs, OpenAPI/Swagger, PostgreSQL, Liquibase, Maven, Docker, and modern testing practices including JUnit 5, Cucumber/Gherkin, and JMeter
* Experience building and operating microservices with CI/CD, cloud architecture, observability, production monitoring, and tools such as Micrometer, Dynatrace, SpotBugs, and SonarQube
* Knowledge of enterprise modernization and distributed systems, including Java 8 → Java 17 upgrades, monolith → microservices migrations, Kafka, Avro, Schema Registry, caching, and resilience patterns
* Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum and modern software development practices, with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts to audiences ranging from interns to CTOs
* Experience in customer-facing engineering, developer tools, AI/ML, or enterprise modernization is a plus, along with technical thought leadership through blogs, talks, or open-source contributions
* Passion for AI-powered software development and willingness to work in person from Pune, India, with overlap for US-based teams

*Blitzy is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We believe different perspectives make us stronger. Base salary ranges are determined by country, role, level, experience, and skills. The range displayed on each job posting reflects Blitzy’s good faith determination of the minimum and maximum targets for new hire salaries across all locations. title: Technology and Innovation - Data Engineering Manager
description:
**Data Engineering Manager**
Riveron is seeking a hands-on Data Engineering Manager to be part of our data engineering team in India. This is not a pure people-management role — you will be writing code, building pipelines, and architecting data platforms daily alongside your team. We're looking for someone who leads from the codebase, not just from a conference room. If you bring deep implementation experience across Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, and Databricks and can pair strong architectural thinking with real delivery output, we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
**Who You Are**

* A data engineering professional with 7-9 years of experience, including 1-3 years balancing technical leadership with active, hands-on implementation — you've managed teams without stepping away from the keyboard.
* You write production-quality code daily. This role requires active coding and pipeline development — not just code reviews and architectural diagrams.
* Hands-on, implementation-level expertise with Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, and Databricks is non-negotiable. You've personally built, deployed, and tuned production workloads on these platforms.
* Strong data architecture background spanning lakehouse design, medallion architecture, data vault, dimensional modeling, and enterprise data platform design — grounded in systems you've actually built, not just designed on paper.
* Deep proficiency in SQL and Python — you can write complex transformations, optimize query performance, debug pipeline failures, and build automation frameworks yourself.
* Proven experience building and shipping ETL/ELT frameworks using Azure Data Factory, dbt, Spark, and platform-native orchestration tools.
* Solid working knowledge of Azure cloud data services (Synapse Analytics, Data Lake Storage, Azure SQL Database) and comfort operating in multi-cloud environments.
* Well-versed in data governance, data quality frameworks, cataloging, lineage, and security best practices — with experience implementing these controls, not just defining policies.
* Proficient with Git-based version control, CI/CD pipelines for data workloads, and Infrastructure as Code — you commit code, open pull requests, and maintain deployment pipelines alongside your team.
* Comfortable working in Agile delivery environments and translating business requirements into scalable technical designs.

**What You'll Do**

* Spend a significant portion of your time writing code — building data pipelines, developing transformation logic, configuring platform services, and shipping production-ready solutions.
* Lead, mentor, and grow a team of data engineers while remaining the team's strongest technical contributor and setting the standard through your own code and architectural decisions.
* Design and personally implement scalable data platforms on Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, and Databricks — selecting the right platform for each use case and building the solution end to end.
* Architect and build lakehouse and data warehouse solutions, defining and coding ingestion patterns, transformation layers, storage strategies, and consumption models.
* Own critical and complex implementation work — the toughest pipeline builds, the most challenging performance problems, and the architectural spikes that set direction for the team.
* Write and maintain shared libraries, frameworks, and reusable components that accelerate the team's delivery and enforce engineering standards.
* Conduct deep, line-level code reviews focused on correctness, performance, and maintainability — not just approval stamps.
* Partner with analytics, data science, and business stakeholders to translate data requirements into engineered solutions and personally prototype key components.
* Establish and enforce best practices for data modeling, pipeline reliability, observability, testing, and documentation — by building the reference implementations yourself.
* Optimize platform performance and manage costs across Snowflake compute, Databricks clusters, and Fabric capacities through hands-on tuning and configuration.
* Implement data governance and security controls across engineering initiatives, ensuring compliance, data quality, and lineage traceability at the code and platform level.
* Stay current with the evolving data platform landscape and evaluate emerging tools through hands-on proof-of-concept work, not just vendor demos.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* A career path that shows sustained, hands-on implementation even as responsibilities grew — architect-turned-manager, not analyst-turned-manager.
* Hands-on experience building medallion-architecture lakehouses on Databricks or Microsoft Fabric, and designing and tuning performant Snowflake warehouse structures.
* Experience implementing CI/CD for data pipelines using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, including writing the pipeline definitions and deployment scripts yourself.
* Familiarity with dbt for transformation orchestration, with personal experience writing and maintaining dbt models and tests.
* Exposure to real-time or near-real-time data ingestion patterns (Kafka, Event Hubs, Spark Structured Streaming) through direct implementation.
* Experience with data mesh or domain-oriented data platform strategies is a strong plus.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to articulate architectural trade-offs to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Excellent stakeholder management skills, with experience running sprint planning, design reviews, and cross-functional delivery coordination.

**About Riveron**
At Riveron, we partner with clients—from global multinationals to high-growth private entities—to solve complex finance challenges, guided by our DELTA values: Drive, Excellence, Leadership, Teamwork, and Accountability. Our entrepreneurial culture thrives on collaboration, diverse perspectives, and delivering exceptional outcomes. We are committed to fostering growth, both for our clients and our people, through mentorship, integrity, and a client-centric approach. This inclusive environment offers flexibility, progressive benefits, and meaningful opportunities for impactful work that supports well-being in and out of the office.

title: Engineering Manager-NetSuite
description:
**About MISUMI Americas**
MISUMI Americas, a division of MISUMI Group, is a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions. By integrating a vast catalog of components with a world-class digital manufacturing platform, MISUMI Americas empowers engineers and procurement teams to accelerate innovation across the entire product lifecycle. With operations in the San Francisco Bay Area and Chicago, the company serves as a vital partner for the most innovative companies in the Americas.
  
  
What’s in it for you?
  
  
**Opportunity To Unlock Your Creativity**
Think of all the times you were held back from trying new ideas because you were boxed in by bureaucratic legacy processes or old school tactics. Having a growth mindset is deeply ingrained into our company culture since day 1 so Fictiv is an environment where you have the creative liberty and support of the team to try big bold ideas to achieve our sales and customer goals.
  
  
**Opportunity To Grow Your Career**
There are plenty of jobs out there. The question is whether any of them will help you grow in your career? Will you be challenged by teammates to achieve your potential? Or are they roles that will ask you to do more of what you've already mastered. At Fictiv, you'll be surrounded by supportive teammates who will push you to be your best through their curiosity and passion.
  
  
Impact In This Role
  
  
Fictiv is seeking a hands-on, deeply technical Engineering Manager to lead our NetSuite team. This is not a purely people-management role. The right candidate thrives at the intersection of engineering leadership and technical craft — someone who can jump into the code to debug a complex issue, write a detailed technical design document, and then step back to coach an engineer on how to approach the problem differently.
  
  
Our NetSuite environment supports a complex, multi-subsidiary OneWorld deployment spanning multiple regions globally, serving a make-to-order custom manufacturing operation across multiple industries. The Engineering Manager will set the technical bar for the team, drive architectural decisions, and build the processes and practices that allow the engineering team to deliver at high quality and velocity.
  
  
This role reports to the Sr Director of Engineering, IT Systems.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**
**Hands-On Technical Leadership**

* Actively participate in technical work alongside the team — reviewing, and debugging code as needed to unblock engineers, validate approaches, or accelerate critical deliveries.
* Author and own technical design documents (TDDs) for significant platform changes, new integrations, and architectural decisions, covering solution design, data flow, error handling, performance considerations, and trade-offs.
* Lead architecture reviews for new features, customizations, and integrations, ensuring decisions are scalable, maintainable, and aligned with NetSuite best practices.
* Conduct thorough, constructive code reviews — holding the team to a high and consistent engineering standard.
* Set standards for development and customization work, including guidelines for SuiteScript patterns, SuiteFlow design, custom record architecture, and integration approaches.
* Review and provide technical direction on team deliverables.
* Maintain a deep, current understanding of NetSuite capabilities and stay informed on upcoming release changes that may impact the business.
* Lead technical evaluation of new NetSuite modules, third-party tools, and integration platforms, producing structured analysis comparing options on capability, cost, risk, and architectural fit.
* Drive proactive identification and remediation of technical debt, performance bottlenecks, and architectural risks before they affect business operations.

**Development & Deployment Practices**

* Own and continuously improve the team's software development lifecycle, from requirements intake through design, development, testing, deployment, and post-release monitoring.
* Mature the team's CI/CD pipeline built on SuiteCloud Development Framework (SDF) and GitHub Actions, improving reliability, test coverage, deployment speed, and rollback capability across QA, Staging, and Production environments.
* Build efficient, repeatable engineering workflows that reduce manual work, minimize deployment risk, and enable the team to ship with confidence.
* Establish clear incident response practices for production issues, including on-call expectations, severity classification, root cause analysis, and post-mortem documentation.
* Champion the use of tooling, automation, and documentation to reduce knowledge silos and accelerate onboarding of new team members.

**Project Management**

* Manage the engineering team's project portfolio, balancing implementation work, enhancements, integrations, and technical debt reduction.
* Lead project planning and estimation for initiatives, working with stakeholders to define scope, timelines, deliverables, and success criteria.
* Coordinate dependencies across concurrent projects and ensure resources are appropriately allocated to meet commitments.
* Partner with business stakeholders and the Director of Engineering to prioritize work, communicate progress, manage scope changes, and escalate risks.
* Own delivery accountability for projects, tracking progress against milestones and ensuring the team ships on schedule with quality.
* Conduct project retrospectives to identify lessons learned and continuously improve the team's delivery practices.

**Cross-Functional Stakeholder Alignment**

* Own the technical architecture of NetSuite across all subsidiaries, ensuring the system is structured to support complex manufacturing workflows including multi-vendor BOMs, intercompany fulfillment, transfer order processing, and landed cost management.
* Serve as the engineering point of contact for business stakeholders across Finance, Operations, Supply Chain, Logistics, and Quality functions.
* Translate complex business requirements into clearly scoped technical solutions, and communicate technical constraints and trade-offs back to stakeholders in accessible terms.
* Partner with regional operations leads across multiple geographies to understand localized system requirements and ensure solutions work across all subsidiaries.
* Collaborate with executive leadership to communicate system health, roadmap progress, and technology investment decisions.
* Act as the engineering escalation point for critical system issues, coordinating resolution across the team, NetSuite support, and business stakeholders.

**People Leadership & Team Development**

* Lead, mentor, and grow the NetSuite engineering team, building individual capability while raising the collective technical bar.
* Actively participate in hiring for technical depth and team fit, structured onboarding, performance management, career development planning.
* Conduct meaningful 1:1s, provide regular and specific feedback, and create growth paths for engineers to develop expertise across NetSuite administration, scripting, and integration development.
* Run knowledge transfer sessions, technical workshops, and internal documentation efforts to ensure knowledge is distributed across the team.
* Foster a culture of engineering excellence, continuous learning, and shared ownership of quality.

Desired Traits
  
  

* 12+ years of experience working in NetSuite, with at least 3 years in a formal engineering management or senior technical lead role responsible for a team.
* In-depth knowledge of NetSuite modules such as GL, Order to Cash, Inventory, AP, AR, Billing, Purchasing, Revenue Recognition, Asset Management
* Deep expertise in NetSuite OneWorld including multi-subsidiary setup, intercompany framework, global financial consolidation, and cross-subsidiary order fulfillment.
* Strong understanding of business processes like Engineering Change Orders, Transfer Order Processing
* Proficiency in NetSuite configuration, customization, and scripting
* Knowledge of system integrations and data migration.
* Familiarity with PLM systems like Arena
* Proven ability to write production-quality code and review complex scripts with a critical eye for performance, maintainability, and correctness.
* Experience authoring technical design documents and leading architecture reviews for significant NetSuite customizations, integrations, or module implementations.
* Familiarity with middleware and integration platforms used to connect NetSuite with external systems such as PLM, Salesforce
* NetSuite certifications such as SuiteFoundation, Administrator, or other relevant certifications, are preferred.
* Ability to work independently, handle multiple tasks, and adapt to changing priorities.
* Familiarity with Agile Software Development, Jira, Git
* Demonstrated track record of improving team development and deployment practices — including testing discipline, code review culture, and release management.
* Experience managing and growing engineering teams.
* Strong cross-functional communication skills, including the ability to present architectural decisions and technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders and executive leadership.

**Interested in learning more? We look forward to hearing from you soon.**
We’re actively seeking teammates who:
  
  

* Bring diverse perspectives and experience to our culture and company.
* Excel at being part of a strong, empathetic team.
* Thrive in an environment emphasizing respect, honesty, collaboration, and growth.
* Have an ‘always learning’ mindset that celebrates learning, not just wins.
* Help us continue to build a world-class organization that values the contributions of all of our teammates

We encourage applications from members of underrepresented groups, including but not limited to women, members of the LGBTQ community, people of color, people with disabilities, and veterans.

**Description**
We’re building the identity and access layer that every service in our SaaS control plane depends on. You’ll own the common auth stack — making sure the right principals get the right access, consistently, across every tenant and product surface.
  
  
**Requirements**
You should have
  
  
– 5+ years building auth systems in production SaaS environments.
  
  
– Strong Go or Python (ideally both); comfortable writing performant, well-tested service code in either.
  
  
– Deep knowledge of OAuth 2.0, OIDC, JWT, and SAML — not just using libraries but understanding what’s happening underneath.
  
  
– Experience with authorization policy engines (OPA, Casbin, or equivalent) and modeling complex permission structures.
  
  
– Familiarity with multi-tenant isolation patterns and the security implications of getting them wrong.
  
  
– Comfort in an AWS/EKS environment with secrets management (AWS Secrets Manager, Vault).
  
  
Nice to have: SCIM provisioning, FIDO2/WebAuthn, zero-trust networking, SOC 2 audit experience, or prior work on a shared platform team serving internal consumers.
  
  
Job responsibilities
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  
– Design and operate the centralized authn/authz platform: token issuance and validation (OIDC/JWT), OAuth 2.0 flows, API key management, and service-to-service identity.
  
  
– Build and maintain the authorization model: RBAC and ABAC policies, tenant isolation enforcement, and fine-grained permission evaluation (Open Policy Agent or similar).
  
  
– Expose auth as a shared internal service consumed by the rest of the control plane — clean APIs, well-documented contracts, and minimal coupling.
  
  
– Partner with product and platform teams to implement SSO integrations (SAML, SCIM) and onboard enterprise identity providers.
  
  
– Harden the auth layer: token rotation, secret management, audit logging, and threat modeling against common identity attacks.
  
  
– Drive adoption of consistent auth patterns across services, replacing one-off implementations.
  
  
What we offer
  
  
**Exciting Projects:**
We focus on industries like High-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.

**Professional Development:**
Our dedicated Learning & Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.

description:
