title: Technical Lead
description:
**About Ascendion**
 Ascendion is a leader in AI\-Native platform driven software engineering company that underwrites outcomes, helping businesses innovate faster, smarter, and with greater impact. We partner with Global 2000 clients across North America, UK, Europe, and APAC to solve complex challenges in data, experience design, software product engineering, and workforce transformation. Powered by expert engineers, thousands of AI agents, and our Engineering to the Power of AI™ (EngineeringAI) method, we deliver measurable outcomes that build trust, unlock value, and accelerate growth. Learn more at ascendion.com
   

  

 Ascendion \| Engineering to elevate life
   

  

 We have a culture built on opportunity, inclusion, and a spirit of partnership. Come, change the world with us:
   

  

* Build the coolest tech for world's leading brands
* Solve complex problems – and learn new skills
* Experience the power of transforming digital engineering for Fortune 500 clients
* Master your craft with leading training programs and hands\-on experience


 Experience a community of change makers! Join a culture of high\-performing innovators with endless ideas and a passion for tech. Our culture is the fabric of our company, and it is what makes us unique and diverse. The way we share ideas, learning, experiences, successes, and joy allows everyone to be their best at Ascendion.
   

  

**About The Role**
 A hands\-on player\-coach. You write production code daily — designing ports, building adapters, reviewing every PR — and you own the architecture, set engineering standards, break the roadmap into work for three developers, and represent the team technically to Roche stakeholders. This is not a purely managerial or purely architectural seat: roughly 60% hands\-on engineering, 40% technical leadership.
   

  

 Job Title: Technical Lead
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* 8\+ years in software / data engineering, including 2\+ years in a technical lead, staff, or architect capacity with direct responsibility for other engineers' output.
* Expert Python for production systems: OOP and abstract base classes, type hints, packaging, dependency management; comfortable authoring a library others build on.
* Proven software architecture experience with clean / hexagonal (ports \& adapters) architecture, dependency injection, and interface\-driven design — demonstrable on real systems, not just theory.
* Snowflake — hands\-on production experience (databases/schemas, roles/warehouses, cloning, access model).
* AWS — hands\-on production experience building and operating services on AWS.
* CI/CD with GitLab (or equivalent) — designing pipelines that build, test, and deploy.
* Infrastructure as Code with Terraform — authored and maintained real infrastructure.
* Secure secret management — hands\-on experience keeping credentials/secrets out of code, logs, and state and sourcing them from a secrets backend (e.g. HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager / Parameter Store).
* Concept\-level mastery (can explain how they work and design for them, independent of any specific vendor tool) of: data governance, data warehousing, data transformation, and data ingestion/ETL.
* Strong SQL (to design and validate backend/migration adapters — not for production data work).
* Professional working English and the communication skills to lead a distributed team and brief non\-engineering stakeholders.
* Orchestrators beyond CI: Airflow / Dagster.


**Minimum Qualifications**
**Experience:** 
 8\+ years in software/data engineering, including 2\+ years in a tech lead, staff, or architect role managing others.
   

  

**Tech Stack:** 
 Expert Python, strong SQL, AWS, Snowflake, Terraform, GitLab CI/CD, Airflow/Dagster, and secure secret management.
   

  

**Architecture \& Skills:** 
 Proven hexagonal/clean architecture experience, strong data domain mastery, and fluent English communication for leadership.
   

  

 Location: Pune
   

  

 Want to change the world? Let us know. Tell us about your experiences, education, and ambitions. Bring your knowledge, unique viewpoint, and creativity to the table. Let's talk!

title: Staff Engineer – Customer Engineering
description:
Staff Engineer – Customer Engineering (Data \& AI Security Platforms)
 



**Location:** 
 Pune, India · Hybrid
 



**Reports to:** 
 Field CTO \& Head of Customer Experience · Engineering Ladder, calibrated with Engineering
 



 Role Summary
 



 Trust3 AI builds software that large enterprises use to control who can reach which data — across Databricks, Snowflake, AWS Lake Formation, BigQuery, Trino and more. It runs in production inside some of the world's largest banks, insurers, retailers and healthcare companies.
 



 We are creating Customer Engineering, and you will be the first engineer in it. You will own a defined piece of that platform end to end — the connectors and integrations our enterprise customers run, the tooling around them, and everything it takes to make them fast, reliable and easy to operate.
 



 Design, build, ship, run, fix, improve, with no handoffs. Two engineers will join you to deliver it; the accountability stays yours.
 



 Real workloads and real telemetry mean you never have to guess what to improve. Your job is to take software that works today and make it excellent — quicker to deploy, harder to break, cheaper to run.
 



 We build with AI: coding assistants and agents are part of the daily toolchain here, and we expect them to show up in what you ship.
 



 What You'll Own
 


* The connectors and integrations customers run — quality, performance, release validation, security posture. If something is wrong with them it is yours, and so is the decision about how to fix it.
* Delivery speed. Customer\-driven fixes and features shipped in weeks rather than release cycles, and custom connectors and integrations built to customer timelines.
* The hard problems. Connector failures, policy\-sync faults, performance collapse, upgrade breakage — deep debugging, root cause, permanent fix.
* Deployment and operations. Install, upgrade and rollback automation across self\-managed, SaaS and air\-gapped estates; telemetry, alerting and dashboards covering connector health, performance and CVE exposure.
* Proving it works, and works at scale. Functional and scalability testing of what you own is yours, not someone else's gate to pass — the suites, the load profiles that reflect real customer volumes, and the evidence that a release is safe to ship.
* Scale, efficiency and toil. JVM and connector profiling, throughput and resource envelopes at enterprise identity and policy volumes — and engineering away the procedures we repeat across customers, through self\-healing behaviour rather than better runbooks.
* The technical call, and the team. What gets fixed, engineered away, declined or raised to Platform Engineering is your call; that boundary is agreed at leadership level, not renegotiated ticket by ticket. You will hire and technically lead a connector engineer and a DevOps engineer.



 The Engineering Bar
 



 Working software is the starting point, not the finish line. We want an engineer whose services are:
 


* **Deployable** 
 — installs, upgrades and rolls back cleanly, without a runbook only the author can follow
* **Scalable** 
 — holds at enterprise volumes and degrades predictably rather than falling over
* **Lightweight** 
 — a modest footprint and resource envelopes that match the work being done, not the worst case someone once hit
* **Enterprise\-ready** 
 — hardened images, current dependencies, a clean CVE posture, and the evidence a customer's security team will ask for
* **Provably correct** 
 — behaviour pinned down by tests you wrote, verified at customer\-scale volumes before a customer finds the limit
* **Supportable** 
 — diagnosable from logs and metrics by someone who did not write it
* **Self\-healing** 
 — any manual procedure we run twice is a defect: the second time it should be automated, the third time it should not be possible



 Platform reliability is the customer's experience of us. The measure of this role is not how fast you perform an operational task, but how quickly you make it unnecessary.
 



 Skills Required
 



 Real depth in the core, and the credibility to pick up the rest. Nobody has all of this.
 



**Core:** 



* Java and Spring at depth
* Microservices design and the reality of operating them
* Kubernetes and Helm in production
* Prometheus and Grafana
* JVM debugging — heap and thread analysis, GC behaviour, connection handling under load
* Linux
* Python or Bash



**Data platforms, depth in at least one:** 



* Databricks (Unity Catalog or SQL warehouses)
* Snowflake
* AWS Lake Formation
* BigQuery
* Trino/Presto
* Spark
* Or comparable



**Cloud, production depth in at least one:** 



* AWS, Azure or GCP
* IAM
* Networking
* Managed Kubernetes



**Testing:** 



* Functional, integration and load testing you build and own
* Test automation in CI

title: Engineer II - Cloud
description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI\-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission\-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI\-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.
   

  

****About The Role:****
 We're hiring a Software Engineer to design, develop, and maintain SOAR connectors that integrate third\-party security platforms with Falcon Fusion, and build/maintain platform services that provide core orchestration and workflow capabilities to all users of CrowdStrike's flagship Falcon Platform.
   

  

 Falcon Fusion – a core 'tier one' offering in our Flagship Platform, Falcon – is used by customers to automate breach remediations within their environments. It also serves as the runtime for apps built by our Foundry Module and is 'dogfooded' internally to automate workflows and accelerate development. Processing anywhere from 500M to 10B\+ events per day, it is utilized by essentially every customer of the Falcon Platform.
   

  

 This role is for an experienced backend microservices developer adept with cloud engineering principles. Your passion and meticulous attention to performance, reliability, and scalability will be key ingredients to your success at CrowdStrike.
   

  

****What You'll Do:****
* Develop production\-grade SOAR connectors that integrate security platforms (SIEM, EDR, ticketing, IAM) with Falcon Fusion at scale, and contribute to the platform services that power connector execution, authentication, and orchestration.
* You'll work on connectors from design through deployment and production support, with guidance from senior team members on architecture and complex integration decisions, while contributing to platform capabilities (auth systems, testing frameworks, deployment pipelines) that all connectors depend on.
* Research and integrate new security platforms and APIs to expand our connector portfolio
* Develop connectors and contribute to platform services, working with authentication mechanisms (OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, API keys) at both the connector and platform layer.

title: Senior Data Platform Engineer - Vice President
description:
**Job Description**
 Fixed Income (FI) is the primary source of capital for corporations, governments, and nonprofits, providing liquidity and innovative solutions globally across the credit, municipal, and securitized markets. The
 **Fixed Income Data Platform Team** 
 is the foundational pillar of this mission, engineered to provide the low latency, high concurrency, scalability, and unparalleled availability required for our groundbreaking solutions. Our Data Platform Engineering team operates at the forefront of innovation, constantly researching, adapting, and strategically deploying the latest open\-source data platforms to meet Citi's unique and evolving needs. We are a collaborative, high\-performing group dedicated to solving complex technical challenges and building highly performant, resilient systems.
   

  

 We are seeking a
 **Vice President, Lead Data Platform Engineer** 
 to provide deep technical expertise, hands\-on contribution, and direct coaching to our talented engineering team. This role is pivotal in driving the technical design, development, and implementation of Citi's next\-generation data platform, with a critical focus on
 **architecting complex streaming solutions, robust data pipeline architectures, and scalable microservices** 
 . This platform empowers quantitative scientists and traders to rapidly iterate on and deploy cutting\-edge analytical and trading tools. We are looking for a polyglot expert who can directly contribute across diverse technology stacks, guide technical direction, and elevate the skills of junior engineers through direct technical leadership.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Hands\-on Technical Leadership \& Coaching: Provide technical leadership through direct code contribution, architecture review, and hands\-on guidance to junior and mid\-level data engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence and continuous learning across polyglot environments.
* Drive \& Implement Architecture \& Design: Directly contribute to and drive the technical design and hands\-on development of highly scalable, low\-latency, fault\-tolerant data pipelines, real\-time streaming platforms (e.g., Flink), and microservices architectures.
* Platform Infrastructure \& Operations Deep Dive: Actively participate in the strategic planning, setup, enhancement, migration, and operational excellence of critical platform infrastructure, including distributed streaming (Flink) and high\-performance caching solutions (Redis).
* Open Source \& Emerging Technologies Evaluation: Continuously research, evaluate, and prototype emerging open\-source data and streaming technologies, leading their integration into Citi's data platform through direct implementation. This includes evaluating new streaming frameworks and caching solutions.
* Performance \& Resilience Optimization: Proactively identify and implement architectural and systemic performance optimizations to ensure optimal efficiency, responsiveness, and resilience across the entire data platform, including Flink and Redis clusters.
* Cross\-Functional Technical Collaboration: Collaborate closely with senior technical stakeholders across engineering, data science, and business teams to translate complex technical requirements into robust, high\-impact implementations.
* Delivery \& Code Quality Assurance: Drive the timely, high\-quality, and secure delivery of data platform features, championing agile methodologies, engineering best practices, and ensuring accountability for code quality and robust testing.
* Technical Problem Solving: Act as a primary escalation point for complex technical challenges, providing expert diagnosis and hands\-on resolution.
* Operational Flexibility: May occasionally work a non\-standard shift including nights and/or weekends and/or have on\-call responsibilities to support critical platform operations.


**Qualifications:**
* 10\+ years of demonstrable and highly hands\-on experience in software development, with at least 3\-5 years in a lead technical contributor or staff engineer role within a data\-intensive environment.
* Deep Architectural \& Implementation Expertise: Proven expertise in designing, building, and implementing Microservices and complex streaming/data pipeline architectures.
* Polyglot Proficiency \& Technical Authority: Demonstrated ability to be a technical authority and actively contribute across multiple programming languages/frameworks, with strong hands\-on experience in Java (Java 11\+ preferred), and significant expertise in Python, along with practical knowledge of front\-end technologies like Angular/React.
* Expertise in Flink Ecosystem: In\-depth architectural understanding and hands\-on experience with Apache Flink for real\-time stream processing, including Flink SQL, DataStream API, and state management. Comprehensive knowledge of Flink infrastructure setup, maintenance, enhancement, migration strategies, and experience in evaluating/integrating alternative streaming frameworks.
* Mastery of Redis: In\-depth knowledge and practical experience with Redis, encompassing not only data structures, caching patterns, and pub/sub mechanisms but also strategic expertise in Redis cluster setup, maintenance, enhancement, and migration strategies for mission\-critical, high\-performance applications.
* Distributed Systems \& Data Engineering: Deep understanding of distributed systems concepts and extensive hands\-on experience with data distribution platforms like Apache Kafka, and various big data storage/querying systems (e.g., Trino, Pinot, Druid, Ignite) for low\-latency access in large\-scale, distributed data pipelines.
* Cloud\-Native \& DevOps Contribution: Proven experience with the design, implementation, and operational aspects of cloud\-native applications and deployment via Kubernetes / OpenShift / ECS, specifically for managing microservices, streaming, and data services.
* Technical Leadership, Coaching \& Communication: Exceptional ability to provide technical direction, coach junior engineers through hands\-on collaboration, and articulate complex technical concepts clearly to diverse audiences.
* Advanced Problem Solving \& Strategic Technical Thinking: Excellent problem\-solving skills, a data\-driven approach to technical decision\-making, and the ability to define and execute long\-term technical strategies through direct implementation.
* Experience with Large Language Models (LLMs), including fine\-tuning, prompt engineering, and integrating LLMs into applications, is a plus.


**Software Engineering Excellence:**
* Demonstrable experience driving and implementing CI/CD strategies for rapid, reliable, and secure deployment of microservices and streaming components. Familiarity with TeamCity, SonarQube, and Jenkins.
* Expertise in the SDLC lifecycle within an Agile environment, adapting to fast\-paced data requirements and directly contributing to continuous process improvement.
* A champion of engineering best practices: architectural patterns, coding standards, rigorous code review, and robust unit/integration testing across diverse technologies.
* Strong experience with standard CI tools (Jenkins, TeamCity, SonarQube, Git).

title: Senior Manager, Software Engineering
description:
**About Kaseya**
 Kaseya is the leading provider of AI\-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long\-term business success.
   

  

 Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double\-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide.
   

  

 Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders \- and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe.
   

  

 We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better \- a product, a process, a career \- you'll fit right in.
   

  

 At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 Kaseya is seeking a Senior Manager, Software Engineering to lead engineering execution for complex enterprise software platforms. This role is responsible for managing software engineering teams, supporting technical strategy, improving delivery processes, and ensuring successful execution of product roadmap initiatives. The ideal candidate is an experienced engineering manager with a strong software development background, solid SaaS and distributed systems knowledge, and a proven ability to lead teams that deliver secure, scalable, and reliable software.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead and manage teams of software engineers and technical leads responsible for delivering enterprise software products and platform capabilities.
* Support the architecture, design, and delivery of secure, scalable, and high\-performing software across cloud\-hosted, data centre\-hosted, and hybrid environments.
* Partner with senior engineering leadership, product management, and cross\-functional stakeholders to execute product roadmaps, technical requirements, delivery schedules, and engineering priorities.
* Drive engineering process improvements across agile delivery, quality practices, DevOps, CI/CD, test automation, deployment automation, and operational readiness.
* Mentor and develop engineers and technical leads, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, urgency, continuous improvement, and engineering excellence.
* Collaborate with QA, UX/UI, operations, support, sales, marketing, HR, Talent, and other teams to support successful delivery and alignment with business goals.
* Participate in architecture reviews, design reviews, code reviews, and technical planning to ensure solutions meet standards for security, reliability, scalability, and maintainability.
* Communicate project status, risks, dependencies, technical trade\-offs, and recommendations clearly to engineering leadership and business stakeholders.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* 6\+ years of software engineering experience, including experience with SaaS platforms, distributed systems, cloud\-based services, or similar complex software environments.
* 3\+ years of experience managing software engineering teams, including coaching, mentoring, performance management, and delivery accountability.
* Hands\-on experience with modern software development practices, including agile methodologies, DevOps, continuous integration, automated testing, and deployment automation.
* Strong technical foundation with experience supporting architecture discussions, design reviews, code reviews, application security, scalability, reliability, and operational quality.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience delivering enterprise SaaS products, platform services, business applications, or other large\-scale commercial software solutions.
* Experience with C\# and the .Net ecosystem
* Ability to understand deeply interconnected systems from a system architecture view
* Demonstrated ability to translate product priorities into engineering execution plans and guide teams through successful delivery.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience partnering with product, QA, UX/UI, operations, support, sales, marketing, and business stakeholders.
* Proven ability to develop engineering talent, support hiring efforts, and build strong team culture in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong problem\-solving, prioritization, decision\-making, and execution skills, with the ability to balance technical quality, delivery commitments, and business needs.


**Additional Information**
*Kaseya provides equal employment opportunity to all employees and applicants without regard to race, religion, age, ancestry, gender, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.*

description:
**About Tripstack \-** 
 Founded in Toronto, Canada in 2016, Tripstack has been part of Etraveli Group since 2019\. It is a B2B Flights as a Service provider and a world leader in virtual interlining. Operating from offices in Canada, India, and Poland, Tripstack is the gateway into Etraveli Group’s world leading tech platform \- giving partners access to global flight content, virtual interlining, and a full suite of services including payments, fraud prevention, pricing, and customer support. As a world leader in virtual interlining technology, Tripstack connects non\-partner, low\-cost and full\-service carriers, enabling the creation of unique and flexible itineraries through a simple, cost\-effective API. Its technology ingest over 30B price points and handles over 240 million searches daily. Through partnerships with airlines, OTAs, and other distribution channels across the globe, Tripstack expands networks, drives new revenue streams, and offers more choice at competitive prices, all backed by robust technology and traveler protection. For more information, visit: www.tripstack.com ,www.etraveligroup.com
   

  

**Role Overview :** 
 As a Technical Lead on the Content team, you will architect software that ensures people can find the best flight combinations, as well as making Tripstack's software solid and scalable. A successful candidate will thrive in and help lead fast\-paced environments that leverage agile planning techniques, encourage and reward creative design and intelligent risk taking, and find innovative ways to leverage cutting\-edge technology. You will lead a high\-performing team to ensure our systems are scalable and low\-latency. You will drive the technical roadmap, mentor senior engineers, and balance innovative feature development with technical debt management.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Ensure high\-quality delivery by owning the development from ideation, planning, design, implementation, and quality assurance to post\-production monitoring.
* Ensure the team's technical decisions are consistently correct, and revisit them when the context changes.
* Unblock the team on technical ambiguity by resolving it quickly and directly.
* Strategize and support the team in unblocking itself using existing company resources and cross team collaboration.
* Author and approve code and designs that rarely require architectural rework after release.
* Ensure the team's solutions follow code guidelines and apply secure and defensive coding practices as a default.
* Build scalable, low\-latency, fault\-tolerant systems empirically proven through load and stress testing.
* Flag known tradeoffs before they become incidents.
* Track, plan, and resolve tech debt consciously so that it doesn’t pile up.
* Ensure the team's releases are monitored, documented, and supportable.
* Act as scrum master for the team.
* Improve the SDLC and project workflow for the team and group.
* Create an inclusive environment where every engineer can contribute and be heard.
* Promote team building and a durable team culture.
* Encourage responsible AI adoption within the team.
* Set clear expectations for how AI\-assisted work is reviewed before it merges.
* You translate broader business objectives into clear engineering tasks while shielding the team from unnecessary external noise.
* Remove blockers using approved AI tooling.


**Requirements \-**
* 8 to 12 years of experience in software development using C\#, .Net core, javascript, and typescript.
* Minimum 2 years of experience leading an agile development team.
* Strong experience in leading a mid\-sized team (7\-10\) which includes developers and QA Engineers.
* Strong experience in developing and integrating REST APIs, XML, JSON, and SOAP.
* Strong architectural \& system design skills.
* Experience in GCP/AWS is a plus.
* Strong experience with code review tools like SonarQube, etc.
* Hands\-on experience in driving ambiguous problem areas in existing or new software initiatives.
* Proven experience in solving complex architecture and business problems with solutions that are extensible, simple, and optimal.
* Ability to think in terms of integrating systems and networks as well as programs.
* Strong Experience influencing software engineering best practices within your team, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations.
* Experience taking a leading role in building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers with other engineers working under your guidance.
* Experience mentoring software engineers to improve their skills, and making them more effective software engineers.
* Experience in communicating with engineering leadership to understand requirements describing software product features, technical designs, and product strategy.
* Experience in system development skills in C\#.
* Experience upskilling senior engineers in AI\-assisted coding.
* Proficiency in using AI tools like Claude to improve efficiency of SDLC.


**What Success Looks Like \-**
* The team regularly meets the delivery commitments on quality.
* Technical ambiguity does not stall the team; decisions are made and communicated quickly.
* Post\-release architectural rework, rollbacks or incidents are rare.
* Engineers on the team describe it as a place where they express themselves and produce their best work.


**Other:**
* Work Mode : Hybrid
* Work Timings: 12:00 PM to 9:00 PM.
* Second level of On call support for production systems that are owned by team


**What it takes to succeed here \-** 
 Ambition and dedication to make a difference and change the way people travel; Where we always play to each other's strength in a high performing team reaching for our common goal. We hold ourselves to the highest expectations, and move with a sense of urgency and hold ourselves accountable and win by staying true to what we believe in.
   

  

**What we offer \-** 
 We offer an opportunity to work with a young, dynamic, and a growing team composed of high\-caliber professionals. We value professionalism and promote a culture where individuals are encouraged to do more and be more. If you feel you share our passion for excellence, and growth, then look no further. We have an ambitious mission, and we need a world\-class team to make it a reality. Upgrade to a First Class team!

title: Application Development Lead (Java) - Senior Vice President
description:
**Job Specification:**
 We are seeking a Lead Java Engineer to head the XiP Compute Service (XCS) team — the engine room of Citi's enterprise\-scale XiNG Platform (XiP), responsible for orchestrating and executing 1\.5 billion risk calculations every day.
   

  

 As the lead of the XCS team, you will own the design, development, and evolution of the most performance\-critical component within XiP. XiP is Citi's unified risk calculation platform built on the XiNG quantitative libraries standard, and XCS sits at its core — providing the powerful compute paradigms and guardrails that enable calculations to run reliably at massive scale.
   

  

 Your team is the engine that daily coordinates hundreds of thousands of pods, consumes tens of thousands of compute nodes, utilises hundreds of TB of memory, and distributes hundreds of millions of calculations across Citi's private cloud and Public cloud infrastructures. The platform is both highly performant and rapidly evolving, and your leadership will be central to driving it to its next generation of scale, efficiency, and capability.
   

  

 You will work closely with other software engineers, DevOps, and our customers to define technical strategy and ensure the reliable, secure, and scalable operation of the platform.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Take a lead in defining the long\-term strategic direction of the XiP Platform:**
 Apply your experience and skills to develop the future versions of the calculation engine. This means making it faster, utilize resources better, and scale to even greater sizes. This means adding new features without impacting performance of the platform in an undesirable manner, as small changes multiplied by millions of calculations have a high cost. This means solving hard problems like transferring small amounts of data to a huge number of machines.
   

  

**Take on the day\-to\-day leadership of the development team:**
 Lead the team's Agile/Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, and retrospectives, to ensure a smooth and effective development workflow. Manage the project backlog, prioritize tasks, and coordinate development efforts to align with the product roadmap and strategic goals. Provide hands\-on technical leadership, guiding the team in architectural decisions and enforcing coding standards.
   

  

**Serve as advisor or coach to team members, allocating and overseeing work:**
 Mentor and guide developers, providing technical advice, code reviews, and career development support. Allocate tasks based on skill sets and project priorities, ensuring balanced workloads and timely delivery. Foster a collaborative and growth\-oriented team environment, encouraging best practices and continuous learning.
   

  

**Lead the implementation of changes and improvements to Citi's Risk Calculation Engine:**
 Lead the design, development, and implementation of enhancements to the Risk Calculation Engine, focusing on optimizing its distribution mechanisms. Analyze current parallelization strategies, which regularly handle 250,000 hours of compute in a single 90\-minute execution, and identify opportunities to further improve efficiency, scalability, and throughput.
   

  

**Plan, coordinate, and execute strategic changes to the engine to reach the next scaling milestone:**
 Develop and manage strategic initiatives aimed at scaling the Risk Calculation Engine to meet future business demands. Coordinate with stakeholders to ensure that all scaling efforts are aligned with customer needs.
   

  

**Qualifications**
* Should be a Graduate from a recognized University
* 10\+ years of professional software development experience with Java.
* Solid experience with Java frameworks (e.g., Spring, Spring Boot, Quarkus).
* Proven experience designing, building, and maintaining large\-scale, distributed systems.
* Exposure to cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and containerization (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).
* Experience with RESTful API design and implementation.
* Strong understanding of object\-oriented programming and design patterns.

 Job Category
   

  

 Customer Success
   

  

 Job Details
   

  

**About Salesforce**
 Salesforce is the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
   

  

 Ready to level\-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
   

  

 The Professional Services organisation is focused on delivering Salesforce's world\-class product and project offerings to ensure customers are getting the most out of the Salesforce Platform. We help customers accelerate their path to value with Salesforce, focused on making sure you’re set up for long\-term success to tap into the full capacity of the Salesforce platform, fast. We help you plan your strategic roadmap and we make sure you are building Salesforce so that it’s easy to maintain and adapt down the road, minimising potential technical debt. Our team is made up of thousands of the world’s leading Salesforce experts. We share our own 20 years of product best practices with your team and partners so that you have everything you need to achieve your goals.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**YOUR IMPACT:**
 Salesforce Professional Services is looking for a Senior Technical Architect. As a Senior Technical Architect, you will be serving as a strategic advisor and Salesforce product and platform expert to the company’s largest, most complex enterprise customers. Here are some salient responsibilities the role entails \-
   

  

* Serve as a trusted advisor to the client
* Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits
* Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases
* Champion an AI\-first delivery methodology, utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation across projects
* Identify and lead internal strategic initiatives to grow the consulting practice; serving as an active contributor to the community’s overall knowledge base and expertise
* Guide customers and colleagues in rationalising and deploying emerging technologies that drive increased business value
* Work collaboratively and having very strong communications skills, especially in teaching complex concepts, and creative, prescriptive thinking
* Identify and proactively manage risk areas and commit to seeing an issue through to complete resolution
* Manage customer expectations; negotiate solutions to complex problems with both the customer and third\-party partners
* Review and correct project/program direction, approach, and key artefacts to keep programs on track and solutions extendable and maintainable going forward
* Work closely with Delivery Managers, Solution Architects, and directly with clients to architect technology solutions to meet client needs
* Contribute to a program vision while advising and articulating program/project strategies on enabling technologies including the Salesforce Platform
* Lead the technical architecture team for an enterprise\-level customer engagement
* From time\-to\-time, the TA may be expected to partake in other pre\-sales activities such as discovery and technical deep\-dive sessions, Proof\-Of\-Concept (POC) development with prospects
* Liaise with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations
* Expected to participate in pre\-sales activities such as discovery and technical deep\-dive sessions, Proof\-Of\-Concept (POC) development with prospects
* Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50\-75%


**Minimum Qualifications**
* 12\+ years enterprise architecture or consulting experience
* Strong application design skills combined with strong data, integration, and security architecture skills
* Strong presentation skills. Able to effectively present and defend a point of view to a variety of audiences
* Detail\-oriented individual with the ability to rapidly learn and take advantage of new concepts, business models, and technologies, including upskilling on modern AI development tools and practices
* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal. Able to effectively develop materials that are appropriate for the audience
* A great listener with the ability to communicate with people in diverse roles
* Proven ability to analyse, design, and optimise business processes via technology and integration
* Resourceful and innovative thinker who can work through and solve problems
* TRUST: Trusts the company’s core values; shows integrity, transparency, and reliability
* TEAM PLAYER: Proficient at collaboration and working with members of a team
* COMMUNICATOR: Speaks and writes with clarity, brevity, and purpose; explains the area of expertise clearly and confidently to others; influences and engages C\-Level with authority and confidence


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree (or its foreign degree equivalent) in Computer Science, Engineering (any field), or a related quantitative discipline. Equivalent demonstrable work experience in lieu of a degree will be considered
* Application, System Architect, CTA Certifications (Optional) or ability to clear the certifications on hire
* Ability to convey and convince customers of best practices at various levels within a large organisation
* Application design and development background
* LEADERSHIP: Self\-aware; proficient at building strong relationships
* THOUGHT LEADER: Strong point of view and executive presence. Confident, but not arrogant, a great storyteller


 Unleash Your Potential
   

  

 When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
 *be your best* 
 , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
 *do your best* 
 . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.
   

  

 Accommodations
   

  

 If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.
   

  

 Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.
   

  

 Posting Statement
   

  

 Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non\-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. title: Lead Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!
   

  

 The
 **Lead Forward Deployed Engineer** 
 operates at the intersection of engineering, data, and customer deployment. In this hands\-on, customer\-facing role, you will lead complex enterprise onboardings to integrate, transform, and operationalize cybersecurity data into Qualys’ Enterprise TruRisk Management (ETM) platform. You will translate fragmented security environments into a unified risk model while bridging the gap between customer needs and core product engineering.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Customer Onboarding \& Data Integration
   

  

* Strategic Execution: Lead end\-to\-end enterprise onboarding from strategy to production rollout, serving as the system of record for customer assets, findings, and business context.
* Pipeline \& API Design: Build REST API, webhook, and scalable ingestion (e.g., S3\-based ETL/ELT) pipelines to integrate diverse data sources (VM, EDR/XDR, Cloud, IAM, CMDBs, GRC).
* Data Modeling \& Correlation: Design custom mapping, transformation, tagging, and asset criticality scoring; implement de\-duplication and correlation logic across heterogeneous security feeds.
* Pipeline Reliability: Ensure continuous full and incremental data ingestion with automated scheduling, monitoring, and error handling.


 Data Quality \& Validation
   

  

* Data Integrity: Establish scalable validation frameworks to audit and maintain asset/findings accuracy for confident risk decision\-making.
* Issue Resolution: Execute controlled reprocessing and configuration adjustments to fix data quality issues without disrupting operational metrics.


 Dashboards, Remediation \& Workflows
   

  

* Analytics \& Modeling: Build customized dashboards, trend visualizations, and risk scoring models, including complex "toxic risk combination" scenarios.
* Workflow Automation: Integrate ETM with ticketing/remediation tools (Jira, ServiceNow) and configure automated alerts, escalations, and ownership mapping.
* Executive Reporting: Develop custom reports/utilities using public APIs for board\-level, operational, and regulatory audiences.


 Product \& Engineering Feedback Loop
   

  

* Roadmap Influence: Translate field deployment challenges and recurring integration gaps into technical requirements for product and core engineering teams.
* Customer Maturity: Guide enterprises from initial risk visibility to automated, remediation\-driven action.


 Required Qualifications:
   

  

* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience: 8–10 years in data engineering, platform engineering, or customer\-facing technical roles.
* Technical Stack:
* Strong programming proficiency in Python, Go, or similar languages.
* Deep experience with REST APIs, webhooks, asynchronous systems, and scalable ingestion pipelines (ETL/ELT).
* Hands\-on knowledge of relational, NoSQL, search, or graph databases.
* Domain \& Data Expertise:
* Strong foundation in data modeling, normalization, transformation, and correlation.
* Solid understanding of core cybersecurity domains (VM, Cloud Security, IAM, Risk Frameworks).
* Hands\-on application of AI or automation to optimize data pipelines and onboarding workflows.
* Soft Skills: Exceptional client\-facing, communication, and technical consultation skills.


 Preferred Qualifications:
   

  

* Background in Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Engineering, or Technical Professional Services.
* Familiarity with large\-scale, distributed systems and microservices architectures.
* Proven ability to thrive in high\-impact, fast\-paced, and ambiguous production environments.

title: ServiceNow Development Lead
description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Sulzer is transforming its IT operating model to better meet business needs and achieve operational excellence. The ServiceNow Development Lead is a key role within the IT Service Management function, responsible for the technical leadership, governance, and delivery of development activities on the ServiceNow platform.
   

  

 The role ensures that ServiceNow solutions are designed and built in a scalable, secure, and upgrade‑safe manner, aligned with platform strategy, enterprise architecture, and business priorities. Acting as the technical lead for ServiceNow development, the incumbent provides hands‑on expertise, sets development standards, mentors internal developers, and ensures high‑quality delivery across ITSM and other ServiceNow capabilities.
   

  

**Main Tasks And Responsibilities**
* Provide technical leadership and end to end ownership of ServiceNow development activities across the platform. ‑to‑end ownership of ServiceNow development activities across the platform.
* Translate functional and business requirements into robust technical designs, ensuring alignment with ServiceNow best practices and platform strategy.
* Define, implement, and enforce development standards, guidelines, and guardrails (coding standards, scoped applications, update set management, CI/CD, documentation).
* Lead solution design for ServiceNow customizations, configurations, integrations, and automation, ensuring upgrade safety and long\-term maintainability. ‑term maintainability.
* Act as the technical authority for ServiceNow development, performing design and code reviews to ensure quality and consistency.

* Own the technical lifecycle of developments across environments (development, test, production), supporting release and deployment activities.
* Support integration design and implementation (REST, APIs, middleware, MID Server), ensuring reliable and secure data exchange.
* Monitor and continuously improve platform performance, stability, and technical debt.
* Maintain technical documentation, design artefacts, and development of runbooks.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives, automation, and innovation across IT Service Management and adjacent domains.


**To Succeed In This Role, You Will Need**
* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience with ServiceNow development in large, complex enterprise environments. ‑on experience with ServiceNow development in large, complex enterprise environments.
* ServiceNow certifications (e.g., Certified System Administrator, Certified Application Developer, CIS certifications).
* Proven experience in a technical lead or senior developer role, guiding development teams and delivery (internal and external).
* Strong expertise in ServiceNow development and configuration, including:

* Business Rules, Script Includes, UI Policies, Client Scripts
* Flow Designer and IntegrationHub
* Service Portal / UI Builder
* ACLs, data policies, and security model
* PowerShell scripting
* Solid experience with ServiceNow ITSM, CSM, SPM; exposure to additional modules (ITOM, ITAM, HRSD) is an advantage.
* Experience designing and managing integrations using REST/SOAP APIs and MID Servers.
* Strong understanding of ServiceNow release management, upgrade‑safe development, and environment management.
* Experience working in agile delivery models and collaborating closely with product and process owners.
* Excellent analytical, problem‑solving, and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and operate effectively in a transforming organization.
* Native‑level proficiency in oral and written English.
* Would Be a Plus:
* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.
* Familiarity with CI/CD concepts and DevOps tooling for ServiceNow.
* Knowledge of ITIL practices and IT Service Management processes.
* Experience working with outsourced development partners or system integrators.
* Exposure to CMDB, CSDM, and service‑oriented data models


 What we offer you
   

  

* A permanent contract.
* A competitive salary as well as participation in the variable remuneration system based on personal and financial objectives.
* Restaurant tickets
* Be part of an experienced, international team
* A good vibe working environment.
* Enjoy great office facilities and a perfect location in Madrid Nuevos Ministerios, making your work experience both comfortable and convenient.

 No visa or work permit support can be provided for this role.
   

  

 Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

title: Principal - Cloud Foundation Engineer
description:
**About Northern Trust**
 As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
   

  

 Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
   

  

 With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
   

  

**Principal \- Cloud Foundations Engineer**
**About The Role**
 We are seeking a Principal \- Cloud Foundations Engineer to design, build, and maintain the core cloud infrastructure and shared services that enable our development and business teams to operate securely, reliably, and efficiently in the cloud. This role focuses on establishing the landing zones, automation, governance, and operational guardrails that form the foundation for all cloud workloads.
   

  

 As a Cloud Foundations Engineer, you will work across multiple teams to ensure that our cloud environments follow best practices for security, scalability, automation, and cost optimization, while enabling self\-service adoption by application teams.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Cloud Platform Engineering
+ Design, implement, and maintain enterprise landing zones and shared cloud services.
+ Manage account/subscription structures across AWS, Azure, and/or GCP.
+ Build and enforce secure\-by\-default infrastructure patterns.

* Infrastructure as Code \& Automation
+ Develop and maintain reusable IaC modules (Terraform, CloudFormation, Bicep, or Pulumi).
+ Build CI/CD pipelines to automate infrastructure deployment and updates.
+ Enable self\-service provisioning capabilities for development teams.

* Security, Governance \& Compliance
+ Implement identity and access management (IAM) best practices.
+ Configure and maintain guardrails such as policies, SCPs, and monitoring controls.
+ Ensure compliance with regulatory and internal security standards.

* Networking \& Connectivity
+ Design and support VPC/VNet architectures, routing, firewalls, VPNs, and interconnects.
+ Establish hybrid connectivity solutions with on\-premises environments.

* Observability \& Cost Optimization
+ Deploy monitoring, logging, and auditing tools across the environment.
+ Build dashboards to track cloud performance, security posture, and costs.
+ Recommend and implement cost\-saving measures.

* Collaboration \& Enablement
+ Partner with application, DevOps, and security teams to ensure smooth cloud adoption.
+ Provide documentation, best practices, and training to engineering teams.
+ Participate in incident response and troubleshooting when foundational services are impacted.


**Qualifications**
* Education \& Experience
+ Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).
+ 15\+ years of total work experience in Technology Infrastructure.
+ 10\+ years of experience in cloud engineering, infrastructure, or platform operations.

* Technical Skills
+ Deep expertise in at least one major cloud provider (Azure and AWS).
+ Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) — Terraform preferred.
+ Hands\-on knowledge of networking concepts (VPC, DNS, firewalls, load balancing, hybrid connectivity).
+ Experience with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, etc.).
+ Familiarity with cloud security principles and compliance frameworks.
+ Proficiency in scripting languages (Python, Bash, PowerShell).

* Soft Skills
+ Strong problem\-solving and troubleshooting abilities, cross\-functional collaboration skills.
+ Excellent communication, mentorship, and ability to influence cross\-functional teams.
+ Demonstrated ability to lead technically without direct authority.
+ Ability to balance governance requirements with developer productivity.


**Preferred Skills (Nice\-to\-Have)**
* Experience operating cloud platforms in regulated enterprise environments.
* Experience with multi\-cloud environments.
* Familiarity with Kubernetes and container orchestration (EKS, AKS, GKE).
* Knowledge of service mesh, API Gateways, or Serverless Platforms.
* Background in FinOps (cloud cost optimization practices).
* Cloud certifications (AWS Solutions Architect, Azure Solutions Architect, GCP Professional Cloud Architect).


 Success Measures
   

  

* Stable, secure, and scalable cloud foundation adopted across teams.
* Improved developer productivity through reusable frameworks and standards.
* Strong technical mentorship and uplift of data engineering capabilities.
* Reduced onboarding time and operational friction for application teams.
* Improved security posture and audit outcomes.
* Recognized as a trusted technical authority within the Cloud Foundation domain.


**Working with Us**
 As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
   

  

 Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
   

  

**Reasonable Accommodation**
 Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.
   

  

**About Our Pune Office**
 The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.
   

  

 Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000\+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

**AI Business Solutions – Dynamics F\&SCM Commerce Technical Senior :**
**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 As a Microsoft Dynamics 365 Commerce Technical Senior at EY GDS, you will contribute to the success of enterprise\-scale D365 F\&O implementations, primarily in the Retail and commerce domain. You will have the opportunity to work with a growing team and play a key role in delivering financial transformation solutions, process improvements, and ERP implementations to global clients, helping build a better working world.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Build and maintain strong client relationships through value\-driven consulting, technical leadership, and proactive engagement.
* Lead the technical design and development of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Commerce solutions, with a focus on POS systems (MPOS/CPOS) \& B2C /B2B Website.
* Configure and extend Store Commerce, Hardware Station, and integrate peripherals such as printers, scanners, cash drawers, and payment devices.
* Configure and extend B2C \& B2B website, Site builder.
* Develop custom POS functionalities using Commerce SDK, Online SDK , TypeScript, JavaScript, C\#, and .NET Core.
* Implement integrations between POS and backend systems: ERP (F\&O), payment gateways, fiscal printers, loyalty programs, and eCommerce platforms.

* Collaborate with functional consultants to translate business needs into detailed technical designs and functional design documents (FDDs).
* Utilize Azure DevOps and Lifecycle Services (LCS) for source control, CI/CD pipelines, and environment management.
* Support system testing, performance tuning, deployment, and go\-live activities.
* Conduct code reviews, enforce best development practices, and maintain thorough technical documentation.
* Provide Level 3 support post\-go\-live to resolve POS\-related issues and ensure smooth store operations.
* Responsible for decision\-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Familiarity with Power Platform, especially Power Apps and Power BI, is a plus.
* Ability to conceptualize and design future\-state business processes.
* Experience in conducting GAP analysis, solution testing, and user training.

**Ideally, you’ll also**
* Knowledge of integration with other Microsoft technologies such as Azure, Power Platform.
* Familiarity with industry\-specific retail practices and compliance requirements.
* Experience working in multi\-country and multi\-legal entity environments.
* Strong documentation, stakeholder communication, and problem\-solving skills.
* Proven ability to lead discovery workshops, manage offshore teams, and mentor junior consultants.
* A proactive mindset with the ability to work independently and collaboratively in a global, fast\-paced environment.


**What We Look For**
* 5–10 years of experience in D365 Commerce technical.
* Minimum 3 full\-cycle D365 F\&O implementations in Commerce domains.
* Strong domain knowledge of Retail \& eCommerce
* Strong domain knowledge of D365 Site builder tool
* Strong analytical and debugging skills with a focus on performance and reliability.
* Experience with Microsoft SureStep, Agile, or hybrid implementation methodologies.
* Proficiency in working with globally distributed teams and stakeholders.
* Microsoft certifications such as MB\-340, MB\-900 are preferred.

Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.

title: Senior Platform Architect
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Senior Platform Architect
   

  

 Who is Mastercard?
   

  

 Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.
   

  

 Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.
   

  

**Overview**
 The Infrastructure Engineering team is looking for a Senior Platform Architect to lead the design and evolution of secure, scalable, and resilient enterprise infrastructure platforms that power Mastercard's critical business services. The ideal candidate is a strategic technology leader with deep expertise in enterprise architecture, infrastructure engineering, and cloud technologies. They are highly collaborative, intellectually curious, and passionate about solving complex technical challenges while driving innovation, operational excellence, and platform modernization. This individual excels at partnering across engineering, security, and product organizations to deliver scalable solutions that enable business growth and provide exceptional customer experiences.
   

  

 Role
   

  

* Lead the architecture, design, and delivery of highly available, scalable, and secure enterprise infrastructure solutions across on\-premises, hybrid, and cloud environments.
* Partner with Engineering, Network, Security, Cloud, Database, Middleware, Product, and Program Management teams to develop infrastructure solutions that support business and technology strategies.
* Drive infrastructure solution delivery from initial business engagement through architecture reviews, financial approvals, procurement, implementation, operational readiness, and production deployment.
* Design resilient networking, application delivery, and security architectures utilizing enterprise technologies including load balancing, web application firewalls, API gateways, and distributed infrastructure platforms.
* Lead infrastructure modernization initiatives focused on automation, Infrastructure\-as\-Code (IaC), platform standardization, performance optimization, resiliency, and operational excellence.
* Develop enterprise architecture standards, technical roadmaps, and infrastructure documentation while mentoring engineering teams and promoting engineering best practices.
* Ensure infrastructure solutions meet stringent requirements for security, compliance, availability, scalability, disaster recovery, and performance across mission\-critical platforms.


**All About You**
 Essential Knowledge, Skills \& Experience
   

  

* Deep expertise in enterprise infrastructure architecture across data center, hybrid cloud, and distributed computing environments.
* Advanced knowledge of enterprise networking, application delivery, and infrastructure security, including Zero Trust principles and modern network architectures.
* Experience designing and supporting enterprise platforms utilizing VMware, cloud technologies (AWS, Azure, GCP), load balancing, web application firewalls, API gateways, and distributed infrastructure.
* Strong expertise in infrastructure automation, Infrastructure\-as\-Code (Terraform, Ansible), CI/CD integration, and configuration management using tools such as Git, Bitbucket, and Jenkins.
* Demonstrated ability to architect and deliver highly available, resilient, and secure infrastructure solutions while collaborating effectively across cross\-functional engineering and business teams.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to influence technical and executive stakeholders.


**Desirable Or Additional Capabilities**
* Expertise in infrastructure performance engineering, including capacity planning, scalability testing, and performance optimization.
* Advanced experience creating technical architecture documentation and executive presentations using Microsoft Visio.
* Experience supporting mission\-critical financial services platforms with stringent availability, security, resiliency, and regulatory compliance requirements.


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Solutions Architect
description:
FEQ327R324

You will guide customers through the competitive landscape, best practices, and implementation, and develop technical champions along the way.
   

  

**The impact you will have**
* Be the trusted technical advisor for one or more named strategic accounts — building deep, durable relationships with their data, AI/ML, and platform engineering leaders, and earning a seat at the table for their most important architectural decisions.
* Help shape and drive your customer's AI strategy — partnering with their data science, ML, and AI platform teams to design GenAI and ML architectures, evaluate build\-vs\-buy decisions, and turn AI ambitions into production systems deployed on Databricks.
* Partner with the sales team and provide hands\-on technical leadership to help large enterprise customers understand how Databricks can help solve their business problems across the full data and AI lifecycle.
* Consult on modern Lakehouse architectures and implement proofs of concept for strategic projects spanning data engineering, data warehousing, machine learning, GenAI— including validating integrations with cloud services, in\-house tools, and third\-party applications.
* Work directly with the sales team to develop your book of business, define account strategies, and execute those strategies to help your customers and prospects solve their business problems with Databricks.
* Collaborate across regions with fellow Solutions Architects and account teams, supporting our customers with consistent architectural guidance across their international footprint.
* Become an expert in, promote, and recruit contributors for Databricks\-inspired open\-source projects (Spark, Delta Lake, MLflow, Unity Catalog) across the developer community.


**What We Look For**
* 12\+ years in data engineering, data science, technical architecture, or a similar pre\-sales / consulting role.

* Strong hands\-on architectural experience — able to whiteboard, design, and personally build end\-to\-end solutions, not just advise.
* Demonstrated experience working with large enterprise or Fortune 500 customers; experience supporting global accounts across multiple geographies strongly preferred.
* Experience working with digital\-native or SaaS enterprises with mature data and AI practices is a strong plus.
* Strong consulting / customer\-facing experience working with external clients across a variety of industries.
* Coding experience in Python, SQL, Scala, Java, or R.
* Experience building distributed data systems at enterprise scale.
* Hands\-on experience with at least one major public cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Available to travel to customers in your region and occasionally internationally.
* Nice to have: prior experience working in or with a Global Capability Center model; Databricks Certification.

More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT\&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data \+ AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. * Continuously improve automation speed, stability, coverage, and execution efficiency.

* Experience developing automated tests for APIs, backend services, web applications, distributed systems, or enterprise software.
* Strong experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated test execution, including familiarity with CI/CD runners and build/deployment infrastructure.
* Hands\-on experience with AWS or other cloud environments, with the ability to troubleshoot applications and test environments in the cloud.
* Experience troubleshooting complex application and production issues using logs, metrics, traces, database queries, and code level debugging.
* Ability to understand an existing codebase and independently build significant automated test coverage.
* Demonstrated ability to use AI assisted development tools/coding agents as part of day to day engineering and test automation work.
* Strong analytical and debugging skills with the ability to identify root causes rather than simply report failures.
* Strong understanding of test automation principles, test design, regression testing, and automation reliability.
* Ability to work collaboratively with engineering and cross functional teams.
* Willingness to support production issue reproduction and troubleshooting outside standard working hours when required.

title: Data Architech
description:
QT\-MA\-09\-746
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced
 **Data Architect / SQL Server Data Engineer** 
 to design and enforce an
 **on\-premises SQL\-first Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold)** 
 using
 **SQL Server 2025 Standard Edition** 
 . The role will focus on building robust, metadata\-driven ingestion frameworks for a greenfield
 **NetSuite ERP** 
 , leveraging
 **SuiteAnalytics Connect and SuiteQL** 
 , with particular emphasis on engineering reliable hard\-delete detection mechanisms. The candidate will develop custom
 **T\-SQL frameworks for data quality, matching, and survivorship** 
 within the Silver layer to address the deprecation of Microsoft DQS and MDS, while designing
 **Kimball\-style dimensional models** 
 , including Star and Snowflake schemas, optimized for downstream reporting and analytics through
 **Power BI Service and the Enterprise On\-Premises Data Gateway** 
 . The role also requires evaluating and implementing high\-volume ingestion solutions, balancing metadata\-driven
 **SSIS pipelines** 
 with hybrid SaaS platforms such as
 **Fivetran** 
 , while operating within strict network security boundaries. The ideal candidate should have expert knowledge of
 **SQL Server internal architecture** 
 , including Resource Governor, temporal tables, and columnstore indexes for analytical workloads on Standard Edition, along with proven experience migrating legacy ERP historical data and integrating it with new cloud ERP operational data in an on\-premises data warehouse. Strong knowledge of the
 **NetSuite data model, ODBC drivers, SuiteAnalytics Connect, and connection concurrency limits** 
 is required, as well as mastery of
 **Power BI semantic model design, DAX, Row\-Level Security (RLS), and gateway capacity planning** 
 . The candidate should also have strong experience designing
 **automated, idempotent ETL/ELT frameworks** 
 that clearly separate extraction logic from business transformations and ensure reliable, maintainable, and scalable data pipelines.

title: Software Engineering Manager
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Software Engineering Manager
   

  

**Overview**
 Mastercard Services enables customers across industries and geographies to make smarter decisions and reach better outcomes with a tailored portfolio of solutions beyond the transaction. If you thrive in a fast\-paced, agile environment, value creativity and technical excellence, and are eager to make a meaningful impact, this is the role for you.
   

  

 The Services global product team is seeking a Manager, Software Engineering to accelerate the development of Analytics \& AI solutions within the Data Analytics and AI product suite. The goal of this team is to build AI products that drive smarter decisions and better outcomes for customers, applying AI responsibly, and leveraging in\-house and 3rd party assets and capabilities effectively to maximize ROI for the program.
   

  

 Engineers work in small, flexible teams. Every team member contributes to designing, building, and testing features. The range of work you will encounter varies from building intuitive, responsive UIs to designing backend data models, architecting data flows, and beyond. There are no rigid organizational structures, and each team uses processes that work best for its members and projects.
