 Lead strategic technical direction for applications, architectures, and development processes.
   

  

 Lead and push the boundaries of analytics and powerful, scalable applications
   

  

 Act as a contributor to product implementation while empowering your team
   

  

 Champion innovation by exploring and adopting new technologies and methodologies.
   

  

 Lead with an agile mindset, adapting to changes quickly and guiding your team to pivot when needed.
   

  

 Coach, mentor, and develop a cross\-functional engineering team to deliver high\-quality solutions and well\-tested code
   

  

 Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning.
   

  

 Collaborate across teams and business units to solve complex technical problems and ensure alignment.
   

  

 Partner with Product Managers and Customer Experience Designers to define roadmaps, scope features, and plan releases.
   

  

 Ensure projects meet customer demands while scaling platform solutions for future growth.
   

  

**Ideal Candidate Qualifications**
 10\+ years of engineering experience in an agile production environment.
   

  

 Experience leading the design and implementation of complex features in full\-stack applications.
   

  

 Proficiency with object\-oriented languages, preferably Java/ Spring, alternatively C\#
   

  

 Proficiency with modern front\-end frameworks, preferably React with Redux, Typescript.
   

  

 Fluent in the use of Git, Jenkins.
   

  

 Solid experience with RESTful APIs and JSON/SOAP based API.
   

  

 Solid experience with SQL, Multi\-threading, Message Queuing.
   

  

 Hands\-on experience with Python or Scala is preferred, as well as expertise in Hadoop platforms and related tools.
   

  

 Experience in building and deploying production\-level data\-driven applications and data processing, workflows/pipelines and/or implementing machine learning systems at scale in Java, Scala, or Python and deliver analytics involving all phases.
   

  

 Data engineering or data science background with strong understanding of data pipelines, architecture, infrastructure, and management.
   

  

**Desirable Capabilities**
 Hands on experience of cloud native development using microservices.
   

  

 Hands on experience on Kafka, Zookeeper.
   

  

 Knowledge of enterprise application security protocols and concepts.
   

  

 Expertise with automated E2E and unit testing frameworks.
   

  

 Knowledge of Splunk or other alerting and monitoring solutions.
   

  

**Core Competencies**
 Strong technologist eager to learn new technologies and frameworks.
   

  

 Experience coaching and mentoring junior teammates.
   

  

 Customer\-centric development approach
   

  

 Passion for analytical / quantitative problem solving
   

  

 Ability to identify and implement improvements to team development processes
   

  

 Strong collaboration skills with experience collaborating across many people, roles, and geographies
   

  

 Motivation, creativity, self\-direction, and desire to thrive on small project teams
   

  

 Superior academic record with a degree in Computer Science or related technical field
   

  

 Strong written and verbal English communication skills
   

  

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Data Architect - 13+ years exp, Snowflake, dbt, Python
description:
**Meet the Team**
 Be part of the Cisco IT Data team, where technology, innovation, and collaboration drive real business value. Our team is at the forefront of designing and delivering scalable, secure, and advanced solutions that enable data\-driven decision\-making for Cisco's global business. We believe in a culture of curiosity, creativity, and continuous learning, where team members are empowered to experiment and bring new ideas to life.
   

  

 As a
 **Data Architect** 
 , you will be the senior technical authority responsible for defining the architecture, standards, and strategic direction of Cisco's enterprise data platforms. You will design scalable, secure, and future\-ready data architectures that power advanced analytics, machine learning, and real\-time data products. Partnering with engineering, analytics, and business leaders, your designs will directly shape how Cisco stores, governs, integrates, and unlocks value from data across the enterprise.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Define and own the enterprise data architecture vision, standards, and multi\-year roadmap across ingestion, storage, transformation, discovery, and governance.
* Design scalable, secure, and highly available data architectures—including data lakes, lakehouses, data warehouses, and real\-time streaming systems—leveraging modern cloud\-native technologies.
* Define and lead target\-state architecture and migration strategies that modernize legacy data infrastructure onto cloud\-native platforms (e.g., GCP, Snowflake) to improve scalability and reduce operational cost.
* Establish architectural standards, reference patterns, and best practices for data modeling, integration, metadata management, and platform security across teams.
* Establish enterprise data modeling standards and governance/lineage frameworks that improve data quality, discoverability, and compliance across multiple business domains.
* Design API\- and event\-driven integration architectures that enable real\-time data access across the enterprise, improving data delivery speed and reliability.
* Partner closely with data engineers, analytics teams, platform engineers, and business leaders to translate strategic priorities into robust, well\-governed data solutions.
* Lead architecture decisions for platform modernization, evaluating and selecting technologies (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Airflow, DBT, Informatica, Kubernetes) to optimize efficiency, cost, and scale.
* Define data governance, lineage, quality, and compliance frameworks, ensuring they are embedded across platform design and operations.
* Provide architectural oversight and design reviews, ensuring solutions meet reliability, scalability, performance, and security requirements.
* Champion conceptual, logical, and physical data modeling practices that support both operational and analytical workloads.
* Mentor engineers and architects, fostering a culture of technical excellence, sound design thinking, and knowledge sharing.
* Act as a key technical advisor to leadership, influencing architecture decisions, technology investments, and strategic direction across the data organization.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
* 13\+ years of professional experience in data architecture, data engineering, or large\-scale data platform design.
* Deep expertise designing enterprise data architectures—data lakes, lakehouses, and data warehouses—at scale.
* Strong proficiency with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Snowflake) and modern, cloud\-native data architectures.
* Expert\-level data modeling skills (conceptual, logical, and physical) across relational, dimensional, and NoSQL paradigms.
* Proven experience defining data integration, ingestion, and API/microservices patterns for enterprise\-scale systems.
* Strong knowledge of data pipeline orchestration tools (Airflow, DBT, Informatica) and cloud\-native storage (Snowflake, BigQuery).
* Hands\-on understanding of CI/CD, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation).
* Solid programming or scripting skills (Python, SQL, Java, or similar) to support architecture validation and prototyping.

title: Principal Software Engineer/Solution Architect
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Principal Software Engineer/Solution Architect
   

  

 Principal Software Engineer / Solution Architect – Decision Management Platform
   

  

**Overview**
 Join a team building modern, real\-time decisioning platforms for fraud analysis and prevention. As a Principal Software Engineer / Solution Architect, you will define and lead the architecture for a customer\-facing platform within the Decision Management Platform (DMP), focused on Decision Products UI (DPUI), also known internally as The Fraud Center. This role owns the API, service, data, and integration architecture for DPUI and works in close partnership with the UI Architect, who leads the user interface architecture.
   

  

 You will shape technical direction, architecture strategy, and governance to ensure the platform is secure, scalable, resilient, and aligned with enterprise and regulatory expectations. Working closely with product teams, UI Architect, and engineering, UX, and operations partners, you will guide DPUI through modernization, customer enhancements, and business cases that require new capabilities or changes to existing services.
   

  

 Role
   

  

* Lead the architecture for the DPUI API, service, and data layers, ensuring they support analyst workflows, customer\-facing capabilities, real\-time service interactions, and integration with the wider DMP platform.
* Define target\-state solutions and guide the design of applications and services across event review, case management, report management, rules and strategy management, and operational workflows.
* Shape architecture across APIs, microservices, database technologies, and integration patterns to support scalable, resilient, high\-performance transaction processing.
* Produce clear architecture deliverables to support decision\-making, governance, and delivery alignment.
* Drive architecture decisions to closure, balancing long\-term direction with practical delivery needs, platform stability, customer enhancements, and business case priorities.
* Partner closely with product teams and the UI Architect to shape solution roadmaps, define viable transition states, and align technical decisions with business priorities and delivery sequencing.
* Provide technical leadership to engineering teams through design reviews, implementation guidance, and delivery support.
* Work across engineering, UX, operations, and SMEs to ensure solutions are cohesive, supportable, and aligned with enterprise standards.
* Contribute to governance, assurance, and architecture review processes, ensuring that designs are well\-articulated, traceable, and implementation\-ready.
* Operate as part of the central architecture team, partnering with peer architects to align solutions, share direction, and promote consistency across the wider platform estate.
* Support and mentor emerging architects, helping to grow architectural capability and strengthen technical decision\-making across teams.
* Drive improvements that increase speed to market, operational efficiency, platform flexibility, and long\-term maintainability.


**About You**
* Proven experience architecting large\-scale, high\-performance distributed platforms in complex enterprise environments.
* Strong ability to define solution direction across multiple teams and support engineering through design, build, and delivery.
* Ability to communicate architecture clearly to support alignment, decision\-making, and execution.
* Strong partnership skills, with the ability to work closely with product teams to shape solution roadmaps and align architecture with evolving business priorities.
* Confidence in leading decisions, managing trade\-offs, and influencing technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to combine strategic thinking with hands\-on technical judgment, bringing clarity to ambiguity and helping teams move forward with confidence.


**Required Skills**
* Strong foundation in distributed systems, API and service design, modern backend architecture, and data\-intensive platform design.
* Experience with microservices architecture, domain\-driven design, and modern integration patterns.
* Experience with CI/CD, containers, Kubernetes, and modern delivery practices across private, public, and hybrid cloud environments.
* Strong understanding of web architecture, application development, integration patterns, and RESTful APIs.
* Experience with relational and operational data technologies, including Oracle and PostgreSQL, and data models that support high\-volume transaction processing.
* Ability to define non\-functional requirements across resilience, scalability, observability, security, and performance, and ensure these are reflected in solution design.
* Experience supporting modernization, migration, and platform transformation initiatives in environments where continuity of service is critical.


 Desirable Knowledge / Experience
   

  

* Experience in fraud, decisioning, workflow, or analyst\-facing platforms.
* Experience with high\-performance data storage technologies such as GemFire and similar in\-memory or distributed data platforms.
* Database experience, including Oracle and PostgreSQL, and data models that support high\-volume transaction processing and operational workflows.
* Experience with streaming or messaging platforms used to support event\-driven and near\-real\-time architectures.
* Experience integrating vendor and open\-source products into an overall platform architecture.
* Experience developing and supporting highly scalable, high\-performance transaction processing systems.
* Familiarity with architecture governance, risk, assurance, or enterprise review processes.
* Exposure to AI/GenAI or automation opportunities that improve user workflows, platform usability, or operational efficiency.


 This is an opportunity to shape the architecture of a critical platform, working with cross\-functional partners to evolve DPUI through customer, business, and platform priorities while helping engineering teams deliver high\-quality solutions for both current needs and future direction.
   

  

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Senior Staff Consulting Architect- Cloud Native
description:
Nutanix is seeking a Sr. Staff Consulting Architect – Cloud Native to provide senior technical leadership in the architecture, design, and transformation of enterprise Kubernetes and cloud\-native platforms based on the Nutanix Kubernetes Platform (NKP), across virtualized, bare\-metal, hybrid, and multi\-cloud environments.
   

  

 The role is intended for a highly experienced cloud\-native architect who can operate as a trusted technical advisor to senior customer stakeholders, lead complex and strategic platform transformation initiatives, and define scalable architecture standards across large and distributed environments.
   

  

 The Sr. Staff Consulting Architect will combine deep hands\-on expertise in Kubernetes, virtualization, platform engineering, automation, and cloud\-native technologies with strong consulting, architecture governance, and technical leadership capabilities.
   

  

 The role will also be responsible for developing reference architectures, reusable delivery patterns, technical assets, and enablement programs, while mentoring Staff and Consulting Architects and raising the overall cloud\-native capability of the consulting organization.
   

  

 Hands\-on expertise in Kubernetes, virtualization, platform engineering, CI/CD, GitOps, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) is mandatory.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Enterprise Architecture \& Strategic Advisory
* Provide end\-to\-end architecture leadership for complex enterprise Kubernetes and cloud\-native transformation programs.
* Define strategic platform architectures spanning:
+ Nutanix AHV
+ VMware vSphere
+ Bare metal
+ Public cloud platforms including AWS and Azure
+ Hybrid and multi\-cloud environments
+ Edge and distributed infrastructure

* Lead architecture strategy for large\-scale and multi\-cluster Kubernetes environments.
* Translate business, application, infrastructure, security, and operational requirements into scalable and resilient cloud\-native architectures.
* Define target\-state architectures and multi\-phase transformation roadmaps covering platform adoption, application modernization, migration, automation, and operations.
* Advise customer executives, enterprise architects, infrastructure leaders, platform engineering teams, and DevOps organizations on cloud\-native adoption strategies.
* Establish architecture principles, standards, and technology selection criteria for enterprise Kubernetes platforms.
* Provide technical leadership for complex architectural decisions, trade\-offs, and escalations.
* Advanced Kubernetes \& Platform Architecture
* Architect enterprise NKP platforms at scale, including:
+ Multi\-cluster and fleet architectures
+ Multi\-tenancy and workload isolation
+ High availability and disaster recovery
+ Cluster lifecycle management
+ Platform scalability and capacity planning
+ Security and governance

* Define advanced Kubernetes networking, storage, ingress/egress, and load\-balancing architectures.
* Design virtualization\-aware Kubernetes platforms considering:
+ Compute and resource allocation
+ NUMA and CPU topology
+ Storage performance
+ Network architecture
+ Failure domains
+ Cluster density
+ Performance optimization

* Define architecture patterns for GPU\-enabled and AI/ML workloads where applicable.
* Architect integration between Kubernetes and enterprise services including:
+ DNS
+ LDAP/Active Directory
+ PKI and certificate management
+ Load balancers
+ Backup and disaster recovery
+ Enterprise monitoring and logging

* Establish architecture patterns for platform standardization across multiple business units, data centers, and geographies.
* Complex Transformation \& Delivery Leadership
* Provide technical leadership for high\-value and technically complex customer engagements from Day\-0 architecture through Day\-2 operations.
* Lead architecture workshops, technical discovery sessions, design reviews, and transformation planning.
* Provide technical oversight for:
+ Platform deployment
+ Cluster onboarding
+ Application migration
+ Application modernization
+ Platform integration
+ Operational transformation

* Guide teams through complex implementation and troubleshooting scenarios spanning:
+ Kubernetes
+ Hypervisors
+ Networking
+ Storage
+ Security
+ Automation
+ CI/CD

* Act as the senior technical escalation point for critical architecture and delivery challenges.
* Ensure architectural decisions are translated into practical, supportable, and repeatable implementation patterns.
* Review and provide technical governance for solution designs produced by Staff and Consulting Architects.
* Automation, GitOps \& Platform Engineering
* Define enterprise automation strategies for Kubernetes and infrastructure platforms.
* Establish standardized GitOps and CI/CD operating models using technologies such as:
+ GitHub Actions
+ GitLab CI
+ Jenkins
+ Argo CD
+ Tekton
+ Flux CD

* Design Infrastructure as Code frameworks using:
+ Terraform
+ Ansible

* Define automation patterns integrating:
+ NKP APIs
+ Kubernetes APIs
+ Nutanix APIs
+ VMware APIs
+ AWS/Azure APIs

* Drive adoption of platform engineering principles, self\-service infrastructure, and developer experience (DevEx) practices.
* Establish reusable automation frameworks and reference implementations that can be adopted across customer engagements.
* Promote secure, compliant, version\-controlled, and auditable platform delivery practices.
* Security, Governance, Resilience \& Operations
* Define enterprise security architecture across infrastructure, Kubernetes, and application platform layers.
* Establish security and governance models covering:
+ RBAC
+ Network policies
+ Pod Security Standards
+ Secrets and certificate management
+ Policy\-as\-Code
+ Workload isolation
+ Multi\-tenancy

* Design policy and governance frameworks using OPA/Gatekeeper or equivalent technologies.
* Define enterprise approaches for:
+ Observability
+ Logging
+ Monitoring
+ Backup and recovery
+ Disaster recovery
+ Business continuity

* Establish operational models covering platform lifecycle, upgrades, patching, capacity management, and resilience.
* Review platform performance, scalability, and operational maturity and drive continuous optimization.
* Technical Leadership, Mentoring \& Capability Development
* Serve as a technical authority and escalation point for the Cloud Native consulting organization.
* Mentor Staff Consulting Architects, Consulting Architects, and other technical consultants.
* Conduct architecture reviews and provide technical coaching on complex customer engagements.
* Develop and deliver internal technical enablement programs covering Kubernetes, NKP, platform engineering, automation, and cloud\-native architecture.
* Define competency expectations and technical development paths for cloud\-native architects.
* Lead communities of practice and technical forums to drive knowledge sharing.
* Identify capability gaps and work with leadership to establish targeted upskilling programs.
* Promote engineering and consulting best practices across geographies and delivery teams.
* Reference Architecture, Innovation \& Thought Leadership
* Create and maintain enterprise\-grade reference architectures, design patterns, deployment frameworks, and technical playbooks for cloud\-native platforms.
* Develop reusable consulting assets that improve delivery quality, consistency, and scalability.
* Identify emerging technologies and evaluate their applicability to Nutanix cloud\-native solutions.
* Drive innovation in areas such as:
+ Kubernetes platform engineering
+ Multi\-cluster management
+ GitOps
+ AI/ML platforms
+ GPU\-enabled Kubernetes
+ Application modernization

title: Architect – AI-Powered Performance Verification Automation
description:

Today, research in artificial intelligence is booming worldwide, which calls for highly scalable and massively parallel computation horsepower that NVIDIA GPUs excel.

Come join our diverse team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world. As part of this team, you would be working on projects that will help make our next generation visual computing, automotive, GPU, HPC systems better. You will get to work on high performance CPU and Memory sub\-systems, Next\-Gen GPUs , NOC based Interconnect Fabric etc. Make the choice to join us today.
   

  

 We are looking for a motivated engineer to drive the transformation of performance verification workflows through AI and automation. In this role, you will design, develop, and deploy solutions that accelerate verification cycles, improve coverage, and reduce manual effort across hardware performance verification project lifecycles. You will be at the forefront of redefining how performance verification is done at scale — replacing repetitive manual analysis with intelligent, self\-improving automation that helps engineers focus on what matters most.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
* Automate verification workflows by building AI/ML\-based tools that generate, triage, and analyse performance test cases and results

* Integrate LLM\-based assistants into existing verification infrastructure to enable natural\-language querying of results, specs, and coverage data

* Collaborate with verification engineers to understand pain points, define automation priorities, and validate AI\-driven solutions against real\-world workflows
* Establish metrics and dashboards to measure automation impact (cycle time reduction, coverage improvement, engineer productivity)

* B.Tech/M.Tech/PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field

* Hands\-on experience with ML/AI frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit\-learn) or LLM APIs (OpenAI, NVIDIA NIM/NeMo)
* Understanding of performance verification methodologies (benchmarking, profiling, regression analysis)
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure automation


**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**
* Experience applying ML to EDA or verification problems (e.g., coverage closure, bug prediction, test generation)
* Familiarity with RAG architectures, prompt engineering, and agentic AI frameworks (LangChain, CrewAI, etc.)

title: Principal, Software Engineering
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Principal, Software Engineering
   

  

**Overview**
 In the time between when you swipe your Mastercard and you receive the approval, Authorization Decisioning has provided your transaction with more than 20 different market\-facing services—including industry leading fraud detection. Everyday Authorization Decisioning provides these same robust computational intelligence services to more than a billion transactions around the planet.
   

  

 As a Principal Software Engineer for Authorization Decisioning, you are a technical authority. You are responsible for providing a broad spectrum of technical leadership and decision making across our program and its partners in technology and product. You are a way finder. You are working across organizational lines to partner with architects, product managers, analysts, managers, and engineers to collaboratively and creatively find solutions to evolving our growing platform. You are an enabler. You are hands\-on experimenting, building, creating, guiding, and mentoring engineering teams through to seeing the realization of these solutions into production.
   

  

 Role
   

  

* Between 20\-40% individual contributor with technical team leadership. Who is recognized as a team/s technical expert within a discipline and drives innovation and organizational growth through their contributions.
* Work on complex enterprise\-wide initiatives spanning multiple services/programs and drives resolution by collaborating with business/product owners, engineers, and architects to design and deliver on new services to introduce new products and bundles
* Has skills to succinctly articulate architecture patterns of complex systems, with business and technical implications, to executive and customer stakeholders
* Responsible for the analysis, design, development and delivery of software solutions
* Defines requirements for new applications and customizations, adhering to standards, processes and best practices.
* Set priorities, objectives, and drive deliverables within global technology domains and sub\-domains and engage with the broader technical community to anticipate developments in innovation and evaluate new solutions for future business platform system requirements.
* Leverages input of partners and personal experience to make thoughtful decisions on technical direction and then has the ownership to see those decisions through
* Practice sustainable incident response and conduct blameless postmortems, taking a holistic approach to problem\-solving during production events.
* Explain technical issues and solution strategies to stakeholders, ensure timely accomplishment of technical designs and delivery milestones and liaise with stakeholders to understand business needs.


**All About You**
* You’ve made your career in designing and building high performance, high transaction volume, and globally scalable platforms.
* As an individual contributor you made your name by solving the hard problems that no one else could and as your career grew so did the complexity. You still love getting your hands dirty, but now look forward to working with your friends to solve the big stuff that no one person can solve on their own.
* Designing and crafting the best software this world has ever seen might be your favorite thing, but you know that’s not the alpha and omega of your problem set. You relish your time with the SRE, Performance Engineering, and Infrastructure teams to ensure the architectures are correct and tuned and that your teams’ code is optimized for each system.
* You know you are responsible for software that is critical financial infrastructure for multiple nation states, but you also know that you can’t be everyone all the time, so you’ve extended your ownership to ensure the SDLC and governance processes are both efficient and responsible.
* You are intelligent and industrious, but people don’t know that because you tell them. Its because they see it in the way you lead. From ideation where you make everyone’s ideas feel heard and respected all the way through to production crisis where you stick with the engineers to overcome oversights not found until the last minute. Your personal culture sets the team culture.


 Proficiencies
   

  

* Deep experience in financial services — particularly in payments industry and hands on experience designing for standard and regulatory compliance – PCI\-DSS, GDPR, etc.
* Data\-intensive designing and architecture patterns – APIs, event\-driven\-services, batch\-services, messaging systems, and big data.
* Data\-intensive programming – Java, REST API, Microservices, Kafka, Axon, MQ, and Spring.
* Cloud and DevOps Architecture – Kubernetes, Docker, and Pivotal Cloud Foundry
* Databases – Oracle, SQL server, PostgreSQL, Cassandra, ElasticSearch
* Tools – Eclipse or IntelliJ, Sonar, GIT, Maven, SQL Developer, Jenkins, CI/CD, Gatling


 Education
   

  

* Required undergraduate degree in Computer Science or in a STEM\-intensive degree program with related experience in software engineering.
* Preferred graduate degree in Computer Science or Business with related experience in fintech and payments.


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Customer Delivery Architect | 10+ years exp, SP routing platforms, architectural and validation expertise
description:
**Meet the Team**
 Customer Experience (CX) is a team of extraordinary technical experts whose \#1 focus is to deliver a premier customer experience and accelerate value realization. Our team, Solution Validation Services (SVS), is an integral part of Cisco Customer Experience, specializing in pre\-deployment solution validation, software qualification, and architectural assurance for complex, mission\-critical networks prior to Go\-Live. We help Tier\-1 Service Providers, Web/Cloud hyperscalers, and large Enterprises tackle their toughest business and operational challenges through network\-centric testing, digital twin lab simulations, and advanced test automation. Our success is proven through accelerated customer deployments, reduced operational risk, premier customer satisfaction metrics, and employee engagement excellence.
   

  

**Your Impact**
 As An Architect In SVS, You Will Provide Top\-tier Technical Leadership And Drive The Validation Strategy For Next\-generation Service Provider Networks
   

  

* Architectural Influence: Translate complex validation outcomes and testbed findings into actionable business risk mitigation strategies for C\-level and senior engineering leadership.
* Solution Validation \& Assurance: Lead end\-to\-end testing of next\-generation Service Provider routing architectures, major software releases (Cisco IOS\-XR 64\-bit), and modern transport solutions (SRv6, BGP EVPN, Routed Optical Networking) to guarantee production readiness.
* Lab Digital Twin Simulations: Build full\-scale, high\-fidelity customer simulations in world\-class SVS test laboratories to uncover, isolate, and resolve sophisticated protocol, scale, and multi\-vendor interoperability bottlenecks before production deployment.
* Test Automation Excellence: Architect and implement continuous test automation frameworks using Cisco pyATS/Genie, CXTM, and CI/CD pipelines, driving automated test coverage and accelerating project delivery velocity.
* Defect Advocacy \& Engineering Liaison: Act as the primary technical escalation authority during validation, partnering directly with Cisco Product Engineering (XR Dev, HW/Silicon teams) to triage defects, validate SMUs/patches, and ensure rapid resolution.
* Pre\-Sales \& Scoping Leadership: Partner with SVS Business Development Managers (BDMs) and Account Teams on pre\-sales scoping, developing Statements of Work (SOW), Level of Effort (LOE) models, and Joint Test Plans on Record (JTPOR).
* Talent Mentorship: Mentor, coach, and elevate the technical proficiency of consulting engineers across the global SVS organization, fostering a culture of innovation and delivery excellence.


**Decision Making \& Scope of Impact**
* Strategic Autonomy: High degree of technical autonomy: determines validation methodologies, test strategies, and architectural best practices across global SP engagements.
* Business Impact: Decisions directly impact customer Go\-Live success, network availability, multi\-million dollar project margins, and Cisco's trusted advisor standing with Tier\-1 accounts.
* Organizational Alignment: Translates global CX and SVS strategic priorities into concrete technical initiatives, testbed innovations, and delivery standards.


**Role\-Specific Responsibilities**
* Customer Architectural Engagement: Collaborate closely with customer Principal Architects, Cisco Account Teams, and CX Technical Leaders to define validation scopes, acceptance criteria, and migration test strategies.
* Deliverable Governance: Author, review, and formally approve key SVS deliverables, including Detailed Test Plans (DTP), Joint Test Plans on Record (JTPOR), Method of Procedures (MOP), and End of Test Reports (EOTR).
* Performance \& Scale Validation: Synthesize complex traffic profiles and performance benchmarks utilizing industry\-standard hardware traffic generators (Spirent TestCenter, Keysight/Ixia IxNetwork) and WAN impairment tools to validate line\-rate throughput, QoS behavior, and failover convergence.
* Automation \& Tooling Leadership: Drive the adoption of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and Test Automation as Code across SVS delivery pods, building reusable pyATS test scripts and CI/CD validation pipelines.
* Advanced Troubleshooting \& RCA: Lead root cause analysis (RCA) on sophisticated customer defects, analyzing packet captures, router debug logs, and telemetry streams to pinpoint software bugs and configuration regressions.
* Knowledge Transfer \& Assets: Champion knowledge sharing by authoring best\-practice whitepapers, test methodology playbooks, and reusable test suites to scale delivery efficiency globally.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Education \& Experience: Typically requires a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Telecommunications Engineering, or equivalent plus 10–15\+ years of relevant experience in Service Provider network design, testing, validation, or advanced technical delivery.
* Core Platform Expertise: Deep, hands\-on architectural and validation expertise in Cisco Service Provider routing platforms and network operating systems.
* Consulting \& Client Engagement: Proven experience in customer\-facing consulting, technical leadership, or solution architecture roles engaging with senior\-level decision makers.
* Certifications: Expert\-level Cisco certification (CCIE Service Provider or CCIE Enterprise/Routing \& Switching) or equivalent proven industry standing is strongly desired.
* Software \& Automation: Demonstrable foundation in software programmability and automation scripting (Python, REST APIs, JSON/YAML).
* Communication Skills: Exceptional written and verbal communication, executive presentation, and interpersonal skills with the ability to navigate ambiguous, high\-pressure environments.


**Preferred Technical Qualifications**
 Strong architectural understanding and hands\-on validation expertise across minimum two of the following SP domain areas:
   

  

* Service Provider Core \& Edge Routing Architectures (Converged SDN Transport \& RON):
* Cisco SP Platforms
* Operating Systems
* Core Routing Protocols
* Segment Routing \& Traffic Engineering
* Multi\-Service VPNs \& EVPN
* SP Network Timing \& 5G Sync
* Routed Optical Networking (RON)
* SP Resiliency \& Security
* SP Automation, Orchestration, Observability \& Tooling:
* Cisco pyATS \& Genie Test Frameworks
* SP SDN Orchestration \& Controllers
* Data Modeling \& Interfaces
* Streaming Telemetry \& Observability
* Scripting \& CI/CD Pipelines
* Test Lab Simulation, Traffic Generation \& Telco Cloud:
* Hardware Traffic Generation
* Virtualization \& Digital Twin Platforms
* SP Cloud \& Telco Infrastructure


**Leadership \& Autonomy**

title: Data architect
description:
Join us as a
 **Data Architect** 
 Barclays, responsible for supporting the successful delivery of Location Strategy projects to plan, budget, agreed quality and governance standards. You'll spearhead the evolution of our digital landscape, driving innovation and excellence. You will harness cutting\-edge technology to revolutionise our digital offerings, ensuring unparalleled customer experiences.
   

  

 To be successful as a
 **Data Architect** 
 you should have experience with: \-
   

  

  

* Design and govern end‑to‑end data architectures, covering ingestion, processing, storage, and analytics.
* Define lakehouse and distributed data processing architectures leveraging Apache Spark/Airflow on AWS (e.g. EMR / Glue).
* Establish logical and physical data models optimised for analytics and large‑scale data processing.
* Ensure architectural alignment with enterprise data standards and cloud best practices.
* Partner with data engineering teams to define Spark‑based data processing patterns for batch and large‑scale transformations.
* Guide development of Python‑based data pipelines for ingestion, transformation, and orchestration.
* Support optimisation of SQL‑based analytics, including complex queries, performance tuning, and consumption‑layer design.
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or related discipline.
* AWS certifications preferred.
* Strong experience designing Cloud‑based data platforms in enterprise environments.
* Hands‑on experience with Apache Spark, Airflow for large‑scale data processing and transformation.
* Strong programming experience in Python for data engineering and pipeline development.
* Advanced SQL skills, including:
+ Analytical queries.
+ Performance optimization.
+ Data validation and reconciliation.

* Solid understanding of data modelling, distributed data processing, and analytics workloads.


 Some other highly valued skills may include: \-
   

  

  

* Deep knowledge of AWS data services.
* S3, Glue, Athena, Redshift, EMR, Lake Formation.
* Experience designing batch and analytical processing architectures using Spark and SQL.
* Good to have Astronomer and Databricks knowledge.
* Understanding of data ingestion, hydration, curation, and consumption patterns.
* Proven experience in enterprise data architecture and governance.
* Strong understanding of data quality, lineage, metadata, and security controls.
* Experience working in regulated environments (banking / financial services preferred).
* Ability to translate business requirements into scalable Spark / SQL‑based data solutions.
* Strong stakeholder communication and architecture documentation skills.
* Comfortable operating across architecture, engineering, and delivery teams.


 You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.
   

  

 This role is based in Pune.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To design, develop, and implement solutions to complex business problems, collaborating with stakeholders to understand their needs and requirements, and design and implement solutions that meet those needs and create solutions that balance technology risks against business delivery, driving consistency.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Design and development of solutions as products that can evolve, meeting business requirements that align with modern software engineering practices and automated delivery tooling. This includes identification and implementation of the technologies and platforms.
* Targeted design activities that apply an appropriate workload placement strategy and maximise the benefit of cloud capabilities such as elasticity, serverless, containerisation etc.
* Best practice designs incorporating security principles (such as defence in depth and reduction of blast radius) that meet the Bank’s resiliency expectations.
* Solutions that appropriately balance risks and controls to deliver the agreed business and technology value.
* Adoption of standardised solutions where they fit. If no standard solutions fit, feed into their ongoing evolution where appropriate.
* Fault finding and performance issues support to operational support teams, leveraging available tooling.
* Solution design impact assessment in terms of risk, capacity and cost impact, inc. estimation of project change and ongoing run costs.
* Development of the requisite architecture inputs required to comply with the banks governance processes, including design artefacts required for architecture, privacy, security and records management governance processes.


**Assistant Vice President Expectations**
* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.


 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Solution Architect, Process Intelligence
description:
Edwards Lifesciences is expanding its global technology capabilities with the launch of a new IT Innovation Hub in Pune, India. The Hub strengthens the technology foundation that supports our business worldwide, working in close partnership with teams across regions to deliver reliable, high\-quality solutions at scale. Designed as a long\-term investment, the Pune Hub will advance newer digital capabilities such as automation, data, AI, and cloud, and will include roles spanning end user services, application development, and enterprise platform teams. Together, these teams will help Edwards operate more efficiently and accelerate innovation in support of our mission of advancing patient care.
   

  

 The Solution Architect, Process Intelligence is the senior technical owner of Edwards Lifesciences’ enterprise Process Intelligence capability on the Celonis platform. This role has end‑to‑end technical accountability across both Celonis platform pillars: Process Mining (data integration, object‑centric data models, analytical assets, and execution solutions) and Celonis Process Management (Process Designer, Navigator, and the governed process repository). The architect defines the event log architecture, ERP data extraction strategy, pipeline reliability, platform administration, and the technical standards that enable scalable, accurate, and audit‑ready process insights. While Order‑to‑Cash (O2C) is the initial scope, the architecture is designed to extend across additional enterprise process domains including Procure‑to‑Pay, manufacturing operations, and Idea‑to‑Market. This role acts as the primary knowledge transfer recipient from the Celonis SI engagement (896 hours, ending September 2026\) and serves as the India‑side technical leader for the BPM execution team. Upon SI handover, this role leads the maintenance, evolution, and scaling of the Celonis platform independently.
   

  

**How you’ll make an impact:**
* Define and maintain the enterprise event log architecture, object‑centric data models (OCDM), Perspectives, and Knowledge Model that enable process mining, conformance analysis, variant detection, and KPI measurement across enterprise processes. Own the technical design decisions that determine how business objects, events, and relationships are modeled within the platform (25%).
* Own the end‑to‑end data integration strategy from source ERP systems (Oracle JDE) into the Celonis platform, including connector configuration, extraction method selection (JDBC, REST, batch vs. real‑time), transformation scripts (PQL), data integration scheduling, and pipeline orchestration. Ensure stable, performant, and governed data flows that meet SLA requirements (20%).
* Serve as the technical owner of the Celonis Process Management (CPM) environment, including Process Designer, Navigator, and the enterprise process repository. Manage platform administration including SSO configuration, user roles and permissions, Home Site configuration, and release cycle governance. Ensure the CPM environment is operationally ready for enterprise‑scale BPMN modeling and process catalog consumption (15%).
* Serve as the primary technical counterpart to the Celonis SI team during the implementation engagement (May–September 2026\). Lead knowledge transfer activities across all SOW phases (Connect, Data Ready, Analyze, Execute, Handover) and ensure internal capability is built to sustain, operate, and evolve the platform independently post‑engagement. Shadow SI consultants during OCDM configuration, Studio asset development, and Action Flow design (15%).
* Establish and govern the data quality framework — including validation rules, reconciliation procedures, data scorecards, and root‑cause resolution workflows — to ensure mining outputs are accurate, consistent, and audit‑ready. Define acceptance criteria for event logs and analytical assets before publication to business stakeholders (10%).
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to the Process Intelligence Data Engineer (P3\), Senior Analyst, Process Excellence (P3\), and broader Pune BPM execution team. Define technical standards, conduct architecture reviews, establish reusable templates and patterns, and ensure alignment with Edwards enterprise IT governance and security requirements (10%).
* Evaluate and recommend adoption paths for emerging Celonis capabilities (e.g., Process Sphere, Action Flows, AgentC, AI‑driven insights) aligned to Edwards’ process intelligence roadmap. Configure and validate execution solutions including Action Flows and Business Apps for prioritized value opportunities (5%).


**What you’ll need (Required):**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field (Master’s preferred).
* 8\+ years of experience in data architecture, solution architecture, or analytics platform architecture roles.
* Hands‑on experience with the Celonis platform, including data integration, PQL (Process Query Language), object‑centric data modeling, and Studio asset development.
* Strong expertise in SQL, relational database design, and ERP data schemas (Oracle JDE, SAP, or equivalent).
* Experience designing and operating ETL/ELT data pipelines at enterprise scale.
* Demonstrated ability to define data governance frameworks, quality standards, and architectural documentation.
* Experience with platform administration including SSO, user provisioning, and role‑based access control.
* Ability to lead technical delivery in a global, matrixed organization and serve as a technical mentor for colleagues with less experience.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non‑technical audiences, including executive stakeholders.

description:
**Job Description**
**Shape ZenseAI.QI and ZenseAI.AssureAI**
* Architect and evolve the platform suite across both engines: the 18\-agent ZenseAI.QI stack (DeepSpeci, CaseGeni, Auto\-PlayPilot, DataGeni, Secure\-Xi, Perf\-Xi, Insights360, RIA and Accessibility Intelligence) and the four\-pillar ZenseAI.AssureAI framework (Data Quality, Model Evaluation, Trustworthiness, and Scalability \& Security).
* Design and refine the archetype\-specific assurance lifecycles for Classical ML, Generative AI and Agentic AI, including the signature eight\-axis agentic trajectory scorecard graded on every run.
* Keep the platforms LLM\-agnostic and deployable on any client stack — on\-prem, cloud or hybrid — as model\-mixing and constant provider churn become the market norm.
* Own technical roadmap decisions for accelerators such as the Agentic Foundry (a 25\-blueprint reference matrix) and the curated, swap\-ready tooling ecosystem around each archetype.


**Lead Evaluation\-Driven Development**

title: Senior ML Platform Engineer
description:
**Sr. Engineer – AI Data Platform \| ML Infrastructure \& Evaluation** 




**Location: Viman Nagar, Pune (Hybrid 3 days)** 




**Experience: 7\+ years** 




  





 We are looking for a Senior Engineer to build and operate ML infrastructure focused on model evaluation, regression detection, observability, and production AI monitoring.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 You will work on the engineering systems that evaluate AI models, identify model and pipeline regressions before production, monitor model behavior after deployment, and provide measurable signals around accuracy, reliability, drift, and inference cost.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 • Build and maintain a three\-tier ML evaluation framework covering component\-level benchmarking, end\-to\-end pipeline evaluation, and longitudinal performance analysis.
 



 • Manage versioned test sets and implement regression detection for model and pipeline changes.
 



 • Maintain and improve multimodal AI evaluation and debugging infrastructure.
 



 • Build and operate production model observability using monitoring, tracing, alerting, and performance signals.
 



 • Instrument training and inference pipelines to make model behavior measurable end to end.
 



 • Build and maintain drift detection, false\-positive management, confidence scoring, and model\-quality monitoring pipelines.
 



 • Implement regression testing that identifies differences between household\-specific performance and aggregate benchmarks.
 



 • Build cost monitoring for ML workloads and identify factors affecting inference cost, latency, and model performance.
 



 • Investigate model\-quality issues and contribute to root\-cause analysis and platform health reporting.
 



 • Work with Computer Vision, AI Platform, and Agentic AI teams to define evaluation and observability requirements for new model generations.
 



 • Contribute to code reviews, automated testing, engineering standards, and ML infrastructure design practices.
 



  





**What We’re Looking For** 




 • 5\+ years of software engineering experience with strong production\-quality Python skills.
 



 • Hands\-on experience building or operating ML infrastructure, MLOps, model evaluation, monitoring, or observability systems.
 



 • Experience building or operating model evaluation or regression\-detection systems in production.
 



 • Strong understanding of the ML lifecycle: training → evaluation → deployment → monitoring.
 



 • Experience with production ML platforms and real operational constraints.
 



 • Hands\-on experience with tools such as MLflow, Weights \& Biases/Weave, Datadog, or equivalent platforms.
 



 • Strong understanding of automated testing, system design, code reviews, and production software engineering.
 



  





**Good to Have** 




 • Computer Vision, Video AI, VLM, LLM evaluation, or multimodal AI experience.
 



 • Experience with video or event\-based AI pipelines.
 



 • Experience with model monitoring, drift detection, model serving, or inference optimization.
 



 • Experience with IoT, smart\-home, connected devices, robotics, or consumer technology products.
 



 • AWS ML experience or AWS Machine Learning certification.

title: Associate Director_3367
description:
**About The Job**
 The AI Factory is a central delivery unit at Allianz Technology that builds and deploys AI\-powered solutions across the Allianz Group. It runs four pillars, Personal Productivity, AI\-Native Ways of Working, Application Rebuild \& Modernization, and AI Use Case Delivery, on top of a shared AI platform ecosystem that provides the runtime, governance, observability, and reusable building blocks every solution runs on.
   

  

 The AI Factory Lead India will head the AI Factory's India team members in India: AI Engagement Managers who shape and steer OE engagements, Forward Deployed Engineers who build and ship the underlying solutions, and AI Platform Engineers who build and operate the shared AI platform every solution runs on. Together they turn OE and Group pain points into deliverable, funded AI projects through a defined lifecycle from Idea to Handover, backed by a growing library of reusable AI building blocks that turn one OE's solution into the next OE's head start. The AI Factory Lead India will also bridge the end\-to\-end delivery, setting priorities across concurrent engagements, growing and coaching AI Engagement Managers, Forward Deployed Engineers, and AI Platform Engineers, and acting as the senior escalation point with AI Factory, Allianz Technology leadership, Heads of ITs', and Account Managers. The role balances demand shaping and delivery execution with platform health, and represents the India team within Allianz Technology's global AI Factory leadership.
   

  

**What You Do**
* Lead and grow the India AI Factory team \- AI Engagement Managers, Forward Deployed Engineers, and AI Platform Engineers and other AI roles \- setting priorities across concurrent OE engagements.
* Coach and develop team members; manage workload distribution, performance, hiring, and career growth across all three disciplines.
* Own the Factory's India delivery portfolio: sequence engagements, resolve cross\-team resource conflicts, and ensure reusable patterns (MVS, AI Building Blocks, platform capabilities) flow between projects.
* Act as the senior escalation point and relationship owner with OE leadership, Heads of IT, and Account Managers, unblocking engagements Engagement Managers cannot resolve alone.
* Own the India team's overall demand pipeline; prioritize opportunities, allocate Engagement Managers, and balance qualification, delivery, and run\-support work across concurrent engagements.
* Represent the AI Factory in governance forums, portfolio reviews, and budget and resourcing conversations with senior stakeholders, up to CTO and Board level where required.
* Ensure the AI Platform Engineers' roadmap (runtime, governance, FinOps, observability) reflects needs surfaced by live engagements.
* Champion reuse: ensure Forward Deployed Engineers contribute new patterns back to the central building\-block catalogue and Engagement Managers factor reuse into scoping.
* Own the build\-to\-run handover model \- including support models, SLAs/OLAs, runbooks, and MLOps/monitoring \- and maintain oversight of security, compliance, and responsible\-AI standards across all Factory deliverables.
* Track Factory\-wide KPIs (time\-to\-value, reuse rate, delivery predictability, platform cost and reliability) and drive continuous improvement.


**What You Bring**
* Proven experience leading multi\-disciplinary technical teams (delivery/engagement, engineering, and platform functions) in large, matrix organizations, ideally in insurance or another regulated environment; knowledge of Allianz Group and Allianz Technology is a plus.
* People management track record: hiring, coaching, performance management, and career development across senior technical and delivery roles.
* Senior enough for OE leadership and Head of IT conversations, technical enough to challenge scope and platform decisions honestly.
* Strong stakeholder, business\-framing, and roadmap\-shaping skills, with the ability to prepare clear decision materials for executive audiences.
* Experience running a delivery portfolio: demand shaping, prioritization, resourcing, budget ownership, and risk management across concurrent engagements.
* An entrepreneurial mindset: comfortable taking ownership and driving topics forward in a build\-up environment without waiting for perfect structure.
* A degree in business, management, technology, or a related field.
* Fluent in English.


 Not Expected To Hands\-on Build Or Hold Formal Certifications (e.g., TOGAF, Zachman) \- Working Knowledge Of The Following Is Needed To Guide Trade\-offs, Hold Credible Technical Conversations With The Team, And Challenge Or Support Architectural And Platform Decisions
   

  

* Enterprise and solution architecture concepts \- technical blueprints, reusable solution frameworks, AI reference architectures, and integration standards.
* GenAI\-enabled capabilities such as intelligent assistants, copilots, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), agents, and automation pipelines.
* Architecture patterns for multi\-system integration, API orchestration, and data harmonization.
* Cloud\-native platforms and services on at least one major hyperscaler (Azure, AWS, or GCP).
* The modern AI/data stack \- vector databases, embedding stores, agentic frameworks, orchestration tools, and LLM/agent framework integration.
* AI governance and responsible\-AI principles, including model governance, data lineage, and auditability.
* Solution lifecycle management and reuse practices (MVS, AI Building Blocks) across sandbox, standardization, and retirement stages.


**What We Offer**
* We offer a hybrid work model which recognizes the value of striking a balance between in\-person collaboration and remote working, including up to 25 days per year working from abroad.
* We believe in rewarding performance and our compensation and benefits package includes a company bonus scheme, pension, employee shares program and multiple employee discounts (details vary by location).
* From career development and digital learning programs to international career mobility, we offer lifelong learning for our employees worldwide and an environment where innovation, delivery and empowerment are fostered.
* Flexible working, health and wellbeing offers (including healthcare and parental leave benefits) support to balance family and career and help our people return from career breaks with experience that nothing else can teach.


**About Allianz Technology**
 With its headquarters in Munich, Germany, Allianz Technology is Allianz's global IT service provider and delivers IT solutions that drive the group's digitalization. With more than 11,000 employees in over 20 countries around the world, Allianz Technology is tasked with running, optimizing, transforming, and innovating the infrastructure, applications, and services together with Allianz companies to co\-create the best customer experience.
   

  

 We service the entire spectrum of digitalization, from one of the industry's largest IT infrastructure projects that spans data centres, networks, and security, to application platforms ranging from workplace services to digital interaction. In short: We deliver comprehensive end\-to\-end IT solutions for Allianz in the digital age. We are the backbone of Allianz. Find us at: www.linkedin.com/company/allianz\-technology.
   

  

**Commitment to Integrity, Fairness \& Inclusion**
 Allianz Technology is proud to be an equal opportunity employer dedicated to fostering an inclusive work environment for everyone. We embrace individuals of all gender identities and expressions, sexual orientations, ethnicities, ages, nationalities, religions, disabilities, and philosophies of life. Our greatest strength as a company lies in the unique skills, experiences, and backgrounds our employees contribute.
   

  

 Allianz Group is one of the most trusted insurance and asset management companies in the world. Caring for our employees, their ambitions, dreams and challenges is what makes us a unique employer. We are united by a shared commitment: to put our customers first and at the center of everything we do. Their needs inspire our thinking and guide our actions. Together, we can build an environment where everyone feels empowered and confident to explore, grow and shape a better future – for our customers and for the world around us.
   

  

 At Allianz, we stand for unity: we believe that a united world is a more prosperous world, and we are dedicated to consistently advocating for equal opportunities for all. The foundation for this is our inclusive workplace, where people and performance both matter, and where integrity, fairness, inclusion and trust are at the heart of our culture. We therefore welcome applications regardless of race, ethnicity or cultural background, age, gender, nationality, religion, social class, disability or sexual orientation, or any other characteristics protected under applicable local laws and regulations.
   

  

 Join us.
 **Let's care for tomorrow.**
**Note:** 
 Having different strengths, experiences, perspectives and approaches is an integral part of Allianz‘ company culture. One means to achieve this is a regular rotation of Allianz employees across functions, Allianz entities and geographies. Therefore, Allianz expects from its employees a general openness and a high motivation to regularly change positions and collect experiences across Allianz Group.

 You

title: Planisware Architect
description:
**Job Description**
**Job Title:** 
 Planisware Architect
   

  

**Location: Pune, India**
**Company Overview**
**About SLB**
 SLB is the world's leading provider of technology for reservoir characterization, drilling, production, and processing to the oil and gas industry. Working in more than 85 countries and employing approximately 100,000 people who represent over 140 nationalities, SLB supplies the industry's most comprehensive range of products and services, from exploration through production and integrated pore\-to\-pipeline solutions for hydrocarbon recovery that optimize reservoir performance. Visit www.slb.com for more information.
   

  

 We are a global technology company driving energy innovation for a balanced planet. Together, we create amazing technology that unlocks access to energy for the benefit of all. Our inclusive culture is the key to our success. We collaborate with our internal community of colleagues, alumni, and our valued external partners to support each other and achieve our goals. We aim to raise the bar high. We look for people who are committed to innovation and success and act with integrity to become and be a part of one of the most diverse group of experts in our industry, anywhere around the globe. Global in outlook, and local in practice, we're united in our passion for discovering solutions and in our commitment to creating a sustainable and balanced future. We set the bar high. So we’re looking for talented, driven people committed to innovation and success and who act with integrity. We'll give you a platform to develop both professionally and personally, supported by our community of colleagues, co\-workers, alumni, and our valued external partners. It's a deep collaboration that enables us all to achieve our goals. Come and be part of one of the world’s most diverse and inclusive groups of industry experts.
   

  

**About SLB India Technology Center**
 SLB has embarked on a corporate transformation to deliver a step change in the reliability, efficiency and integration of our technologies, products and services. Advanced technologies are key enablers to this and encompass all aspects of business systems, including the organization platform and processes. Investments in, and building strong competences across our technology pillars – IT Central, SAP, Cyber Security, Digital Enterprise Systems, Data and Analytics, Digital Operations, Architecture and Integration, and Governance and Performance are key to an integrated digital that is positioned to deliver superior results. The SLB India Technology Center has a fundamental and critical role in this corporate transformation and for delivering digital solutions to the larger SLB organization.
   

  

**About Role**
 Slb has an opening in Coimbatore / Pune, India and Bogota, Columbia for a Technical Lead who will work on the Development / configuration for all modules / capabilities, changes and bug fixes related to Planisware and Microsoft .Net suite of applications in the Product and Service Delivery Function under Enterprise Solutions.
   

  

 The end users supported are the global community in Slb using these systems. Both L1 support and L2 support is provided in\-house while L3 Development and Support is outsourced to vendors.
   

  

 This role will work closely with the Scrum team on defining / change requirements and align with the development team (L3, vendors) for technical design and effort validation. Further, he/she will define periodic release plans and release schedules in coordination with the domain teams and the L3 vendor while being supervised by the Chief Scrum Master. He / she would manage the execution of release activities and co\-ordinate with the L3 development teams to ensure releases are delivered on time and within budget.
   

  

 Key responsibilities
   

  

 Technical Responsibilities
   

  

* Solution Design \& Architecture: Lead the design and architecture of standard as well as customized Planisware solution to address Project Management needs/Stakeholders
* Strategic Alignment: Work with product management and IT leadership to align Planisware functionality with business strategies and project goals.
* Obtain business requirements and use cases / user stories from Product and Service Delivery, Supply, Distribution and Operation Planning Domains for all enhancements. Validate all such requirements and articulate to the L3 teams
* Customization Framework: Define best practices and frameworks for customizing Planisware to meet the evolving needs of the business.
* Integration Strategy: Develop and implement integration strategies to connect Planisware with other enterprise systems. Optimizing the API calls to minimize the performance issues \& Cost.
* Governance \& Best Practices: Establish governance around Planisware usage, ensuring the platform is optimized for scalability, security, and performance.
* Performance Tuning: Monitor system performance, ensuring efficient use of resources, and troubleshoot issues as they arise.
* Technical Leadership: Provide guidance and mentorship to development teams, ensuring high\-quality deliverables Serve as a SPOC to the L3 inhouse / vendor development team and coordinate all development and testing activities. Help development team to understand the error causes on production environment
* Review and get technical feasibility validation of the technical design provided by L3 for the change requests.
* Ensure adoption of Scrum in the development process. Also ensure DevOps is adopted within the team efficiently
* Work on roll\-back scenarios and identify cases where roll\-backs are necessary


 Release Management
   

  

* Assist the Technical Team in the design and development of the release management process
* Expertise in various PLW modules, including Oscar and PMGo modules.
* Proven experience in designing and deploying Planisware for large\-scale organizations, particularly in product or project management. Familiarity with enterprise architecture and software development life cycle (SDLC) methodologies
* Manage risks and resolves issues that affect release scope, schedule and quality
* Ensure technical documentation is kept up to date by the development team
* Proactively identify and implement procedures to streamline the build process which may drive the development and maintenance of an automated build process
* Periodically reports performance metric dashboard for releases handled. Communicate release details and schedules to the Domains as required


**Essential Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or related field
* 10\+ years of overall support/development experience, of which 5 \+ years on Planisware.
* Planisware Certification – Specialist OR Expert
* 4\+ years in Change and Release Management
* 3 to 4 years of experience building on Web apps / Desktop Apps using technologies like React, Angular, Java ASP.NET, etc.
* Good understanding of consuming APIs through Single Page Application (SPA).
* Good exposure to database technologies like Oracle, MS SQL Server, etc.


**Key competencies**
* In\-depth knowledge of the change management process working on the change and release module
* Should have a thorough understanding and working knowledge of ITIL processes including Application Change and Release Management
* Experience working on multiple releases/projects as a subject matter expert and as a technical leader. Should have worked on complex projects that require expertise across multiple disciples and environments
* Very good understanding around building Planisware based solution and Integration / data migration processes
* Experience working in an Agile/Scrum/Kanban environment
* Good knowledge of Azure IaaS / PaaS
* Very good experience of version management.
* Experience of providing overall process improvements adopting to the release process
* Advanced knowledge of Software Development Lifecycle
* Preferred experience in Oil \& Gas industry (though not mandatory)


**Other Skills And Abilities**
* Self\-driven, Proactive, Systems Thinking
* Open to travel abroad and in India
* Comfortable working occasional extended hours demanded by emergency release
* Exposure to Performance Tuning (Tuning concepts \- indexes, segments, partitions, query tuning) of database systems would be an added advantage
* Works well with all personality types
