title: Principal, Enterprise Arch
description:
**About Northern Trust**
 As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
   

  

 Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
   

  

 With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
   

  

 The Principal Enterprise Architect is responsible for defining and advancing architecture for Global Engineering. The candidate will be a key member of the Global Engineering Architecture team whose collective responsibility is to enable system development through aligned enterprise strategies, roadmaps, golden paths, reference architectures, design patterns, standards, and governance frameworks. This role will partner with executives, enterprise architects, solution architects, application development teams, platform engineering, data, security, and the business. Must demonstrate a proven history of shaping large\-scale technology solutions that address the business objectives of a complex global organization. Ensures that business strategy, market trends, technology evolution, and AI\-enabled opportunities are effectively represented in the organization’s systems, platforms, data architecture, and business processes. Analyzes architectural requirements, defines the vision and target\-state architecture, assesses the current state, establishes transformation roadmaps, governs the project portfolio, and partners with solution architects and engineers to realize the target state.
   

  

 This individual must be delivery\-oriented, enterprise\-minded, and able to influence across senior business, technology, risk, security, and engineering audiences. Must be able to guide strategic direction and make pragmatic decisions that optimize business value, engineering velocity, resiliency, cost, security, regulatory expectations, and risk. Identify reusable platforms, shared engineering capabilities, overlapping functions, and opportunities to converge on standards in order to improve efficiency, quality, developer experience, and time to value across Global Engineering. The preferred candidate will have a broad background in enterprise architecture, application development, cloud\-native delivery, integration, data architecture, AI\-enabled solutions, platform engineering, security, and architecture governance. Must be able to work independently to solve complex problems, create and manage technology roadmaps, and collaborate effectively with a diverse set of partners.
   

  

**Knowledge / Skills**
* Previous or current hands\-on software development experience using modern application development frameworks such as Java/Spring, JavaScript/ReactJS, APIs, cloud\-native services, and engineering automation.
* Significant experience with enterprise architecture patterns, architecture governance, capability modeling, target\-state definition, and enterprise architecture best practices.
* Hands on experience designing and building of cloud\-native architectures; preference using Azure, AWS, Tanzu, and/or Kubernetes
* Deep knowledge of API and microservice style architectures
* Experience shaping AI\-enabled architecture strategies, including generative AI, agentic AI, machine learning, model lifecycle management, prompt and context engineering, retrieval\-augmented generation, and integration of AI capabilities into enterprise platforms.
* Strong understanding of responsible AI, AI risk management, model governance, explainability, data privacy, security controls, regulatory considerations, and production observability for AI\-enabled systems.
* Experience using API Management Platforms and Storefronts (e.g. APIGEE, Software AG, etc)
* Experience using Kafka, Solace, and/or MQ for messaging/event streaming
* Deep knowledge of architecture frameworks such as TOGAF and/or Zachman, with the ability to apply frameworks pragmatically across business, application, data, technology, security, cloud, and AI architecture domains.
* Experience with SQL, NoSQL, data platforms, metadata, data quality, lineage, and governance capabilities required to support analytics, AI, and enterprise\-scale decisioning; e.g. Oracle, Postgres, MySQL, SQL Server, Mongo, data lakehouse, and cloud data services.
* Knowledge of software development methodologies and tools such as Agile, product\-oriented delivery, Github, GH Copilot, ADO Boards, Maven/Gradle, CI/CD (Actions), MLOps, LLMOps, and architecture\-as\-code practices.
* Experience with DevOps best practices and toolchain / pipeline automation, Azure DevOps and Atlassian Suite preferred
* Knowledge of the financial services industry and in particular, a broad and deep understanding of products and services provided by Northern Trust.
* Has an understanding of Global Engineering domains, enterprise platforms, software delivery practices, developer experience, cloud enablement, integration, data, security, and operational resiliency in a large financial services environment.
* Strong knowledge of security frameworks and controls.


**Major Duties**
* Define enterprise architecture strategies and target\-state roadmaps that provide business value while reducing complexity, technical debt, operational risk, and duplicated capabilities.
* Mediate conflicting priorities to drive optimal solutions.
* Identify and escalate duplication of effort, functional and technical redundancy, and opportunities to reuse Global Engineering platforms, standards, and shared enterprise capabilities.
* Create reference architectures and reusable patterns for common archetypes, including web, microservice, mobile, third\-party platforms, cloud\-native services, data platforms, AI\-enabled applications, and automation solutions.
* Quickly build proof of concept prototypes with new technologies being researched.
* Establish AI architecture guardrails, responsible AI design patterns, model governance expectations, data readiness criteria, and production readiness standards for AI\-enabled solutions.
* Partner with platform engineering, data, security, risk, and application teams to integrate AI capabilities safely into enterprise platforms and business processes.
* Enable the development organization by creating working examples
* Create cloud, platform, data, and AI\-related frameworks that embed non\-functional requirements, including resiliency, observability, security, privacy, performance, scalability, cost management, and operational supportability.
* Define cloud, platform engineering, DevSecOps, data, and AI delivery best practices for Global Engineering.
* Training technologists and provide project\-based consulting/expertise
* Liaise with Enterprise Architecture, Global Engineering, Security, Data, Risk, Infrastructure, and application delivery groups to align architecture direction and execution.
* Solve problems collaboratively.
* Act as a subject matter expert on technologies and trends in enterprise architecture, cloud, platform engineering, middleware, data, security, infrastructure, generative AI, and AI\-enabled automation.


**Qualifications**
* Minimum 12\+ years of technology experience across application development, engineering, architecture, platform, data, cloud, or related disciplines.
* Minimum 8\+ years of enterprise, solution, domain, or platform architecture experience, with demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and govern architecture decisions at scale.
* Demonstrated experience applying AI, data, automation, cloud, and platform architecture concepts to enterprise transformation, including responsible AI and AI governance considerations.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience; MBA or Master’s degree preferred


**Working with Us**
 As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
   

  

 Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
   

  

**Reasonable Accommodation**
 Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.
   

  

**About Our Pune Office**
 The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.
   

  

 Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000\+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Principal Engineer, Real\-time Payments (Technology \& Architecture)
   

  

 Principal Engineer, Real time Payments (Technology \& Architecture)
   

  

**Overview**
 The Real time Payments (RTP) program is driving the global shift toward instant, account to account payments, enabling secure, low latency, and highly resilient payment services across multiple live markets worldwide.
   

  

 RTP platforms operate as mission critical financial infrastructure, supporting high transaction volumes, strict regulatory expectations, and near zero downtime requirements. The program spans multiple products and shared services, deployed across diverse market and customer environments, while adhering to Mastercard’s enterprise architecture, security, and operational standards.
   

  

 Engineering within RTP is focused not only on feature delivery, but on building scalable, resilient platforms that can evolve safely over time—through strong architecture, disciplined engineering practices, and a relentless focus on non functional excellence.
   

  

 Role
   

  

 We are seeking a Principal Engineer to provide hands on technical execution and architecture \& technology leadership for multiple Real\-time Payments products and platform capabilities across multiple markets.
   

  

 This is a senior individual contributor role for a deeply experienced engineer who:
   

  

* Owns the design and implementation of complex services or subsystems
* Stays close to the code on complex and high risk areas
* Is deeply hands‑on and leads by technical design \& architecture excellence
* Contributes \& drives architecture and product design aspects
* Owns key technology \& implementation decisions including all non\-functional aspects across performance, scalability, reliability, security, and observability


 The role combines strong technical depth with engineering leadership with end‑to‑end ownership for delivery quality, correctness, and maintainability in their area of responsibility.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 The role spans five core dimensions, with ownership across end to end technical outcomes.
   

  

* Design \& Technical Execution
* Own the architecture and detailed design for one or more RTP products or platform capabilities across markets.
* Define and enforce reference architectures, design patterns, and engineering standards (e.g., microservices, event driven architecture, domain driven design).
* Design, build, and maintain high‑quality software components and services for RTP products.
* Lead and participate in technical design reviews, ensuring alignment with RTP and enterprise architecture principles.
* Make clear, well reasoned technology and design trade offs, balancing delivery speed, risk, and long term maintainability.
* Own end‑to‑end delivery of complex features or subsystems, from design through production.
* Translate functional and non‑functional requirements into robust technical implementations.
* Ensure solutions adhere to RTP architecture standards and engineering best practices.
* Hands‑on Engineering \& Code Quality
* Remain hands on for critical components, complex problem areas, prototypes, and reference implementations.
* Lead by example in code quality, testing discipline, and maintainable design.
* Perform and participate in code reviews, raising the bar for engineering quality.
* Drive high quality implementations for low latency, high throughput, distributed systems.
* Support teams in solving deep technical problems across application, messaging, data, and platform layers.
* Non Functional Excellence (NFR Ownership)
* Design and implement solutions that meet defined performance, scalability, reliability, and security requirements.
* Define and enforce measurable non functional requirements, SLIs, and SLOs.
* Ensure production readiness through strong observability (metrics, logs, traces), capacity planning, and failure mode design.
* Proactively identify and remediate architectural, capacity, and resilience risks.
* Support performance testing, capacity validation, and production readiness activities.
* Actively participate in incident analysis and remediation when issues arise.
* Cross Market Consistency \& Platform Evolution
* Drive cross market alignment, preventing architectural and Technology drift and duplicated solutions.
* Promote reuse of patterns, components, and learnings across RTP markets and shared services.
* Contribute to and influence the technology roadmap, including platform evergreening and technical debt reduction.
* Act as a trusted technical partner to product, operations, and governance forums.
* Engineering Leadership \& Bar Raising
* Mentor senior engineers and technical leads; raise the quality of design reviews, code reviews, and technical decision making.
* Influence engineering culture toward ownership, quality, and operational excellence.
* Support hiring and technical assessments, helping set the bar for senior technical talent.
* Communicate complex technical topics clearly to both technical and non technical stakeholders.


**All About You**
 Experience \& Technical Expertise
   

  

* 10\+ years of experience in software engineering, with significant time spent designing and building distributed systems at scale.
* Proven experience owning architecture and design for complex, business critical platforms.
* Strong hands on expertise with microservices and event driven architectures.
* Deep understanding of performance engineering, scalability patterns, resilience design, and failure handling.
* Solid experience with observability, production diagnostics, and operational readiness.


 Technology Breadth
   

  

* Strong background in enterprise backend development with hands\-on experience across object\-oriented \& functional programming languages \- Java/Spring, React, Angular, Erlang

**Infrastructure Automation Engineer (DevSecOps) – Azure, Kubernetes \& Terraform**
**Experience:** 
 6–9 years
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We are seeking experienced and hands\-on Senior Infrastructure Automation Engineers (DevSecOps) with strong proficiency in Azure and Kubernetes to design, provision, automate, secure, and support scalable multicloud infrastructure for enterprise workloads.
   

  

 The role requires deep expertise in Infrastructure as Code with Terraform, container orchestration on Kubernetes, automated CI/CD pipeline engineering, Python\-based infrastructure automation, and embedding security controls across the build, deploy, and run lifecycle, with a strong focus on reliability, compliance, cost\-awareness, and delivery quality.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design, provision, and manage scalable multicloud infrastructure with Azure as the primary platform and AWS as the secondary platform.
* Architect and operate production\-grade Kubernetes clusters (AKS / EKS / self\-managed) covering deployments, scaling, networking, ingress, secrets, RBAC, upgrades, and operational troubleshooting.
* Implement and govern Infrastructure as Code using Terraform — module design, remote state, workspaces, policy\-as\-code, and reusable platform components for repeatable, secure, and auditable deployments.
* Build, maintain, and optimize end\-to\-end CI/CD pipelines for application and infrastructure delivery, including build, test, scan, approval, and progressive deployment workflows.
* Develop Python\-based automation, tooling, and operators to streamline provisioning, configuration, remediation, and day\-2 operations across cloud platforms.
* Embed DevSecOps practices across the SDLC — SAST, DAST, SCA, container image scanning, IaC scanning, secrets management, and policy\-as\-code (OPA / Sentinel / Kyverno).
* Integrate cloud infrastructure with enterprise networking, IAM, security, monitoring, logging, and DevOps toolchains in line with enterprise standards.
* Monitor platform health, lead incident response, perform root cause analysis, and drive continuous service and reliability improvements.
* Ensure infrastructure is resilient, secure, compliant, cost\-aware, and aligned with enterprise architecture, security baselines, and operational standards.
* Mentor junior engineers, lead technical reviews, and contribute to platform engineering standards, runbooks, and reference architectures.


**Required Skills And Experience**
* 6\+ years of overall experience in cloud infrastructure engineering, DevOps, DevSecOps, or platform engineering, with at least 3\+ years in a senior or lead capacity.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Azure services (AKS, VNet, Azure AD / Entra ID, Key Vault, Storage, Monitor, Policy, Azure DevOps); working knowledge of AWS services (EKS, EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, CloudWatch) as the secondary platform.
* Deep, production\-grade experience with Kubernetes and the broader container ecosystem (Docker, Helm, Istio / service mesh, ingress controllers, operators).
* Strong expertise in Terraform — module development, state management, multi\-environment patterns, and integration with policy\-as\-code frameworks.
* Proven experience designing and operating CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent, including pipeline security and supply\-chain controls.
* Strong proficiency in Python for infrastructure automation, tooling, and integration; working knowledge of Bash / Shell scripting.
* Solid grounding in cloud security — IAM, network segmentation, encryption, secrets management, vulnerability management, and DevSecOps tooling (e.g., Trivy, Checkov, tfsec, SonarQube, Snyk, Aqua / Prisma Cloud).
* Good understanding of cloud networking, hybrid connectivity, load balancing, observability, logging, and access controls.
* Demonstrated experience troubleshooting complex infrastructure issues, deployment failures, distributed systems, and performance bottlenecks.
* Strong awareness of cloud governance, compliance frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2, CIS Benchmarks), cost optimization, and operational best practices.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, documentation, collaboration, and stakeholder communication skills.


**Qualification and Certifications**
* B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* One or more relevant certifications strongly preferred — Microsoft Azure (AZ\-104 / AZ\-305 / AZ\-400\), CKA / CKAD / CKS, HashiCorp Terraform Associate, AWS Solutions Architect / DevOps Engineer, or recognized security certifications (CCSK, CompTIA Security\+).
* Strong commitment to continuous learning and staying current with cloud, DevSecOps, Kubernetes, and platform engineering practices.


**Good\-to\-Have Skills**
* Exposure to GCP and broader multi\-cloud operating models.
* Experience with policy\-as\-code and guardrails (OPA / Gatekeeper, Kyverno, Azure Policy, Sentinel).
* Experience with service mesh, GitOps tooling (ArgoCD, Flux), and progressive delivery patterns.
* Experience with monitoring and observability stacks such as Prometheus, Grafana, Azure Monitor, CloudWatch, ELK, Datadog, or Dynatrace.
* Experience with Azure Cost Management, AWS Cost Explorer, tagging strategies, and FinOps practices.
* Exposure to platform engineering, internal developer platforms (IDP), release management, and SRE practices.


**Working Expectations**
* Collaborate effectively with architecture, engineering, security, application, and operations teams across geographies.
* Maintain clear, version\-controlled documentation for infrastructure design, deployment steps, SOPs, runbooks, and automation scripts.
* Demonstrate strong ownership in resolving issues, improving reliability, hardening security posture, and enhancing automation across cloud platforms.
* Follow enterprise delivery standards, security controls, change and operational procedures, and quality expectations.
* Provide technical mentorship and act as an escalation point for complex infrastructure, automation, and security challenges.

**About The Job**
 The Globalization Experience Team is searching for an Internationalization Software Engineer responsible for creating, enhancing, and maintaining robust software and tooling so SAS products work correctly for global users across languages, locales, and character sets. This role focuses on building and integrating foundational internationalization capabilities—Unicode correctness, locale‑sensitive formatting and sorting, and string externalization/resource management—while partnering with product teams to embed best practices early in the software development cycle. You’ll also use AI\-assisted techniques (when appropriate) to accelerate analysis, automation, and documentation, helping teams deliver global\-ready software efficiently and consistently.
   

  

**As An Internationalization AI Software Developer, You Will**
* Design, develop, and maintain software, libraries, and tooling that enable product teams to efficiently build high‑quality, global‑ready software in compliance with SAS Internationalization guidelines and standards.
* Work effectively in mature and legacy code to resolve customer\-impacting defects, coordinating with support and product teams to deliver patch updates for high\-priority fixes with strong testing and regression awareness to protect production behavior
* Partner closely with cross‑functional stakeholders—including product development teams, product managers, project managers, support engineers, and testers—to integrate internationalization best practices early and throughout the software development lifecycle.
* Collaborate with internationalization testers to guide testing strategies, investigate defects, and drive engineering improvements that result in high‑quality, globally usable product deliverables.
* Use AI\-assisted tools responsibly as part of day‑to‑day engineering (e.g., accelerating code review and refactoring suggestions, log/defect triage, test generation, and documentation) while ensuring correctness, traceability, and alignment with SAS development standards.


**Required Qualifications**

* Experience using modern developer productivity tools (including AI\-assisted coding and review tools) to improve delivery speed and quality, with an understanding of validation practices (tests, reviews, and responsible use).
* Proficiency in one or more of the following programming languages: Go, Python, and C, with the ability to read, understand, and contribute to production codebases.
* Working proficiency in shell scripting (e.g., Bash or similar) to support automation, tooling, or development workflows.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across cross‑functional teams including developers, testers, and product stakeholders.
* Hands‑on experience using GitHub in a team environment, including branching strategies, pull requests, and code review processes.
* Experience using Jira and Confluence as part of an Agile development process, including issue tracking, planning, and documentation.
* Ability to adjust working hours to accommodate a variety of time zones
* You’re curious, passionate, authentic and accountable. These are our values and influence everything we do.


**Additional Competencies, Knowledge And Skills**
* Experience with SAS programming or familiarity with SAS language, tools, or development environments.
* Experience with TypeScript and Java Script a plus.
* Experience working with CI/CD pipelines, including build, test, or deployment automation.
* Proficiency in additional spoken language.

title: Staff Engineer
description:
**Hungry, Humble, Honest, with Heart.**
**The Opportunity**
 We are seeking a Staff\-level Software Engineer with deep expertise in system security, Kubernetes internals, network security, Linux security, and distributed storage. In this high\-impact role, you will be the primary technical driver for building secure\-by\-default features for the NKP and CN\-AOS platforms.
   

  

 You will design secure\-by\-default architectures, develop Kubernetes Custom Resource Definitions (CRDs) and operators, and ensure our Container Storage Interface (CSI) implementations are hardened against modern attack vectors while effortlessly serving enterprise and AI workloads.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The NKP (Nutanix Kubertenes Platform) team is building an enterprise\-grade management platform for the containerized world. We are developing a fully cloud\-native architecture designed to securely deploy, run, and manage Kubernetes clusters seamlessly across any hybrid or multi\-cloud environment.
   

  

**Your Role**
 We are seeking a Staff\-level Software Engineer with deep expertise in system security, Kubernetes internals, network security, Linux security, and distributed storage. In this high\-impact role, you will be the primary technical driver for building secure\-by\-default features for the NKP and CN\-AOS platforms.
   

  

 You will design secure\-by\-default architectures, develop Kubernetes Custom Resource Definitions (CRDs) and operators, and ensure our Container Storage Interface (CSI) implementations are hardened against modern attack vectors while effortlessly serving enterprise and AI workloads.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities.**
 Cloud\-Native Development: Design and build advanced Kubernetes Controllers, Operators, and CRDs in Golang to natively orchestrate and secure storage workloads.
   

  

**Platform Hardening, Network \& Container Security**
* Implement and manage Kubernetes Network Policies for micro\-segmentation and least\-privilege communication.
* Configure and enforce OpenShift Security Context Constraints (SCCs) and Multi\-Category Security (MCS).
* Deploy and operate Container Security Operators for continuous vulnerability scanning of running pods and images.
* Build platform functionality for image scanning, signing, and policy enforcement Advanced Cluster Security for runtime threat detection, compliance monitoring, and network policy enforcement.
* Drive platform compliance with CIS benchmarks (Kubernetes and Linux), FIPS, and zero\-trust guidelines.
* Distributed Systems Engineering: Tackle complex problems in large\-scale distributed systems, focusing on performance, scaling out, and resiliency.
* Technical Leadership: Drive architectural reviews, establish secure coding standards, and mentor junior and mid\-level engineers to act as a technical force multiplier.


**What You Will Bring**
* Experience: 12\+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 3\+ years focused on building scalable distributed systems, cloud platforms, or security infrastructure.
* Kubernetes Expertise: Deep expertise in Golang and extensive hands\-on experience with Kubernetes internals, building Operators/Controllers, Cluster API (CAPI), NetworkPolicies, SCCs, MCS, and related security primitives.
* Storage Fundamentals: Solid conceptual and practical understanding of distributed storage systems (block, file, object), data replication, deduplication, and high availability.
* Systems Engineering: Strong background in Linux OS internals, networking, container runtimes (containerd, Docker), and kernel security modules.
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
* This role combines deep platform engineering with hands\-on security ownership. You will shape how NKP delivers secure, compliant, and production\-grade Kubernetes \+ storage capabilities at enterprise scale.


**Work Arrangement**
 Hybrid: This role operates in a hybrid capacity, blending the benefits of remote work with the advantages of in\-person collaboration. In locations where our workplace policy applies (i.e. San Jose, Durham, Mexico City, Bangalore, Pune, Hoofddorp, Belgrade, Barcelona, Singapore, Sydney and Tokyo), employees are expected to work onsite a minimum of 3 days per week to foster collaboration, team alignment, and access to in\-office resources. Workplace type may vary based on location and team requirements. Please speak with your recruiter for details. Additional team\-specific guidance and norms will be provided by your manager.

title: IDP Platform Engineer
description:
**Role Purpose** 




  





 Your job is developer enablement, and it is hands\-on: you own the integration and automation layer of an enterprise internal developer platform built on Port.io. You will write the services and connectors that pull the platform's data together, build the workflows behind every self\-service action using GitHub Actions and Temporal, maintain the reusable pipeline templates and embedded quality gates other teams consume, and operate the containerised runtime it all runs on.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  




* **Integration development:** 
 Write the integration services and custom connectors that connect the platform to ServiceNow (approvals, CMDB), identity, observability, cloud platforms and the delivery toolchain, using TypeScript or Node.js and Python with the Ocean framework.
* **Catalogue data:** 
 Build and maintain the ingestion that keeps the software catalogue accurate and current across source control, cloud platforms and enterprise systems.
* **Workflow orchestration:** 
 Build the automation behind self\-service actions, using GitHub Actions for standard workflows and Temporal for durable orchestrations.
* **Pipeline products:** 
 Build reusable, versioned CI/CD pipeline templates consumed as golden paths.
* **Developer enablement:** 
 Unblock developers on pipelines, environments, tooling and automation, and make the supported approach the simplest one to follow.
* **Integration runtime:** 
 Deploy and operate the self\-hosted integration workloads, such as Ocean\-based connectors and event listeners, as containerised services on Kubernetes.
* **Performance testing capability:** 
 Operate and improve the k6 framework, covering its GitHub workflow integration, Kubernetes execution model and Grafana and InfluxDB visibility, and onboard engineering teams to it.
* **Quality gates:** 
 Integrate security scanning (Wiz, Checkov, OPA), testing and cost tooling so the gates apply by default.



  





**Essential** 




  




* **CI/CD depth:** 
 6\+ years in DevOps or platform engineering with advanced GitHub Actions experience, covering reusable workflows, composite actions, secrets and runner strategy. Equivalent platforms are fine if you are happy to standardise on Actions.
* **Kubernetes:** 
 Solid working Kubernetes
* **Scripting and APIs:** 
 Strong scripting in TypeScript, Node.js, Python or Go, and automation against REST APIs and webhooks.
* **Software engineering:** 
 Production coding ability, not just scripting: services and integrations written in TypeScript or Node.js and Python, with the testing, review and documentation discipline that implies.
* **API integration:** 
 Building and consuming REST APIs, webhooks and event\-driven integrations against enterprise systems, including authentication flows, rate limits and failure handling.
* **Enablement mindset:** 
 A track record of supporting and unblocking development teams, treating automation as a product with users.
* **Pipeline security:** 
 Building security into pipelines: secrets management, least\-privilege runners and service identities, and dependency and IaC scanning as enforced gates.
* **Test automation in CI:** 
 integrate automated testing into pipelines



  





**Nice to Have** 




  




* **Durable orchestration:** 
 Temporal preferred. Airflow, Step Functions or Argo Workflows transfer well.
* **IaC:** 
 Terraform and IaC pipeline integration.
* **Performance testing:** 
 k6, Gatling, JMeter or Locust. Any load\-testing background transfers well.
* **Ecosystem:** 
 Port.io or Backstage exposure, the Ocean framework or comparable connector frameworks, JQ for data mapping, and ServiceNow integration.
* **Security:** 
 Container and Kubernetes security.



  





**Technologies \& Tools** 




  





 The platform environment:
 



  




* **Developer portal:** 
 Port.io, or a Backstage background: catalogue, blueprints, self\-service actions and scorecards, with configuration\-as\-code in JSON and YAML. Custom integrations use the Ocean framework in Python, plus the Port API and Terraform provider.
* **Languages:** 
 TypeScript, Node.js and React, with Python for custom integrations and JQ for data mapping.
* **Orchestration:**

title: Lead Engineer - Core Commerce Platform
description:
SPEED \& SPIRIT is what we look for in our candidates, defined by some simple values that inspire us to BE DRIVEN in our performance, BE VIBRANT in our sporting legacy, BE TOGETHER in our team spirit, and BE YOU to let our individual talent and experience shine. Applying for a job at PUMA is easy and all genders are welcome. Simply click APPLY ONLINE and follow the steps to upload your application.
   

  

**YOUR MISSION:**
 You will be part of the Core Commerce Platform organisation responsible for delivering the omnichannel commerce capabilities that power the purchase journey, inventory availability, delivery promise, order processing \& fulfilment and post\-purchase experiences across channels. The organisation plays a critical role in ensuring products are available to buy, orders can be fulfilled reliably, and commitments made to consumers are delivered consistently. Through a portfolio of commerce platform capabilities, the organisation enables seamless omnichannel experiences while supporting efficient, scalable, and resilient commerce operations across the global digital ecosystem.
   

  

 As an OMS Lead Engineer, you will provide technical leadership for the team building and supporting omni\-channel commerce capabilities. You will own technical architecture, engineering standards, and key technology decisions while ensuring solutions are scalable, reliable, resilient, and aligned with the broader commerce platform strategy. Working closely with the Engineering Manager, Product Owners and Retail Tech Teams, you will deliver scalable, resilient, and secure omni\-channel commerce capabilities. You will champion engineering best practices, code quality, observability, and continuous improvement across the team.
   

  

**What you will do:**
* Lead the design, development, and evolution of Order Management capabilities including order orchestration, inventory availability, fulfilment, returns, and post\-purchase experiences.
* Own the technical architecture, engineering standards, and key technology decisions for OMS platforms and related integrations.
* Design and build scalable, resilient, API\-first and event\-driven services supporting omnichannel commerce use cases such as Click \& Collect (BOPIS), Ship\-from\-Store, Endless Aisle, and Delivery Promise. Partner with Product Owners, Architects, Retail Technology, Supply Chain, and Business stakeholders to translate requirements into robust technical solutions.
* Drive integration of OMS with Commerce Platforms, ERP, WMS, Payments, Logistics, and Customer Service systems.
* Ensure inventory visibility, order processing, fulfilment, and returns workflows are accurate, reliable, and scalable across channels and regions.
* Champion engineering excellence through code quality, automated testing, secure development practices, and continuous improvement.
* Establish and promote best practices in microservices, cloud\-native architecture, observability, performance optimization, and reliability engineering.
* Mentor and coach engineers, providing technical guidance, architecture reviews, and hands\-on support for complex initiatives.
* Drive adoption of AI\-assisted engineering practices and automation to improve developer productivity, quality, and delivery efficiency.


**YOUR TALENT:**
* 10\+ years of hands\-on experience designing and building Order Management capabilities using Java/Spring Boot or equivalent frameworks, including implementation, extension, integration, and customization of packaged or custom order management solutions.
* 3\+ years of experience leading a technical capability, project or engineering team.
* Experience with enterprise order management platforms such as Fluent Commerce (preferred), IBM Sterling OMS, Manhattan Associates, Kibo Commerce, or Salesforce OMS is highly desirable.
* Hands\-on software engineering experience with Java, Spring Boot, and modern microservices architectures, building scalable, resilient, and production\-grade services.
* Deep understanding of the end\-to\-end order lifecycle, including order capture, sourcing, fulfilment, shipment, returns, exchanges, and post\-purchase processes.
* Proven experience customizing and extending OMS capabilities to support evolving business requirements, omnichannel fulfilment models, and enterprise integrations.
* Strong knowledge of omnichannel commerce operations, including Ship\-from\-Store (SFS), Buy Online Pick Up In Store (BOPIS), Ship\-to\-Store, Curbside Pickup, Endless Aisle, and associated order routing strategies.
* Solid understanding of inventory management, sourcing optimization, fulfilment orchestration, and order allocation concepts across stores, DCs, and third\-party fulfilment networks.
* Proven experience integrating OMS platforms with Commerce, WMS, ERP, POS, Payment, 3PL, Carrier, and Customer Service systems to enable end\-to\-end order visibility and orchestration.
* Experience designing OMS\-centric microservice architectures with clear domain boundaries across Order Management, Inventory, Sourcing, Fulfilment, Returns, and Customer Service capabilities.
* Hands\-on experience with Kafka or similar event\-streaming platforms for event\-driven architectures, asynchronous processing, and enterprise\-scale system integrations.
* Experience with performance engineering, scalability testing, and optimization of high\-throughput, business\-critical commerce platforms.
* Experience defining and implementing capacity planning, resiliency, and scaling strategies to support peak trading events and global commerce operations.
* Experience driving technical architecture, establishing engineering standards, mentoring engineers, and influencing technical direction across cross\-functional teams.
* Experience leveraging AI\-assisted engineering tools, coding agents, and LLM\-powered development workflows to improve engineering productivity, software quality, and delivery efficiency.


 PUMA provides equal opportunities for all job applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or disability. Equality for all is one of the core principles at PUMA and we do not tolerate any form of harassment or discrimination.
   

  

 At PUMA, every application is reviewed by real people who are committed to fairness, transparency, and equal opportunity \- no matter your background, identity, or experience. To ensure our process stays true to these values, no automated systems or AI tools are used to make hiring decisions. Every decision is made by real people \-with real judgment and accountability. These functions have no influence on decisions in the application process. We believe in creating spaces where everyone is welcome, celebrated, and empowered to contribute authentically. Because at PUMA, whoever wants to play, can play.
   

  

 PUMA is a global sports brand creating footwear, apparel, and accessories that inspire athletes and everyday movers. The PUMA Group owns PUMA, Cobra Golf, and stichd, operates in 120\+ countries, and has around 22,000 employees worldwide.

 *do your best*

title: Enterprise Architect - Enterprise AI Platform & Governance
description:
Job Title \-
 **Enterprise Architect \- Enterprise AI Platform \& Governance**
**Location:** 
 Kharadi, Pune, India.
   

  

**Life Unlimited.** 
 At Smith\+Nephew, we design and manufacture technology that takes the limits off living.
   

  

**Smith\+Nephew is seeking an Enterprise Architect \- Enterprise AI Platform \& Governance to lead the enterprise\-wide AI architecture strategy, governance, standards and adoption roadmap.**
 This role will serve as the central architecture authority for Artificial Intelligence initiatives across the organisation, defining enterprise AI standards, Agent\-to\-Agent (A2A) communication patterns, Model Context Protocol (MCP) frameworks, integration architectures, security controls and enterprise deployment guidelines.
   

  

 The role will partner with business leaders, digital transformation teams, platform owners, cybersecurity, data teams and external technology partners to establish scalable, secure, compliant and reusable AI solutions. It will participate in the Architecture Review Board (ARB), govern AI technology decisions, lead platform evaluations and selection scoring, and provide templates, playbooks, reference architectures and roadmaps to accelerate enterprise AI adoption.
   

  

**What will you be doing?**
**Enterprise AI Architecture \& Strategy**
* Define enterprise AI architecture vision, principles, standards, reference architectures and target\-state roadmap.
* Create enterprise\-grade patterns for Generative AI, Agentic AI, RAG, orchestration, model integration and AI operations.
* Align AI strategy with cloud, data, cybersecurity, integration, enterprise architecture and digital transformation strategies.
* Provide guidance for enterprise deployments, including pilots, scale\-up, lifecycle management and adoption governance.


**AI Governance \& Architecture Review Board**
* Serve as the AI architecture authority in the ARB and provide design assurance for AI programmes.
* Define AI governance guardrails covering architecture, security, privacy, validation, compliance, responsible AI, monitoring and operational controls.
* Review AI solution designs to ensure alignment with enterprise standards, regulatory expectations and scalable deployment practices.
* Publish standards, reusable templates, checklists, decision records and architecture review packs for AI initiatives.


**Agent Architecture, MCP \& A2A Standards**
* Define enterprise standards for AI agent architecture, autonomous workflows and multi\-agent orchestration.
* Establish patterns for Agent\-to\-Agent communication, agent collaboration, ownership, security, observability and lifecycle management.
* Define enterprise adoption guidance for MCP, context brokering, tool integration, memory, retrieval and interoperability standards.
* Create reusable agent blueprints and integration patterns for enterprise systems and business processes.


**Enterprise AI Platform Selection \& Technology Evaluation**
* Lead AI platform assessments, proofs of concept, vendor evaluations and technology comparison exercises.
* Develop scoring frameworks and objective evaluation criteria for AI platform selection decisions.
* Assess GenAI, LLM, agentic AI, vector database, orchestration, prompt/model management, monitoring and AI engineering platforms.
* Recommend strategic platform investments based on architectural fit, scalability, security, compliance, cost, integration and enterprise readiness.


**AI Integration Architecture**
* Define integration standards connecting AI platforms with ERP, CRM, HR, Supply Chain, Quality, Regulatory, Data Lake, Analytics and enterprise applications.
* Establish API\-led, event\-driven, service\-oriented and agent\-enabled integration patterns.
* Govern data access patterns, semantic layers, retrieval frameworks, model connectors, observability and secure consumption of enterprise data.
* Ensure resilience, scalability, performance, security and auditability across AI integrations.


**Enterprise AI Delivery Enablement**
* Provide architecture templates, reference designs, standards, playbooks, scorecards and roadmap artifacts for AI programmes.
* Mentor solution architects, engineering teams, delivery leads and partners on enterprise AI best practices.
* Support AI portfolio planning, sequencing, dependency management and delivery governance.
* Drive global consistency and reuse across AI initiatives while enabling business agility.


**Skills:**
**Mindset \& Behaviors:**
* Exercises sound judgment and makes clear, timely decisions in ambiguous or evolving situations
* Applies critical thinking to interpret complex information, make sense of ambiguity, and guide clear action
* Demonstrates ethical reasoning and accountability in decision\-making and delivery
* Brings creativity and strategic imagination to reframe problems, explore opportunities, and shape new solutions
* Shows learning agility and adaptability in response to change, feedback, and new information.


**What will you need to be successful?**
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Systems or equivalent experience.
* Licenses / Certifications: TOGAF, Azure AI, Azure Solutions Architect, Cloud Architecture, AI/ML Architecture or equivalent certifications preferred.
* Experience: 12\+ years of experience in Enterprise Architecture, Solution Architecture, Technology Strategy or related leadership roles.
* 5\+ years of experience leading large\-scale Enterprise AI, Generative AI, Agentic AI or digital transformation initiatives.
* Proven experience defining AI standards, architecture governance, technology roadmaps and reference architectures for global enterprises.
* Hands\-on experience with cloud AI platforms such as Azure AI, OpenAI, Microsoft Copilot ecosystem, AWS AI, Google AI or equivalent platforms.
* Strong experience with enterprise integration, data platforms, ERP/CRM ecosystems, security architecture and operational governance.
* Experience participating in Architecture Review Boards and leading platform evaluation or selection decisions.
* Experience in manufacturing and MedTech domains, including regulated product environments, quality management, supply chain, manufacturing operations and compliance\-driven technology delivery.
* Experience with SAP S/4HANA transformation, integration and enterprise architecture, including ERP modernization, process standardization, data integration and AI\-enabled business process automation.
* Core Competencies:
* Enterprise Architecture frameworks such as TOGAF or equivalent; business capability modelling; technology strategy and roadmap planning.
* Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, vector databases, semantic search, AI agents, multi\-agent orchestration, MCP and A2A standards.
* API\-led, event\-driven, microservices, cloud\-native and enterprise integration architecture.
* Responsible AI, AI security, privacy, auditability, model governance, validation, observability and AI operations.
* Executive stakeholder engagement, technology decision\-making, influencing without authority, architecture governance and mentoring.

title: Principal Application Engineer
description:
****Who is Litmus****
 Litmus is building the data foundation that powers industrial AI.
   

  

 AI doesn’t work without real\-world, contextualized data \- Litmus makes that data usable. As AI adoption accelerates, most industrial environments still can’t access or use their operational data. We solve that gap.
   

  

 We’re a growth\-stage software company helping manufacturers access, structure, and use real\-time data from machines, systems, and sensors at the edge. Our platform sits at the intersection of edge computing, AI, and industrial operations, enabling some of the world’s largest companies to run operations in real time, reduce downtime, and optimize production.
   

  

 Backed by leading investors and trusted by global manufacturers and partners like Google, Microsoft, Dell, Oracle, and Mitsubishi, Litmus is powering the shift toward software\-defined manufacturing.
   

  

****Why join Litmus****
****Build the infrastructure that makes industrial AI possible****
 AI is moving beyond the cloud and into the physical world. At Litmus, you’ll build the infrastructure that enables real\-time data to power AI and machine learning systems in production environments.
   

  

****Work on problems where software meets the real world****
 Most AI systems fail without access to real\-world data. You’ll build the layer that makes them viable in production. We solve challenges at the intersection of distributed systems, real\-time data, and industrial constraints — where reliability, scale, and performance are non\-negotiable.
   

  

****Have real impact, fast****
 You’ll work on systems used by real customers in production, with direct impact on product and company trajectory. As a scaling company, we move quickly. You’ll have ownership, visibility, and the ability to shape both product and company as we scale.
   

  

****Join a high\-performance team****
 We’re building a team that holds a high bar and pushes each other to improve. You’ll work alongside experienced operators, engineers, and leaders who have done this before and are building again at scale. We hire people who take ownership, move quickly, and care about outcomes. No passengers.
   

  

****Our culture****
 At Litmus, the team is collaborative, curious, and low ego. People are scrappy, take ownership, and look for ways to make an impact. We value empathy just as much as execution, whether that’s in how we build, how we communicate, or how we support each other.
   

  

 We’re a growing company, so things move quickly and not everything is perfectly defined. If you enjoy figuring things out, working closely with others, and making steady progress, you’ll do well here.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Principal Application Engineer is the senior technical authority within the Litmus Customer Success team for the APAC region. This role provides technical leadership, oversight, and direction to the regional Application Engineering team, ensuring that customer implementations of Litmus Edge and Litmus Edge Manager are architecturally sound, delivered consistently, and aligned with customer outcomes and Litmus best practices.
   

  

 The Principal Application Engineer will oversee the technical work of Application Engineers supporting proof\-of\-concept projects, pilots, production implementations, customer expansions, and complex support engagements. This person will establish regional technical priorities, review and approve solution designs, guide application engineers through complex technical decisions, and ensure that contracted technical responsibilities are delivered successfully.
   

  

 As a senior individual contributor and regional technical leader, the Principal Application Engineer will act as the escalation point for high\-risk implementations, critical customer issues, and complex architectural decisions. The role will also mentor Application Engineers, improve delivery standards, and develop reusable technical approaches that increase the quality, predictability, and scalability of customer delivery across APAC.
   

  

 The Principal Application Engineer will partner closely with Customer Success leadership, Sales Engineers, Account Managers, Product Management, Development, partners, and the Litmus Support Desk. This role reports to the Manager, Customer Success Operations, with global reporting and technical alignment to the Director of Technical Delivery.
   

  

****What You’ll Do****
* Serve as the senior technical authority for Customer Success application engineering activities across the APAC region and provide technical direction, guidance, standards adherence and oversight to Application Engineers.
* Establish technical priorities for the regional Application Engineering team in alignment with customer commitments, commercial objectives, available capacity, implementation risk, and business value.
* Work with Customer Success leadership to assign technical resources and determine the appropriate level of engineering support for customer engagements.
* Balance immediate customer requirements with long\-term maintainability, product strategy, delivery scalability, and Litmus technical standards.
* Ensure that technical solutions demonstrate measurable business value and support customers’ operational, manufacturing, data, automation, and digital transformation objectives.
* Identify implementation dependencies, assumptions, risks, and technical gaps early in the customer lifecycle.
* Support Application Engineers during customer meetings when senior technical leadership, architecture expertise, or escalation management is required.
* Maintain consistency in how Litmus products are designed, configured, deployed, tested, and supported across the APAC region.
* Define when technical exceptions may be approved and document the risks, conditions, and mitigation requirements associated with those exceptions.
* Onboard, mentor and coach Application Engineers, helping them strengthen their architecture, implementation, troubleshooting, customer communication, and decision\-making capabilities.
* Serve as the regional escalation point for complex implementation issues, critical customer incidents, architecture concerns, and unresolved Level 2 support cases and provide advanced troubleshooting, root\-cause analysis, and remediation guidance for issues involving Litmus products, customer infrastructure, networks, integrations, data flows, and industrial systems.
* Support Sales Engineers and Account Executives with architecture reviews, technical strategy, proposal development, scope validation, and implementation risk assessment.
* Provide senior technical oversight during the transition from pre\-sales to implementation.


****What You’ll Bring****
**Must Have**
* 10–15 years of progressive experience in application engineering, solution architecture, systems integration, technical consulting, customer success engineering, industrial technology, or a related technical discipline.
* Significant experience leading complex software, infrastructure, automation, IIoT, analytics, edge\-computing, or shop\-floor implementations in manufacturing or industrial environments.
* Demonstrated experience providing technical leadership, architecture oversight, design approval, and implementation governance across multiple simultaneous customer engagements.
* Experience directing or overseeing the work of engineers, including setting technical priorities, reviewing deliverables, mentoring team members, and making technical decisions.
* Strong understanding of industrial and enterprise solution architecture, including networks, security, protocols, Linux\-based systems, databases, APIs, data pipelines, and distributed deployment environments.
* Deep hands\-on experience with product configuration, systems integration, technical troubleshooting, performance analysis, root\-cause analysis, and production support.
* Strong customer\-facing skills, including the ability to lead architecture workshops, explain complex technical concepts, manage technical objections, and communicate risk clearly.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence customers, engineers, sales teams, partners, product leaders, and executives.
* Strong organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to balance customer urgency, contractual commitments, technical risk, team capacity, and strategic value.
* Ability to operate independently as a senior technical leader while collaborating effectively across regional and global teams.
* Willingness and ability to support customers and engineers across APAC time zones and to travel regionally when required.


**Nice to Have**
* Experience with Litmus Edge, Litmus Edge Manager, industrial data platforms, edge orchestration platforms, or similar technologies.
* Strong knowledge of industrial protocols and systems, including OPC UA, MQTT, Modbus, PLCs, SCADA, historians, MES, and industrial control environments.
* Experience designing highly available, secure, and scalable industrial edge architectures across multiple facilities or geographic regions.
* Knowledge of cybersecurity practices for operational technology, industrial networks, edge devices, and hybrid cloud environments.
* Experience supporting regulated, mission\-critical, or high\-availability customer environments.
* Experience with pre\-sales architecture, technical discovery, proposal approval, statement\-of\-work review, RFI/RFP responses, and commercial scope validation.
* Experience working with systems integrators, channel partners, value\-added resellers, and regional technology partners.
* Experience contributing to product roadmaps, design reviews, beta programs, technical validation, or release\-readiness processes.
* Experience developing technical standards, reference architectures, implementation methodologies, and reusable engineering assets.
* Relevant certifications in cloud architecture, Kubernetes, networking, cybersecurity, industrial automation, or solution architecture.
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering, computer science, information technology, automation, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.


**Measures of Success**
* Quality, consistency, and scalability of APAC customer implementations.
* Successful delivery of strategic proof\-of\-concept and production engagements.
* Reduction in implementation risk, technical rework, escalations, and recurring support issues.
* Timeliness and quality of regional technical decisions and approvals.
* Customer adoption, value realization, satisfaction, and expansion.
* Development and technical readiness of Application Engineers.
* Adoption of regional and global delivery standards, reusable assets, and best practices.
* Effectiveness of pre\-sales\-to\-delivery handovers and technical scope validation.
* Quality and influence of APAC field feedback provided to Product Management and Development.
* Ability to balance customer priorities, team capacity, delivery commitments, and long\-term technical quality.


**Reports To:** 
 Manager, Customer Success Operations
   

  

**Global Technical Alignment:** 
 Director of Technical Delivery
   

  

**Regional Scope:** 
 APAC

title: Enterprise Architect
description:
**Job Summary**
 Principal Architect role in a global enterprise environment responsible for shaping long term architecture strategy and guiding complex transformation programs using Enterprise Architect tooling and practices. The role involves hybrid work in a day shift collaborating with distributed teams to design scalable solutions that support core banking branch operations and improve customer and employee experiences across the organization.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Drive holistic enterprise architecture blueprints that align technology capabilities with long term business objectives ensuring that systems remain scalable secure and adaptable to evolving market demands.
* Define target state architectures for core banking and branch operations creating detailed models with Enterprise Architect tools that reduce complexity and improve operational efficiency across business units.
* Guide solution architects and engineering teams in translating enterprise architecture standards into practical implementation patterns enabling consistent delivery quality across hybrid work locations.
* Coordinate architecture governance forums that review critical initiatives applying standardized principles and patterns to mitigate risk and promote reuse of proven design assets.
* Evaluate proposed application and integration designs for alignment with enterprise roadmaps recommending improvements that enhance data integrity resilience and maintainability for day shift operations.
* Collaborate closely with business stakeholders in branch banking and account setup maintenance and closure processes to ensure that technology solutions directly support regulatory needs and customer service goals.
* Champion modernization initiatives that simplify legacy platforms rationalize application portfolios and introduce modular architectures that reduce long term cost of ownership.
* Develop architecture guidelines and reference models that help project teams make informed design decisions improving time to market for new features in a hybrid work model.
* Assess emerging technologies and industry trends relevant to financial services preparing evidence based recommendations that strengthen competitive advantage and societal trust in digital banking.
* Facilitate architecture reviews and design workshops that foster shared understanding of dependencies performance considerations and security controls across multidisciplinary teams.
* Monitor architecture compliance throughout project lifecycles using Enterprise Architect repositories and diagrams to track deviations and drive corrective action.
* Document end to end solution landscapes for key programs in core banking and branch operations providing clear traceability from business capabilities to applications and infrastructure components.
* Optimize collaboration patterns between architecture development and operations teams to support reliable day shift delivery without requiring travel while still enabling effective stakeholder engagement.


**Qualifications**
* Demonstrate extensive experience using Enterprise Architect to model complex enterprise landscapes including business processes applications data and technology layers in large multinational environments.
* Bring deep background in enterprise architecture frameworks such as TOGAF or similar structured methods applying them pragmatically to guide long term transformation roadmaps.
* Show practical exposure to branch banking domain areas including account setup maintenance and closure with clear understanding of compliance risk and customer journey considerations.
* Possess strong skills in documenting architecture decisions creating clear diagrams and presenting technical concepts to business and technology audiences in concise and accessible language.
* Exhibit ability to work effectively in hybrid models and distributed teams using collaborative tools and disciplined communication practices to maintain shared architectural understanding.
* Apply robust knowledge of integration patterns data management practices and security controls that are critical for reliable and trustworthy financial services platforms.

title: Technical Engineer - Process Intelligence
description:
**About AkzoNobel**
 Since 1792, we’ve been supplying the innovative paints and coatings that help to color people’s lives and protect what matters most. Our world class portfolio of brands – including Dulux, International, Sikkens and Interpon – is trusted by customers around the globe. We’re active in more than 150 countries and use our expertise to sustain and enhance the fabric of everyday life. Because we believe every surface is an opportunity. It’s what you’d expect from a pioneering and long\-established paints company that’s dedicated to providing sustainable solutions and preserving the best of what we have today – while creating an even better tomorrow. Let’s paint the future together.
   

  

 For more information please visit www.akzonobel.com
   

  

 © 2026 Akzo Nobel N.V. All rights reserved.
   

  

**Job Purpose**
 Design, configure, test, and continuously improve enterprise process intelligence solutions and business process monitoring capabilities using Celonis EMS and related enterprise technologies.
   

  

 Support business transformation initiatives through IT changes, Agile DevOps delivery, and process optimization activities in line with global Information Technology (IT), enterprise architecture, and security standards to enable operational excellence, process transparency, and measurable business value.
   

  

 The role contributes to data\-driven decision making by translating business process requirements into scalable process mining solutions, dashboards, analytics, and actionable insights across global business functions.
   

  

* The Technical Engineer in IT Operations is responsible for translating business process requirements into detailed functional designs, Celonis stories, KPIs, dashboards, and EMS configurations in accordance with enterprise architecture and security standards. Working within projects, operational changes, and Agile DevOps teams, the Functional Engineer coordinates the preparation, review, execution, and testing of process mining solutions while ensuring high\-quality delivery and stakeholder alignment throughout the implementation lifecycle.


 The Technical Engineer actively collaborates with business process owners, implementation partners, and external consultants during the execution of enhancements and deployments. The role contributes to incident resolution, root cause analysis, process optimization initiatives, and continuous improvement activities to strengthen operational performance and process transparency.
   

  

* The Functional Engineer in Application Delivery is responsible for leading enterprise\-wide process intelligence initiatives and defining scalable process mining solutions across business domains. The role drives strategic transformation programs, establishes governance standards, mentors team members, and partners with Architects and senior stakeholders to design advanced analytics, AI\-enabled process intelligence capabilities, and sustainable optimization roadmaps.


 The Functional Engineer oversees large\-scale implementations and complex operational changes together with strategic partners and cross\-functional teams. The role ensures quality execution, monitors delivery progress, governs testing and deployment activities, and leads continuous improvement, incident management, and process mining best practice adoption across the organization.
   

  

 We are seeking an experienced Functional Engineer with a strong background in process mining and a proven track record in designing \& implementing impactful process mining use cases. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in using Celonis to analyse, optimize, and transform key business operations, particularly within finance and supply chain functions.
   

  

 You will leverage Celonis Process Intelligence capabilities, AI\-driven insights, and Agentic Automation features to drive digital transformation initiatives by identifying operational inefficiencies, opportunities for potential savings, and developing advanced Celonis applications, dashboards, and intelligent workflows that enhance performance and achieve business objectives.
   

  

 The role will also contribute to the adoption of AI\-powered process optimization, predictive analytics, intelligent recommendations, and autonomous action orchestration across enterprise processes
   

  

**Key Activities**
**Story specification**
 Translate business process requirements into clear and detailed Celonis solution designs. Own and develop high\-quality stories and configuration specifications for Engineers, Developers, and implementation partners to translate into dashboards, process models, integrations, analytics, and EMS configurations including implementation proposals and deployment planning.
   

  

**Development \& delivery**
 Guide, coordinate, and oversee the preparation, implementation, and deployment of process intelligence solutions and related configurations. Ensure that all internal and external partners follow established standards including process documentation, governance controls, testing procedures, naming conventions, and architectural principles. Review, approve, and control the implementation of new enhancements, dashboards, KPIs, analytics models, and process mining capabilities across enterprise solutions.
   

  

 This results in sustainable, scalable, and business\-aligned solutions delivered in close collaboration with stakeholders, business process owners, and external service providers. Solutions are developed according to enterprise architecture and security standards, while changes are properly prepared, documented, validated, and implemented to deliver operational insights and measurable business outcomes.
   

  

**Testing**
 Own and coordinate testing activities for Celonis stories, dashboards, process models, and integrations. Develop and maintain test scenarios, review test outcomes, support user acceptance testing, coordinate business sign\-off, and contribute to release planning and test management activities to ensure reliable and high\-quality deployments.
   

  

**Incident management**
 Perform functional and technical analysis of incidents, data quality issues, and process intelligence disruptions based on business impact and severity. Conduct root cause analysis, document findings, coordinate corrective actions, and oversee deployment of fixes to ensure timely and effective issue resolution and stable operational performance.
   

  

**Process management and improvement**
 Monitor and analyze the performance, adoption, and security of Celonis solutions and related enterprise applications against agreed service and business KPIs. Actively contribute to process optimization initiatives through dashboard development, operational insight visualization, automation, and advanced analytics. Maintain visibility of technical debt and collaborate closely with Domain Architects and delivery teams to continuously improve process intelligence capabilities, DevOps practices, and platform stability.
   

  

**Project support**
 Support project and program managers by taking ownership of process intelligence deliverables including requirements gathering, configurations, dashboards, analytics, testing, and deployment coordination. Define, plan, manage, and execute assigned activities in alignment with IT delivery leads and business stakeholders to ensure efficient realization of project objectives and transformation outcomes.
   

  

**Experience**
 Knowledge extends across complete process intelligence domains and related enterprise processes.
   

  

 Participates in complex transformation initiatives up to €500K and coordinates, reviews, and approves operational and technical solution changes.
   

  

 Acts as a trusted advisor to business stakeholders by identifying optimization opportunities and translating them into process mining and analytics solutions.
   

  

 Communicates technical concepts and process insights effectively to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
   

  

 Demonstrates strong understanding of Agile and DevOps delivery methodologies.
   

  

 Leads complex analytical assessments across multiple domains, identifies optimization opportunities, and evaluates implementation effort and business value realization.
   

  

 Initiates and implements process intelligence standards, governance procedures, and continuous improvement initiatives across functions.
   

  

 Translates business requirements into scalable process intelligence and optimization opportunities across related systems and functions.
   

  

 4–7 years of relevant experience leading process intelligence initiatives and cross\-functional optimization activities
   

  

 Relevant Bachelor or Master degree

Our talent acquisition process plays an integral part in this journey, as setting the foundations for a diverse environment.
